dang bza' tsho la sogs da lta lhan cig tu 'dus pa 'di rnams kyang 'phral 'phral so sor 'bral bar 'gyur ba yin pas/ khong khro dang 'thab rtsod ngan shag dang 'thab mo sogs mi byed par yun ring 'grogs pa'i nges pa med pas 'phral snang yud tsam pa 'dir brtse bas 'grogs shing skyong dgos snyam du bsams te/pha dam pas/ bza' tshang mi rtag tshong dus mgron po la/ ngan shag 'thab mo ma byed ding ri pa/ zhes gsungs/ brtsigs pa'i mkhar thams cad kyang 'gyel bar 'gyur ba yin te/ sngon dar zhing rgyas pa'i grong sde dang / dbo/na gnas stong pa'i shul 'di dag la'ang skyes bu'i bdag bzang po re yod pa yin te/ da lta'i gnas skabs nas/ bya dang bye'u'i tshang du song / lha sras khri srong lde'u btsan gyi ring na/sprul pa'i bzo bor bzhengs shing / u rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas rab gnas mdzad pa/ bsam yas dbu rtse rim gsum lta bu yang me'i gnod pas zhag gcig la zhig chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus su dmar po'i ri yi pho brang rnam rgyal khang bzang la 'gran pa lta bu yod pa'ang da lta ming rdo tsam yang ma lus pa yin na/rang re'i grong khyim dang dgon gnas 'bu tshang lta bu 'di la gces spras su byas nas ci zhig byed/des na bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ pha yul rgyab tu bskyur/ mi yul dang du blangs/ gnas brag rtsa ru bsdad/ grogs ri dwags dang 'grogs/ gyong lto gos gtam gsum la bskur nas blo phugs chos la gtad/ chos phugs sprang la gtad/ sprang phugs shi la gtad/shi phugs grogs stong la gtad de/jo bo bka' gdams pa'i gtad sa bzhi po 'di mthar 'khyol ba zhig byed dgos snyam du snying thag pa nas bsam/ mthon po'i thob dang dpa' ba'i dpung yang mi 50

rtag pa yin te/ 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po nga las nu lta bu gling bzhi la dbang ba'i gser gyi 'khor lo sgyur ba/sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha yul la'ang dbang byas/ lha'i dbang po brgya byen dang stan gcig la sdod/ lha ma yin gyi g.yul ngo bzlog nus pa yang mthar sa steng du lhung ste/ 'dod pa rnams kyis ma ngoms bzhin du shi ba yin/ da lta rang res mthong chos la'ang rgyal po'am/ bla dpon gyi drung 'khor/yul sde'i dpon po sogs/ thob thang dang khe drags yod pa thams cad kyang rtag par de ga'i ngang du bsdad pa gcig kyang med/ sngar lo khrims lung gzhan la ston pa'i btsan po rnams kyang / da lo btson khang du nyal dgos pa du ma mthong bas rtag pa med pa'i mnga' thang gis ci byed/de bas dus rtag tu rgud pa dang nyams pa med par 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i mchod 'os su gyur pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang zhig bsgrub dgos snyam du bsam/ de bzhin du dgra gnyen kyang mi rtag ste/ sngon 'phags pa ka pho na bsod stoms la phebs pas khyim bdag zhig gis bu zhig pang na bzung / nya sha zhig zhim zhim ltar za/ khye mo zhig rus pa 'cha' ba la rdo deg par/ 'phags pas mngon shes kyis gzigs pas/ nya de skye ba da res kyi pha dang / khyi mo de ma'i skye ba yin zhing / tshe sngon rang gsod pa'i dgra de srog lan chags nas/ bur skyes pa yin par gzigs pas/ pha sha za zhing ma la deg /gsod pa'i dgra bo pang na bzung / /chung mas khyo yi rus pa 'cha'/ /'khor ba'i chos la gad mo bro/ /zhes gsungs pa yin/ tshe 'dir yang dgra mi sha bor gyur pa rnams kyang / phyis su mthun pa'i gros/sa byas/ gnyen dang nye bar sbrel/ mdza' mthun gzhan las lhag pa yang du ma 'dug /pha ma dang spun zla yin kyang rgyu rdzas 51

dang longs spyod phra mo re'i ched du 'khon nas gcig gis gcig la ci gnod byed pa dang / bza' tsho dang nye 'brel yin yang 'phral rkyen phran bu res dgrar gyur te gcig gis gcig gsod pa yang mthong bas dgra gnyen gang yang rtag pa med pas thams cad byams pa dang snying rjes skyong dgos snyam du yang yang bsam/skyid sdug gi gnas skabs kyang mi rtag ste tshe stod 'byor zhing skyid pa du ma/ tshe smad dbul zhing sdug bsngal ba dang / tshe stod sdug bsngal ba du ma tshe sprud la skyid pa yang yod cing /tshe stod sprang por gyur pa yang tshe smad rgyal po byas pa yang du ma yod/rje btsun mi la'i sa khu lta bu/snga dro mna' ma bsus te skyid pa'i ston mo byed pa la phyi dro khang pa brdibs te sdug bsngal gyi smre sngags 'don pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab/ chos phyir dka' ba spyad de sdug bsngal gyi rnam grangs du ma myong yang mthar bde skyid bla na med pa thob ste/ sngon byon gyi rgyal ba gong ma rnams dang rje btsun mi la lta bu yin/ sdig pas bsags pa'i longs spyod kyis skyid por byas kyang mthar sdug bsngal mu mtha' med par 'gyur te/ sngon nyi 'og/ gi rgyal khab tu dang po zhag bdun 'bru'i char babs/ de nas zhag bdun gos kyi char babs de nas zhag bdun rin po che'i char babs/ mthar sa'i char babs te thams cad sa 'og tu shi nas ngan song du skyes pa lta bu yin pas/ skyid sdug rtag pa med pa la re dogs kyi 'dzin 'khris mi byed par 'jig rten tshe 'di'i bde skyid longs spyod thams cad mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin dor/ chos phyir dka' spyad dang snying rus kyis sdug bsngal dang du blangs nas rgyal ba gong ma'i gshegs shul snyogs pa zhig byed dgos snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsgom/bzang po dang ngan pa yang mi rtag 52

ste/ 'jig rten gyi phyogs nas kyang / kha drag dang gtam bshad/ shes rgya dang pher yod/ dpa' rtsal dang spyang grung 'dzom pa rnams kyang rgad pa'i dus la babs/sngon bsags kyi bsod nams zad tsa na bsam blo thams cad phyin ci log tu skye/bya ba thams cad lam du mi 'gro/ mis 'phya/ rang sdug gzhan gyis brnyas bcos byed ba kho nar gyur/ sngar gyi yon tan phran bu re yod pa rnams zad pa ltar gyur nas ci yang med pa yang du ma yod/ sngar shes med dang / bsam med khram pa dang rdzun ma yin zer ba mang po phyis longs spyod dang 'byor pa thob/ khram pa rgas pa gtso bo zer ba'i dpe bzhin gzhan gyis blo gtad byed/ bzang po dang bsam yod du brtsi ba yang du ma yod/ chos phyogs nas kyang / rtogs ldan rgas pa'i slob gnyer/ zhen log rgas pa'i gsog 'jog ston pa rgas pa'i bza' dpon zer ba bzhin tshe stod 'jig rten gyi bya bzhag thams cad blos btang ba'i bya btang yang tshe smad rgyu zas kyi gsog 'jog rem pa dang / tshe stod gzhan la chos bshad byed pa'i slob dpon yang tshe smad rngon pa dang rkun jag byed pa dang / tshe stod 'dul 'dzin gyi mkhan po yang tshe smad phru gu mang po'i pha ma byed pa sogs yod cing / tshe stod sdig pa'i las kho na byed pa yang tshe smad dam pa'i chos kho na sgrub cing grub pa thob pa'am/ min kyang 'chi khar lam sna zin pa skye ba gong 'phel du gyur pa sogs du ma yod pa yin pas da lta bzang ngan gyi snang ba skad cig ma la rtag pa dang brtan pa gang yang med kyang /rang la nges 'byung dang skyo shas sad sud skyes/ltar snang gi chos zhig sgrub lo byas/gzhan 'jig rten pas bzang por brtsis te/yon bdag dang slob mas zhabs nas bteg tsa na rang gis rang rgyud zhib tu mi 53

brtag par nga ni de dang de lta bu yin no snya/ma nas nga rgyal gyis rgyud sbos/ snang ba 'ur langs ngas gang byas kyang chog snyam pa'i blo skye ba ni/ bdud kyis mngon sum du bslus pa yin zhing / bdag 'dzin yul phud/ bdag med kyi ye shes skyes/'phags pa'i sa ma thob kyi bar du bzang ngan gyi snang ba la rtag pa med pas/dus rtag tu 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom/ rang rgyud kyi skyon la rtog rtag tu dman sa 'dzin/ nges 'byung dang skyo shas bskyed/ zhi dul dang bag yod la bslab/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa dang / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la bsams nas dus rtag tu/ yi phya dung nge/ sems skyo chad de ba zhig la bslab dgos te/ rje mi las/mi med lung pa'i brag phug na/ /skyo chad de ba la sangs dus med/ /bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la/ /yid dung nge ba la 'bral ba med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar nyams su blang dgos/ de ltar nyams su ma blangs na/ 'phral gyi rnam rtog 'di yang mi rtag pa yin pas cir 'gyur gtol med de/ sngon nye ba dgrar langs pa'i mi zhig phyis su chos sgor zhugs nas/ sgrub pa byas pa'i dge slong thang pa zhes bya ste/ rlung sems la rang dbang thob nas nam mkhar 'phur nus tsa na/ nyin gcig gtor zan za ba la phug ron mang po 'dus pas/ nga la 'di lta bu'i dmag sde yod na dgra bo de rnams tshar gcod nus snyam pa'i rnam rtog ngan pa zhig lam du ma bslangs pas/phyis yul du babs nas dmag dpon byed pa zhig byung ba yin/ de bzhin du 'phral du bla ma dang dge ba'i grogs po'i rkyen las/chos kyi snang ba tsam thob kyang /so so'i skye bo'i 'du shes la rtag pa med pas rang mgo nyi ma chos kyis bton te/tshe dang sgrub pa stoms pa zhig byed dgos snyam du bsam mo/ /de ltar dpe don du 54

ma la bsams kyang / ya ki srid pa'i rtse mo nas/ ma ki dmyal ba'i gnas ris yan chad rtag pa dang brtan pa cung zad kyang med pa 'pho 'gyur 'phel 'grib kyi rang bzhin du yid ches par bya'o//drug pa 'chi rkyen nges med la bsams te mi rtag pa bsgom pa ni/ rang re 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rnams skyes pa tsam nas 'chi ba nges kyang / 'chi lugs 'chi rkyen 'chi ba'i dus tshod ma nges shing / nam 'chi dang 'dir 'chi/ 'di ltar 'chi dang gang gis 'chi ba ni su la'ang nges pa med de/ 'jig rten 'dir 'tsho ba'i rkyen ni nyung zhing 'chi ba'i rkyen ni mang bar/ slob dpon ārya de was/ 'chi ba'i rkyen ni shin tu mang / /'tsho ba'i rkyen ni shin tu nyung / /de yang 'chi ba'i rkyen du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ me dang /chu dang / dug dang / g.yang dang / mi rgod dang / gcan gzan la sogs 'chi ba'i rkyen ni shin tu mang zhing / 'tsho ba'i rkyen ni nyung zad tsam las med la/ 'tsho ba'i rkyen du rlom pa'i zas gos la sogs pa rnams kyang 'chi ba'i rkyen du 'gyur ba yang yod de/ dug can gyi bza' ba zos pa'am/ min kyang 'phral du lus la phan par zlom nas zas zos pa yang gyur dug gam mi 'phrod par gyur nas 'chi ba'i rkyen byed pa yang mang zhing / khyad par da lta'i dus skabs na skye bo phal cher sha'i zas la sred pa che bas/ sha khrag gi zas bag med du spyad pa la brten dmar gdon nam sha sgren gyis nad du ma gyur pa med pa lta bu dang / gzhan yang zas dang spyod lam nyes pas/ skran dang bad kan chu nad bskyed de 'chi ba'i rkyen byas pa ni grangs kyis mi chod/ de bzhin du longs spyod dang snyan grags la sogs don du gnyer bas pha rol gyi g.yul ngor 55

phyin pa'am/ gcan gzan ma rungs pa'i drung du 'gro ba/ chu la bag med du brgal ba sogs 'chi ba'i rkyen du gyur pa yang grangs kyis mi chod/ gzhan yang 'chi rkyen rnam pa sna tshogs pas 'chi dus nges pa med par 'chi ba yin te/ kha cig ma yi mngal du 'chi ba yang yod/kha cig skyes ma thag tu 'chi ba yang yod/kha cig gog po 'gog tsam na 'chi ba yang yod/ kha cig dar la babs nas 'chi ba yang yod/ kha cig rgas shing 'khog nas 'chi ba yang yod/ kha cig sman dang srung ba byed long med par 'chi ba yang yod/ kha cig lo nad stan la 'byar nas shi mig gson la bltas// rus mgo lpags kyis g.yogs te 'chi ba yod/ kha cig gdong thug lta bus zas za 'phro gtam bshad 'phro las ka byed 'phro la shi ba du ma yod/ kha cig rang gis rang gsod pa yang yod pa yin la/ de ltar 'chi ba'i rkyen grangs mang ba'i dbus na 'tsho ba'i tshe nus pa chung ba rlung gseb kyi mar me lta bu gnas pa yin pas dus da lta tsam 'chi ba glo bur du sleb ste/ sang gi nyi ma tsam la mgo'am kha la rwa co skyes pa'i dud 'gro zhig tu skyes med pa'i nges pa yang med pas/ nam 'chi cha med dang gar skye nges med la yid ches thob par bya'o/ /bdun pa 'dun pa drag po la bsams te mi rtag pa bsgom pa ni/ dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du 'chi ba kho na bsgom zhing 'gro 'dug nyal gsum thams cad la 'jig rten 'di'i spyod lam gyi tha ma yin no/ /zhes ngag tu yang brjod/ yid la'ang dung nge bsgom/ gnas gzhan du 'gro na'ang der 'chi'am gnas 'dir e log cha med do snyam pa dang / lam du zhugs pa'am ngal stegs la sdod na'ang 'dir 'chi'am snyam pa dang / gang na 'dug kyang 'dir 'chi 'am snyam pa dang / 56

mtshan mo nyal ba'i dus kyang do nub nyal sa 'dir 'chi'am sang nyin ldang pa'i nges pa med do snyam pa dang / nangs mo ldang pa'i dus kyang de ring gi nyin gang 'dir 'chi'am do nub nyal ba'i nges pa med do snyam du 'chi ba 'ba' zhig snying thag pa nas dung dung bsgom zhing / sngon bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes rnams mtshan mo gzims pa'i tshe nangs par me btang rgyu e 'ong mi shes snyam du me mi sba ba dang / gsol zhal yang kha sbubs nas 'jog pa sogs 'phral dang 'phral la 'chi ba'i thugs 'dun 'ba' zhig mdzad pa bzhin nyams su blang / 'chi ba tsam bsgoms pas kyang mi 'ong ste 'chi khar phan pa dam pa'i chos kho na yin pas/ dus rtag tu dran pa dang shes bzhin ma bral ba'i ngang nas 'khor ba'i bya bzhag thams cad mi rtag snying po med par shes pas yang dag pa'i chos la bskur dgos te/ spyir lus sems kyi tshogs pa mi rtag pas g.yar po la bdag tu ma 'dzin/ 'gro na lam mi rtag pas/ sdud pa las/gnya' shing gang tsam lta zhing 'gro 'a/ sems 'khrul med gom pa chos phyogs su 'dor/ 'dug na gnas mi rtag pas dag pa'i zhing khams yid la bya/ bza' btung dang longs spyod mi rtag pas ting nge 'dzin zas su za/ nyal na gnyid mi rtag pas 'khrul pa 'od gsal du sbyangs/ /'byor na nor mi rtag pas 'phags pa'i nor bdun bsnyen/ gnyen grogs dang srid sde mi rtag pas dben par nges 'byung la bskul/ che btsan dang snyan grags mi rtag pas rtag tu dman sa bzung / smra ba'i tshig mi rtag pas bzlas brjod dang kha bton la bskul/ dad pa dang nges 'byung mi rtag pas dam bca' brtan po la brtson/ 'du shes dang rnam rtog mi rtag pas mi gzhi bzang po la bslab/ nyams 57

dang rtogs pa mi rtag pas chos nyid zad pa la skyol dang / de'i dus su skye 'chi'i bar lag 'gyel/ 'chi brod kyi gdeng tshad rnyed/ 'chi med kyi btsan sa zin/ bya rgod po gnam 'phangs chod pa dang 'dra bas/ 'chi yong snyam pa'i yi mug de dus de nas bsgom mi dgos te/ rje mi las/ nga 'chi bas 'jigs nas ri la phyin/ nam 'chi cha med bsgoms bsgoms pas/ /'chi med gnyug ma'i btsan sa zin/ /da 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bor te thal/ /zhes dang / mnyam med dwags po rin po che'i zhal nas/ dang po skye 'chi'i 'jigs pas ded pa sha ba btson dong nas 'bros pa lta bu zhig dgos/ bar du shi yang mi 'gyod pa zhing pas so nam rem ba lta bu zhig dgos/ tha ma blo bde ba bya ba rlabs chen zin pa'i skyes bu lta bu zhig dgos/ dang po long med du shes pa skyes bu'i gnad la mda' phog pa lta bu zhig dgos/ bar du yengs med du bsgom pa bu gcig po shi ba'i ma lta bu zhig dgos/ tha ma byar med du shes pa phyugs ma dgras ded pa'i rdzi bo lta bu zhig dgos/ zhes gsungs/de lta bu ma byung gi bar du 'chi ba mi rtag pa 'di kho na bsgom dgos te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / mi rtag pa mang du bsgom na sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa byas pa yin no/ /mi rtag pa mang du bsgom na sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbugs phyung pa yin no/ /mi rtag pa mang du bsgom na sangs rgyas thams cad kyis lung ston pa yin no/ /mi rtag pa mang du bsgom na sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ /dper na rjes rnams kyi nang na glang po che'i rjes mchog yin no/ /de bzhin du nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bsgo ma pa'i 'du shes thams cad kyi nang na mi rtag pa bsgom pa'i 'du shes kho na mchog yin no/ 58

zhes gsungs pa dang / 'dul ba lung las/ nga'i 'khor bum pa bzang po lta bu/dge slong shā ri'i bu dang / mo'u 'gal gyi bu dang 'dra ba brgya la gdugs tshon yon dang bcas pa byin ba bas/ 'dus byas mi rtag ba skad cig ma gcig dran pa mchog yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du dge ba'i bshes gnyen pu to ba la dge bsnyen gcig gis chos gcig tu bya ba la gal gang che lags zhus pas/ pu to ba'i zhal nas/chos gcig tu bya ba la mi rtag pa bsgom pa 'di gal che ste/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa 'di bsgom na/ dang po chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu byed/ bar du dge sbyor la sku/la ba'i rkyen byed/ tha ma chos mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i grogs byed/ yang mi rtag pa 'di bsgom na/ dang po tshe 'di'i gdos thag chod pa'i rgyu byed/ bar du 'khor ba mtha' dag la zhen pa ldog pa'i rkyen byed/ tha ma mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam du 'jug pa'i grogs byed/ yang mi rtag pa 'di bsgom na/ dang po dad pa skye ba'i rgyu byed/ bar du brtson 'grus rtsom pa'i rkyen byed/ tha mar shes rab skye ba'i grogs byed/ yang mi rtag pa 'di bsgoms shing rgyud la skyes na/ dang po chos tshol ba'i rgyu byed/ bar du chos sgrub pa'i rkyen byed/ tha ma chos mthar phyin pa'i grogs byed/ yang mi rtag pa 'di bsgoms shing rgyud la skyes na/ dang po go cha'i brtson 'grus rtsom pa'i rgyu byed/ bar du sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus rtsom pa'i rkyen byed/ tha mar phyir mi ldog pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom pa'i grogs byed/ gsungs shing / pha dam pa'i zhal nas kyang /mi rtag pa 'di rgyud la skyes na/ dang po chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu byed/ bar du brtson 'grus kyi lcab byed/ mthar 'od gsal chos sku thob par byed gsungs/ des na mi rtag pa'i 'du shes bcos ma ma yin pa zhig rgyud la ma skyes 59

na chos zhu lo dang byed lo ji tsam byas kyang mthar chos dred kyi rgyur 'gyur ba yin te/ dam pa'i zhal nas/ bod kyis chos byed pa la shi snyam pa ni gcig kyang mi snang ba la/ lus pa ni gcig kyang ma mthong / lar ser gos gyon nas nor bsags pa la dga' tshad 'dis 'chi bdag gshin rje la zas nor 'jal ba e yin snyam/nor bzang bzang thams cad tshags byed lugs la/ dmyal ba la lkog 'dun 'jal ba e yin snyam/ bod kyi chos pa 'di tsho mthong na dgod re bro ha ha/ thos pa su che nga rgyal che/ /sgom pa su bzang zas nor bsog /dben pa su brten 'du 'dzi mang / /rang yul gang spangs ngo tsha med/ /de tsho chos la dred pa yin/ /de tsho sdig la dga' ba yin/ /pha rol po shi ba mthong yang rang 'chi ba mi shes pas le lan dang po de la thug ces gsungs/ de'i phyir mi rtag pa'i 'du shes bsgom pa ni chos nyams su len pa thams cad kyi sngon 'gro sgo 'byed pa yang yin te/ dge bshes pu to ba la rkyen ngan sbyong tshul gyi gdams ngag zhus pas/ pu to ba'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis 'chi ba mi rtag pa mang du soms dang / der 'chi nges pa'i blo gcig byung na/ sdig pa spong ba la dka' rgyu med/ dge ba sgrub pa la dka' rgyu med pa zhig 'ong gi/ de'i steng khyod kyi byams pa dang snying rje mang du sgoms dang / de rgyud la skyes na/ sems can gyi don byed pa la dka' rgyu med pa zhig 'ong gi de'i steng du khyod kyis chos rnams kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid mang du sgoms dang /de rgyud la skyes na/'khrul pa sbyong ba la dka' rgyu med pa zhig 'ong gi zhes gsungs/de ltar mi rtag pa rgyud la skyes na/ 'jig rten tshe 'di'i bya bzhag thams cad la zhen pa gting nas log pa sgyug nad can la btso zan byin pa lta bu zhig 'ong ba 60

yin te/ rje bla ma'i zhal nas kyang / ngas 'jig rten 'di'i mthon po dang btsan po phyug po dang 'phyor po dang ji lta bu zhig mthong yang de la yid smon mi 'chor bar dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar la lta ba 'di mi rtag pa cung zad re rgyud la skyes pa'i don gyis yin/nga la 'di las lhag pa'i gdams ngag gang yang ston rgyu med/ces yang yang gsungs/ de lta bu'i mi rtag pa rgyud la skyes pa'i tshad ji lta bu zhig yin na/ dge bshes kha rag sgom chung lta bu zhig dgos pa yin te/ khong gtsang gi jo mo kha rag gi ri khrod du sgrub pa byed pa la byon pas brag phug gi sgo na tsher phung zhig 'dug pa la na bza' 'thogs pas dang po bcad dam snyam pa la rjes su/sa cang nga brag phug gi nang 'dir 'chi ba las slar e ldog mi shes de bas dge sbyor rang byas na khebs che dgongs nas bcad pa ma byung / yang sgor byon skabs kyang de bzhin byung ba la nga sgo nas nang du e ldog mi shes dgongs te/ de ltar lo mang po'i bar du bzhugs bla ma grub pa thob ste song yang tsher phung gcod pa ma byung ba yin/ de bzhin du rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa la'ang ston ṛ ka'i tshe chu gzims kyi rdzing bu zhig yod pa la them skas med pas 'byon bzhugs shin tu dka' bar yod pa 'dir them skas zhig bgyis na zhus pas/ sang phod 'dir e nyal mi shes de 'dra'i dka' las kyis ci byed ces gsungs pa yin te/ dus rtag tu mi rtag pa'i gsung kho na 'byon pa yin gsungs/des na rang re rnams kyang de lta bu re rgyud la nges par ma skyes kyi bar du sbyor ba sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi thabs sna tshogs kyis blo bcos te mi rtag pa gsha' ma zhig rgyud la ma skyes kyi bar du bsgom/ mjug bsngo ba'i rgyas thebs par bya ba dang bcas nyams su blangs 61

nas dam pa gong ma'i rjes shul snyogs pa zhig la ci nas kyang 'bad dgos pa yin no/ /mi rtag mngon du gyur kyang rtag par 'dzin/ /rga ba'i grong sgor sleb kyang gzhon par rlom/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra log rtog sems can rnams/ /mi rtag rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs//tshe mi rtag pa'i khrid do//gsum pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/'khor ba'i bya bzhag snying po med par dgongs//snying rje chen pos gzhan don 'ba' zhig gnyer//srid zhir ma zhen theg chen gzhung bzhin mdzad//mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo//don gsum pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs kyi khrid la'ang gnyis las/ dang po chos la nyan 'chad bgyid pa'i tshul sngar dang 'dra/ gnyis pa bshad bya'i chos la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spyir bsam pa dang / bye brag rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal bsam pa dang gnyis/ dang po ni sngar bshad pa de ltar rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor rnyed kyang yun ring sdod longs med par mi rtag 'chi ba'i dbang du 'gro/shi nas kyang me shi ba'am chu skam pa lta bu zhig yin na de ka las gzhan mi 'dug kyang / shi nas med du mi 'gro zhing skye ba len dgos pa yin/ skye ba zhig blangs phyin chad 'khor ba'i gnas las ma 'das te/ spyir 'khor ba zhes bya ba de rdza mkhan gyi 'phang lo'am/ zo zun gyi khyud mo'am/ bum nang gi bung ba bzhin 62

gcig nas gcig tu 'khor ba la zer/ de'ang bum nang du bung ba bcug nas kha bcad pa na bung ba de gang du 'phur yang bum nang las gzhan du 'gro mi nus/dpe de bzhin du 'khor ba'i gnas 'di mtho dman gang du skyes kyang 'khor ba'i gnas ris las mi 'da' ste/bum pa'i stod lta bu mngon mtho lha mi'i gnas dang /smad lta bu ngan song gsum gyi gnas ris yin/ de ltar 'gro ba'i gnas rigs drug po 'dir zag bcas kyi las dge ba dang mi dge ba'i rgyus gcig nas gcig tu skye zhing 'khor bas na 'khor ba zhes bya/ rang re 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir thog ma med pa'i dus nas 'khyams te/ 'khor ba'i sems can 'di thams cad phan tshun pha ma dang dgra gnyen btang snyoms gsum ma byas pa gcig kyang med/ 'di'i ma ni 'di'o//de'i ma ni 'di'o//zhes sems can gcig gi ma brgyud pa'i grangs sa chen po 'di ril bu rgya shug gi tshig gu tsam du dril te bgrangs kyang sa chen po 'di thams cad zad par 'gyur gyi/ sems can re re'i ma byas shing brgyud pa'i grangs mi zad pa mdo las gsungs pa'i don/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshig gu tsam//ril bur dril kyang sa yis longs mi 'gyur//zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ da lta'i bar du skye ba 'di ma blangs bya ba med pas 'dod pa'i phyir mgo dang yan lag bcad pa'ang grangs kyis mi chod/ grog spur la sogs srog chags phra mor skyes pa'i yan lag rnams da lta gcig tu bsdom rgyu yod na ri yi rgyal po ri rab las kyang mtho/ kha la zas med/ rgyab la gos med/ 'khyag ltog skom gsum la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal spyong nas ngus pa'i mchi ma thams cad ma skam par bsags na mtha'i rgya mtsho 63

chen po las kyang mang /dmyal ba'i gnas su skyes te zangs zhun khol ma kho na'ang phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen po bzhi las mang ba zhig btung ba yin kyang / da dung 'khor ba'i gnas ris 'di la skyo ba'i blo skad cig kyang mi skye bar zhen cing chags pas bcings pa rnams/ 'khor ba mtha' med du sngar gyi sdug bsngal de las kyang mang bar myong dgos pa yin/ gal srid bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge 'bras phran bu res tshangs pa dang lha'i dbang po lta bu tshe ring zhing gzugs dang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i lus rten thob kyang mthar 'chi ba'i gnas las ma 'das/shi nas kyang ngan song gi sdug bsngal nyam thag pa la spyod pa yin na/lus rten 'dir dbang phyug dang nad med pa la sogs pa'i bde ba cung zad tsam pa ni lo shas dang zla ba zhag 'ga' tsam pas mgo bskor te mtho ris kyi bde 'bras zad nas shin tu dbul zhing nyam thag pa'am ngan song gi sdug bsngal bzod dka' ba la mi 'dod bzhin du spyod dgos pas da lta'i bde skyid mi lam bdo 'phro la sad pa lta bu 'di la snying po ci zhig yod/ 'phral du dge 'bras phran bu res bde zhing skyid pa ltar snang ba rnams kyang 'phen byed kyi las zad nas skad cig ma gcig kyang sdod dbang med pa yin te/ rin po che'i khri la lha'i gos btings pa'i steng na gnas shing 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas dga' mgur rtse ba'i lha'i dbang po rnams kyang che'i tshad rdzogs nas mig 'byed 'dzum tsam gyi yun la dmyal gnas lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi'i steng du mgo thur du bstan nas lhung ste sdug bsngal la spyod pa'ang yod/ gling bzhi 'od kyis snang bar byed pa'i nyi ma dang zla ba gnyis kyang mthar gling par mun pa mun nag gi nang du skyes te rang gi yan 64

lag brkyang bskum tsam yang mi mthong ba'i gnas skabs de lta bu yod pa yin pas/ltar snang 'khor ba'i bde ba la blo gtad mi 'dug des na da res kyi skye ba 'dir 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las thar te gtan du bde ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa zhig ci nas kyang byed dgos snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar nyams su blang ngo / /gnyis pa rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal bye brag tu bsam pa la drug dang po dmyal ba la sde tshan bco brgyad yod pa las/ tsha dmyal brgyad ni/ yang sos nas rim pa bzhin 'og nas 'og tu mnar med pa la ma thug gi bar du khang pa'i thog so bzhin brtsegs nas yod pa yin la/ de dag thams cad kyang gzhi dang khor yug thams cad mgar gyi lcags bsregs lta bu rdog pa bzhag pa tsam gyi bde bar mngon pa yang med par me lce 'bar ba'i klong shin tu dbal tsha ba kho na yin/de las dang po yang sos ni/ lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi'i steng mdag me 'bar ba'i klong du dmyal ba'i sems can kha ba dang bu yug 'tshubs pa lta bu grangs med pa las kyi dbang gis lhan cig tu bsdus te/ de dag kyang 'phen byed zhe sdang gi las kyis 'phangs pas/ de'i byed pa rgyu mthun las/ thams cad kyang dgra mi sha bo mthong ba lta bu phan tshun khong khro'i sems skyes te 'thab pa na/ las kyis sprul pa'i mtshon cha bsam gyis mi khyab pa lag tu lon pas gcig gis gcig la brdegs nas thams cad kyang shi zhing / nam mkha' las yang sos par gyur cig ces pa'i sgra grags ma thag thams cad yang sos te sngar bzhin 'thab 65

pa sogs shi sos res mos byed pas sdug bsngal ba'o/ /tshe tshad ni mi lo lnga bcu re la lha rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i zhag gcig de sum cu la zla ba/ de bcu gnyis la lor brtsis pa'i lha'i lo lnga brgya la dmyal ba yang sos kyi zhag gcig de ltar brtsis pa'i zhag sum cu la zla ba dang / zla ba bcu gnyis la lor byas pa'i rang lo lnga brgya'i bar du sdug bsngal myong ba'o//gnyis pa thig nag ni/ lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi'i steng du gshin rje'i las mkhan rnams kyis dmyal ba'i sems can de'i lus mgal dum ltar bsgrol/ thig nag po bzhi brgyad bcu drug sum cu so gnyis la sogs pa btab pa'i steng du lcags kyi sog le me 'bar bas dra bar byed cing / bcad zin pa rnams de ma thag 'byar ba yang dang yang du gshog cing gcod pa la sdug bsngal lo/ /tshe tshad ni mi lo brgya lha sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i lha'i lo stong phrag gcig dmyal ba thig nag gi zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo stong thub pa'o//gsum pa bsdus 'joms ni/ lcags kyi gtun chen po yul ljongs tsam pa re'i nang du dmyal ba'i sems can grangs med pa blugs nas/ lcags bsregs kyi tho ba ri rab tsam pa re gshin rje'i las mkhan rnams kyis klad la bskor nas brdungs pas thams cad kyang ngu co dir re gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal dang 'jigs skrag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang du shi/ tho ba bteg pa na slar sos te sngar bzhin sdug bsngal myong ba dang / gzhan yang lung pa phan tshun gyi ri thams cad sngar rang gis gang bsad pa'i srog chags/sha ba dang /dgo ba dang /ra lug la sogs pa'i mgo brnyan du gyur pa'i rwa rtse na me 'bar bas rdung kha bkye ba'i 66

bar du dmyal ba'i sems can grangs med pa las dbang gis ded de brgyab pas phan tshun brdungs pa'i tshe thams cad shi slar phye ba'i tshe sos pa yang sngar ltar 'joms pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal mi lo nyis brgya lha 'thab bral gyi zhag gcig tu brtsi zhing / lha'i lo gnyis stong bsdus 'joms kyi zhag gcig byas pa'i rang lo stong phrag gnyis kyi bar du myong ba'o//bzhi pa ngu 'bod ni/ lcags bsregs kyi khang pa sgo med pa'i nang du 'tshed cing sdug bsngal ba/'di nas thar ba'i dus mi 'ong snyam du 'o dod drag po 'bod pa ste/ mi lo bzhi brgya lha dga' ldan gyi zhag gcig dga' ldan gyi lo bzhi stong ngu 'bod kyi zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i rang lo stong phrag bzhi thub pa'o//lnga pa ngu 'bod chen po ni/ gshin rje'i las mkhan mtshon cha thogs pa 'jigs su rung ba mang pos dmyal ba'i sems can grangs med pa ded de lcags kyi khyim me 'bar ba gnyis rim du bcug nas tho ba la sogs pas rdeg cing / sgo phyi nang gnyis ka lcags zhun gyi zhal ba byas pas nang ma las thar kyang phyi ma las mi thar snyam du 'o dod chen po 'bod pa'o/ /tshe tshad ni mi lo brgyad brgya lha 'phrul dga'i zhag gcig byas pa'i lha'i lo brgyad stong ru 'bod chen po'i zhag gcig ste/de lta bu'i lo stong phrag brgyad thub pa'o//drug pa tsha ba ni/ lcags kyi snod chen po stong gsum tsam par khro zu khol ma'i nang du dmyal ba'i sems can grangs med pa 'tshod pas sdug bsngal zhing / steng du thon pa'i res la las mkhan rnams kyis lcags kyus bzung ste/ mgo la tho lum gyis bsnun pas dran pa 'ams pa'i tshe sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba ma zung ba tsam bde 67

bar bsgoms shing shin tu sdug bsngal ba/ mi lo stong phrag gcig dang drug brgya lha gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi zhag gcig lha'i lo khri drug stong tsha ba'i zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo khri phrag gcig dang stong tsho drug thub pa'o/ /bdun pa rab tu tsha ba ni/ lcags kyi khyim me 'bar ba'i nang du las mkhan rnams kyis lcags kyi gsal shing rtse gsum pa me 'bar bas rkang mthil gnyis dang 'og sgo nas 'dzugs shing phrag pa gnyis dang spyi bo nas thal mar 'byin/lcags bsregs kyi snam bus lus kyi phyi nas dkris pas shin tu sdug bsngal ba'o//tshe tshad ni bar gyi bskal pa phyed thub pa ste/ mi lo'i grangs kyis gzhal ba'i yul las 'das pa'o//brgyad pa mnar med pa ni/ lcags khyem me 'bar ba nye 'khor lhag pa bcu drug gis bskor ba'i nang du gshin rje'i las mkhan rnams kyis lcags bsregs kyi dum bu sol ba lta bu ri tsam du spungs pa'i dbus su dmyal ba'i sems can grangs med pa bcug nas/ stag gzig gi spud pa bus pas me dang lus gnyis med du sreg sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba shin tu rags shing 'o dod 'bod pa'i sgra tsam las lus dngos ltar mi mngon/ thar bar 'dod pa'i blo rgyun chad med pa skye yang thar pa'i dus ni med/skabs rer me sgo cung zad re phye bas bros par rlom pa na/las mkhan rnams kyis mda' bo che dang / dbyug pa dang / tho ba la sogs pas bsnun cing / khro chu khol ma khar ldugs pa sogs dmyal ba snga ma bdun po'i sdug bsngal kyang tshang bar myong dgos/ tshe tshad bar gyi bskal pa gcig thub pa ste/ de las lhag pa mnar rgyu med pas mnar med ces bya/ 'di ni mtshams med pa'i 68

las byas pa'i sems can dang /sngags su zhugs nas rdo rje slob dpon la log lta skyes pa sogs skye ba'i gnas yin te/ las gzhan gyis 'dir skye mi nus/ de'i 'khor nye 'khor ba ni/mnar med kyi phyogs bzhi so so na/me ma mur gyi 'obs/ ro myags kyi 'dam/ mtshon cha'i thang / ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal bzhi po/ shar na bzhi/lho na bzhi/ nub na bzhi/byang na bzhi dang bcu drug shar lho mtshams na lcags kyi shal ma ri'i sdong po gcig de bzhin lho nub/ nub byang / byang shar rnams na'ang re re dang bcas pa yod pa las/ /dang po me ma mur gyi 'obs ni/dmyal ba mnar med kyi las srab pa dag phyir thon pa'i tshe rgyang ring po nas grib ma nag ngam me ba'i 'obs mthong nas dga' ste phyin pas/ shal tshan gyi mdag me rab tu 'bar ba'i 'obs su tshud de sha rus tshig cing sdug bsngal ba'o//gnyis pa ro myags kyi 'dam ni/ de bzhin du rgyang ring po na chu klung mthong ste/sngar bskal pa chen po zhig 'jig gi bar du me dpung du btsos pas skom tshad kyis zu mthong ba la dga' ste 'thung du phyin pas de na chu zhig ci la yod/mi ro rta ro khye ro la sogs ro rul ba shin tu dri nga ba 'bus g.yeng ba 'ba' zhig gi 'dam du tshud de spyi bo'i bar du nub/ srin bu lcags kyi mchu rnon can rnams kyis za bas sdug bsngal ba'o//gsum pa spu gri'i thang ni/ yang de nas thar te phyin pas thang sngon po nyams dga' ba zhig mthong ba la phyin pas mtshon cha'i thang dang thug sa gzhi thams cad lcags bsregs kyi thur ma rnon po rtsa ltar skyes pa'i steng du rkang pa g.yas bzhag na g.yas phug g.yon bzhag na g.yon phug pa bteg pa'i tshe sos shing / 69

bzhag na sngar ltar gcod pas sdug bsngal ba'o//bzhi pa ral gri'i tshal ni/ yang de las thar te nags tshal nyams dga' ba mthong ba la dga' nas rgyug pas der nags tshal nyams dga' ba ci la yod/ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal dang 'phrad de/ lcags kyi sdong po ral gri mang po lo ma ltar skyes pa rlung gis bskyod pas lus dum bu dum bur gcod cing yang sngar ltar 'byar nas gcod pa'i sdug bsngal spyong ba'o/ /lcags kyi shal ma ri ni/ btsun 'chal sdom nyams tshangs spyod nyams pa rnams dang 'dod log spyod pa rnams skye ba'i gnas yin te/ las kyi dbang gis lcags kyi shal ma ri 'jigs su rung ba'i drung du sbebs pa na/ ri rtse na sngar rang la dga' gdung yod pa'i grogs des 'bod par mthong nas phyin pas lcags kyi sdong po skyes pa'i lo ma thams cad thur du bstan pas 'jigs shing / ri rtser sleb tshe ga dang bya rgod la sogs pas mig tshil 'bru/ yang ri'i rtsa ba na 'bod par mthong nas sngar bzhin phyin pa dang / lo ma thams cad gyen du bstan pas brang gzhung nas rgyab gzhung du thal mar 'bigs shing / ri'i rtsa bar phyin pas lcags kyi skyes pa dang / bud med 'jigs su rung bas 'khyud nas mgo bo khar bcug ste bldad pas 'gram khug gnyis nas klad pa skya cir gyis 'ong ba sogs kyis sdug bsngal ba'o//de ltar tsha ba'i dmyal ba brgyad/ 'khor lhag pa bcu drugalcags kyi shal ma li la sogs pa de dag gi sdug bsngal rang gis legs par dpyad nas/dben par song ste mig btsum zhing rang nyid dmyal ba'i gnas der mngon sum du skyes par bsgom/ 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal gyi snang ba mngon 70

sum lta bur skyes pa na/ ga re nga da res der skyes pa min kyang de'i sdug bsngal sems thog tu blangs pa tsam la yang 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal de tsam 'dugad lta der skyes pa'i sems can grangs kyis mi chod pa yod/ de thams cad kyang rang gi skye ba sngon ma'i pha ma sha stag yin/ skye ba 'di'i pha ma dang nye du mdza' bshes sogs du ma shi ba de dag kyang der skyes med pa'i nges pa med/ gnas ris de dag tu skye ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo ni zhe sdang gi las yin/ rang res kyang tshe rabs 'di dang gzhan du nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi las bsags pa la grangs kyis mi chod pa yod pas skye ba gzhan du dmyal ba'i gnas de dag tu skye nges/des na da res rang gis dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob/mtshan ldan gyi bla ma mjal/zab mo'i gdams ngag nyan/sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub tu yod pa'i dus 'dir/phyin chad ngan song gi gnas de dag tu gtan nas mi skye ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos snyam du yang yang bsam/ sngar byas kyi las ngan pa rnams la 'gyod pa drag pos bshags pa dang / phyin chad dmyal ba de dag tu skye ba'i las srog la babs kyang bsags re shi snyam pa'i dam bca' drag po bya/ da lta der skyes pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje drag po bsgom/ de dag thams cad da lta nyid du ngan song gi gnas ris las thar bar gyur cig snyam du smon lam gdab pa sogs sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar nyams su blang ngo //gnyis pa grangs dmyal brgyad ni/ spyi mthun du gzhi dang khor yug thams cad gangs ri dang chab rom gyi khrod/ bu yug 'ba' zhig gis bsgribs pa'i gnas su gcer bu grang pa'i sdug bsngal gyis nyams phas lus la chu bur thol 71

thol rdol ba ni/ zu bur can/zu bur de dag rdol nas rmar song ba chu bur rdol ba/grang ba'i zug rngu bsran mi bzod par so 'tshir bas so tham tham pa/ smre sngags rgyun mi chad pa 'don pas sa chu chu/skad kyi gdangs chag pas shugs ring kyi hud du 'don ba kyi hud 'don pa/ phyi'i lpags mdog sngon por song ste bzhi chal du gas pa utpal ltar gas pa/ nang gi sha dmar por mngon pa yang grang bas 'khyag nas brgyad tshal du gas pa padma ltar gas pa/ de las kyang dmar nag tu gyur te bcu drug dang / so gnyis grangs med par gas pa padma chen po ltar gas pa/ de ltar gas pa'i rma nang du srin bu lcags kyi mchu can mang po zhugs nas za zhing grang ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba las/ sdug bsngal mi 'dra ba brgyad la ming brgyad du chags pa grang ba'i dmyal ba brgyad ces bya/ de dag gi tshe tshad ni/grong khyer ko sa la'i bres gzhal ba'i bcu tshad nyi shu shong ba'i gzhong pa til gyis gang ba las chu bur can gyi lo brgya re na til re re phyungs pas til thams cad zad pa na chu bur can gyi tshe tshad rdzogs pa yin la/ lhag ma rnams de las rim par nyi shu re'i 'gyur gyis tshe je ring sdug bsngal je che yin te/ chu bur can gyi tshe tshad tsam pa nyi shu chu bur brdol bas thub/ de'i tshe tshad tsam pa nyi shu so tham pas thub pa sogs 'gre bar bya'o/ /de dag gi sdug bsngal yang sngar ltar rang rgyud la blangs nas bsgom zhing / da lta mi yul 'dir dgun gyi dus su gcer bur skad cig tsam sdod pa'i grang lhag gi sdug bsngal yang bzod mi nus na/ der skyes na ji ltar bzod snyam du rang rgyud kyi nyes pa la bshags sdom dang / gnas der skyes pa'i sems can la snying rje sgom pa sogs sngar ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas 72

nyams su blang ngo //nyi tshe ba ni/ gnas kyang nges med sdug bsngal yang nges med yin te/ brag gi bar du bcar ba dang / rdo yi nang du 'thum pa dang / chab rom gyi nang du rengs pa dang / zu tshan gyi nang du 'tshod pa dang / me nang du sreg pa dang / shing sdong la bcad gtub byas pas/ rang nyid kyi yan lag dang nyi lag bcad par nyer len byas te sdug bsngal ba dang / gtun dang / phyags ma dang / phru ba dang /sgo dang / ka ba dang /sgyed pu dang / thag pa la sogs pa rtag tu bkol zhing spyod pa'i gzugs su 'du shes pas sdug bsngal de dag myong pa ste/dper na 'gro mgon gling rje ras pas yar 'brog mtsho nang na nya gzigs pa dang / grub thob thang stong rgyal pos rdo nang na sbal pa gzigs pa sogs yin/ de yang yar 'brog g.yu mtsho sngon mo der/ sngon mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal sgrub pa la bzhugs skabs bon pos gser ba'i zho gang 'phangs pa mtshor bsgyur ba yin te/ grags pa'i mtsho chen bzhi'i gcig yin/ mtsho mgo der lung gangs chen dang / mtsho zhug zas ma rgu ru la zug nas nyin lam mang po'i bar du yod pa la/ grub chen gling rje ras pas mtsho nang der gzigs nas bshum/ sa kha kha dkor ma za dkor ma za zhes gsungs/ de ci lags zhus pas/ mtsho nang 'dir bla ma dkor zan zhig gi rnam shes/nyi tshe ba'i dmyal bar skyes te sdug bsngal mang po myong gin 'dug gsungs/de ston par zhus pas rdzu 'phrul gyis mtsho de skad cig la bskam tsa na/ nya chen po zhig gi lus kyis mtsho des gar sleb pa la srog chags grangs med pas go mtshams med par gtams te zos pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pas 'gre ldog ldog 73

byed kyin 'dug 'di lta bu'i las ngan pa su zhig gi skye ba lags zhus pas/ 'di gtsang bla rta nag can gyi skye ba yin gsungs/ gtsang bla rta nag can bya ba de/ ngag nus dang byen rlabs shin tu che zhing /'dre gdon gyis nyen pa rnams la lta stangs byas pa tsam gyis phan pa sogs byung bas dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i mchod gnas su gyur te/ gshin po'i 'bul ba byas pa sogs la phaṭa shar re sprags nas rta zog mang po blang 'gro ba zhig yod pa de yin/ grub thob thang stong rgyal pos rdo pha bong chen po zhig gi steng du rtsa rlung gi 'khrul 'khor mdzad pas/ rdo de phyed tshal du gas pa'i nang na sbal ba chen po zhig lus la srogs chags chung ngu grangs med pa 'byar nas zos pas sdug bsngal mi bzod par kha nag deng deng 'dug pa 'di ci lags zhus pas/ 'di dmar chog byed pa'i bla ma gcig gi skye ba yin gsungs/da lta bla ma rnam pa tsho yang / yon bdag gi bsha' lug tsho ba dang rgyags pa re bshas nas mid pa dang tsher pa sogs sha khrag gis g.yos/ tshang 'brong gi rtsibs sha 'dar cum me ba'i steng du bzhag nas drangs tsa na/ mnabs gzan de dbu la 'then nas/ nang cha rnams byes pas nu ma nu nu mdzad/ phyag shan de kha zhig blangs nas phyi sha rnams dal bus gsol/ bzhes pa zin tsa na zhal snum chil le/dbu rlangs pa phal le/ sngar gyi de ma yin pa'i rgya dmar cig ge ba zhig byas nas dbu bteg 'ong bar 'dug ste/ tshe 'dir gsol gsol ba'i bu lon phyi ma sku lus kyi steng nas 'jal dgos byung tsa na/nyi tshe ba'i dmyal gnas su 'o brgyal chen po yod par 'dug de bzhin du ngor mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong sde dge na bzhugs skabs/ nyin gcig de ring rngul mda'i chu nang 'dir gang byung yang 74

gtong mi nyan zhes grwa pa mang po sgug tu bcug phyi dro tsam na shing sdong dum chen po zhig chus khyer byung ba de blangs nas de las gzhan gang yang ma byung zhus pas de yin/sdong dum de gshogs dang gsungs / sdong dum gshags pa'i nang na sbal ba chen po zhig srog chags mang pos za gyin 'dug pa de la khrus chog sogs mdzad/ sde dge'i gnyer pa bo rgyas bya ba zhig gi skye ba yin gsungs/ des na mi dpon khe drag sde za ba rnams kyang da lta dbang che yang dmyal gnas 'di dag la bsams nas stabs gzab byed dgos par 'dug /de bzhin du sngon bcom ldan 'das bzhugs skabs gnas pa'i grong gi shan pa zhig gis mtshan mo srog mi gcod pa'i khrims blangs pa nyi tshe ba'i dmyal bar skyes te/ mtshan mo khang bzang nyams dga' ba'i nang du bud med mdzes ma bzhis bza' btung dang longs spyod kyis mchod cing shin tu skyid pa la/ nyin mo khang pa yang lcags bsregs kyi khang par gnas 'gyur/ bud med bzhi khyi sre bo 'jigs su rung bar gyur nas za bar byed pa dang / yang byi pho byed pas nyin mo byi bo mi byed pa'i sdom pa blangs pas nyin mtshan gyi skyid sdug sngar gyi de las ldog par spyong ba gro bzhin skyes rna ba bye ba ris gzigs pa dang / gtsug lag khang yid du 'ong bar dge slong lnga brgya tsam gnas pa nyin gung tsam la gaṇḍi brdungs nas gdugs tshod la 'dus tshe gtsug lag khang lcags bsregs kyi khang pa dang / lhung bzed dang phor pa sogs mtshon char gnas gyur nas deg res 'ba' zhig byed gdugs tshod yol ba'i tshod la sngar bzhin bgyis te gnas pa/sngon 'od srung gi dus su dge slong mang po gung tshigs kyi skabs tshig gi rtsod pa byas pa'i rnam smin yin par bshad pa la 76

sogs pa rnams yin no/ /de ltar tsha dmyal brgyad/ grang dmyal brgyad dang bcu drug nyi tshe nye 'khor gnyis dang bco brgyad po la/ dmyal khams bco brgyad ces bya ste/ de dag gi grangs dang tshe tshad sdug bsngal/ der skye ba'i rgyu la sogs pa zhib tu shes par byas nas/ der skye ba'i sems can la snying rje bsgom/ rang gzhan thams cad phyin chad der mi skye ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos pa yin/ de ltar ma yin pa go lo dang thos lor bzhag nas nyams su ma blangs na/ slar chos dred nga rgyal gyi rgyur 'gro/ dam pas smod cing mkhas pas khrel pa'i gnas su 'gyur te/sngon bla ma zhang rin po che'i drung du/ dge slong spyod lam mdzes pa nga rgyal che ba zhis/ mjal du byung ba la/dge slong khyod kyis chos ci shes gsungs pas/chos mang po thos pa yin zer/ 'o na dmyal khams bcod brgyad bya ba de gang yin gsungs pas/ tsha dmyal brgyad/ grang dmyal brgyad dang bcu drug karma pa zhwa dmar nag gnyis/ dang bco brgyad yin zer skad/ khong karma pa la mi gus pas dmyal ba'i grangs su brtsis pa ma yin kyang /nyi tshe dang nyen 'khor gnyis ka'i ming ni brjed/karma pa zhwa dmar nag gnyis ni de dus grags chen po yod pas bab col du bgrang bar 'dug de lta bur gyur na chos zhus nas nyams su len pa lta ci/ tshig tsam yang mi shes pa ni ngo tsha ba'i gnas yin no//ngan song gi gnas gnyis pa/ yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ spyir yi dwags la bying na gnas pa dang / mkha' la rgyu ba'i yi dwags gnyis yod/ dang po la'ang phyi'i sgrib pa can/ nang gi sgrib pa can/ sgos khur gyi sgrib pa can la sogs pa yod pa las/ phyi'i sgrib pa can ni/ lo grangs brgya phrag mang po'i bar du chu'i 76

ming tsam yang thos ma phyong bas shin tu bkres shing skom pas gdungs/ dus rtag tu bza' btung zhig don du gnyer nas 'gro yang cung zad kyang mi rnyed/ res 'ga' rgyang ring po na chu klung sngon po re 'bab pa mthong nas/ yan lag gi lhu tshigs 'khrol zhing lto ba mi theg par sdug bsngal bzhin thang chad chad du phyin pas drung du sleb tshe chu thams cad skam nas/ gram pa tsam lus nas shin tu sdug bsngal ba dang / yang rgyang ring po nas ljon shing thog gu can mthong bas sngar bzhin song ste drung du slebs pa na skam nas khra ma'i sdong po chen por 'gyur ba dang / yang bza' btung longs spyod bzang po mang po mthong yang / drung du phyin pa'i tshe skyes bu go mtshon dang ldan pa mang pos srung bas ded nas mtshon chas rdeg cing sdug bsngal ba dang /dbyar gyi dus su ni zla ba yang tsha zhing sreg pa dang /dgun ni nyi ma yang shin tu grang zhing bsil bas lhag par gdung ba sogs te/sngon gro bzhin skyes yi dwags kyi yul du byon pas/ yi dwags kyi ser sna'i dug gi tshad pas phog ste khong zhal shin tu skom nas lcags kyi mkhar chen po zhig gi sgo na skyes bu mdog nag la mig dmar ba 'jigs su rung ba zhig 'dug pa la/chu gar yod ces dris pas/ yi dwags sdong dum mes tshig pa 'dra ba mang po 'dus nas skyes bu chen po phun sum tshogs pas chu sprul zer/ khong gis ngas kyang chu ma rnyed pa yin chu sprul byas pas/ khyed ci zer nged rnams lung ba 'dir skyes nas lo grangs bzu gnyis yin kyang / zu'i ming tsam yang da res las thos ma myong zer ba lta bu'o//nang gi sgrib pa can ni/ kha khab kyi mig tsam pas rgya mtsho chen po'i chu btung 77

yang mgrin pa rta rnga tsam pa'i nang du ma tshud pa'i bar la kha'i dug gis skam pa dang / cung zad re mgrin par tshud kyang lto ba yul ljongs tsam yod pa mi khengs pa dang / lto bde tsam re lto bar song na mtshan mo'i ring de la me 'bar nas glo snyeng nang khrol thams cad bsregs bas sdug bsngal ba dang / 'gro bar 'dod pa'i tshe lto ba yul ljongs tsam pa yan lag 'jag skya tsam gyis mi theg par shin tu sdug bsngal ba'o/ /sgos khur gyi sgrib pa can ni/ yi dwags re re'i lus la mang po'i tshang bcas nas za ba byed pa la sogs pa yin la/ de las gzhan yang skyid sdug gi rnam grangs ma nges pa'ang du ma yod de/ sngon gro bzhin skyes rna ba bye ba ri yi dwags kyi yul du byon skabs gzhal med khang zhig na bud med gzugs bzang ba/mdzes pa/lta na sdug pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa zhig gi khri'i rkang pa bzhi la yi dwags bzhi btags shing 'dug des gro bzhin skyes la zan byin nas yi dwags 'di rnams khyed la zan slong na cung zad kyang ma sbyin cig zer/ gro bzhin skyes kyis zan za ba'i tshe yi dwags slong ba las/ gcig la byin pas phub mar gyur/ yang gcig la byin pas lcags kyi tho lum za bar gyur/ de bzhin du gcig la rang gi sha dang / gcig la rnag khrag tu grur bas/bud med de 'ongs nas khyod la kho mos ma sbyin ma smras sam/ kho mo'i snying rje las khyed kyi snying rje lhag gam zer ba la/'di dag khyod dang ci nye byas bas/ 'di ni kho mo'i khyim thabs yin/ 'di ni bu yin/ 'di ni mna' ma yin/ 'di ni bran mo yin zer/ khyed cag las gang gis 'dir skyes byas pas/ 'dzam bu gling gi mi rnams ni yid ches par dka' ba yin 78

pas yid mi ches so zer/ kho bos mngon sum du mthong na ji ltar yid mi ches byas pas/ de na re kho mo gnas pa'i grong gi bram ze mo yin te/ rgyu skar la babs pa'i nub mo zas bzang po dag sta gon byas pa la/ 'phags pa ka ta yā na chen po bsod snyoms la byon par kho mo dad pa skyes nas bsod stoms phul te/ khyem thabs rjes su yid rang ba 'bul du bcug na dga' bar 'ong snyam nas/ rje'i sras 'phags pa ka ta yā na chen po la bsod snyoms phul bas rjes su yi rang ba phul cig byas pas/ de khros nas ji srid zam ze rnams la ma phul/ gnyen bshes rnams kyi sri zhu ma bgyis par/ khyod kyis dge sbyong mgo reg de la bsod snyoms kyi phud sbyin nam/ mgo reg de phub ma ci phyir mi 'gam zer/ de bzhin du bu la byas pas de yang khros te/mgo reg de ci phyir lcags kyi tho lum mi za zer/de'i nub mo kho mo'i gnyen dag gis kho mo la za ma bzang po rnams bskur ba mna' mas mo rang gis zos nas/ ngan pa rnams nga la byin/ ngas za ma bzang po rnams zos nas ngan pa rnams nga la ma byen nam dris pas/ des ngas khyod kyi zas za ba las rang gi sha ci phyir mi za zhes rdzun smra zhing / de bzhin du kho mo'i gnyen rnams la zas bskur ba sngar bzhin bran mos zos nas/ ngas khyod kyi za ma rku ba las rnag khrag dag ci phyir mi 'thung zhes smra ba rnams la/ bdag gis sems can 'di dag rang rang gi las kyi 'bras bu nyams su spyong ba der skye zhing lta bar gyur cig snyam pas/ yi dwags mthu mo cher skyes/ de min na 'phags par bsod snyoms phul bas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skye ba yod pa yin/ khyed yang gnas pa'i grong du 'gro na bdag gi bu mo smad 'tshong byed pa de la/ khyod kyi pha ma sogs ngas mthong bas de 79

dag na re/ las 'di'i 'bras bu ni yid du mi 'ong ba yin gyis dam pa ma yin pa'i chos/ sdig pa de spongs shig zer ro/ /zhes gsungs shig de yid mi ches na khyod kyi sngon gyi pha'i khang pa na lcags zangs gser gyis gang ba bzhi dang /gser gyi 'khar ba dang / ril ba spyi blugs yod kyi/ de dag phyung la dus dus su 'phags pa ka sgyu na chen po la bsod snyoms phul nas bdag cag gi ming nas phyung ste yon bsngo ba byos shig dang /des las de srab pa dang / yongs su zad par 'gyur ro/ /zhes zer ro//de bzhin du slob dpon dze tā ri ljongs rgyur byon pas/ yi dwags mo gzugs mi sdug pa phru gu lnga brgya'i sa mar gyur pa zhig gis slob dpon la/ nga'i khyo bo rdo rje gdan du zas 'tshol ba la song nas lo bcu gnyis yin kyang ma byung /khyed der byon na khyod myur du ma 'ongs na phru gu rnams bgres nas 'chi'o gsungs shig zer/ khyod kyi khyo pho de ji zhig lta bu yod/ yi dwags thams cad 'dra bar 'dug pas ngas shes sam gsungs pas/ nor mi dgos te/ kha che ba sna nyag pa mig zhar ba gzugs mi sdug pa'i mtshan ma dgus brgyan pa zhig yod zer/khong rdo rje gdan du byon pas/ dge tshul zhig gis gtor chu dang gtor zan mang po zhig dor nas song ba la/ yi dwags mang pos rub brgyab pa'i khrod na kho rang 'dug chung ma'i 'phrin bskur rnams bskyal bas/ ngas lo bcu gnyis su nyul yang / skor gcig dge slong yang dag pa cig gis snabs lud zhig dor ba la nged yi dwags mang po'i rub brgyab bas cung zad rnyed pa las gang yang ma rnyed pa la zer/ kho rang snabs lud rtsod sa nas yi dwags gzhan gyis lus la rma mang po gtod 'dug gsungs/ de bzhin du yi dwags kyi gnas ris gang du skyes kyang 80

bkres skom gtso bor grur pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gdungs pa'i tshul sems thog tu blang / da lta rang res snga dro tsam za ma ma zos kyang / sdug bsngal sbu 'dra zhig 'dug lo grangs mang po'i bar du zu yi ming tsam yang mi thos pa'i gnas su skyes na ji ltar byed/ der skye ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo ni ser sna dang / 'jug gegs yin pas bdag gis kyang de lta bu'i las bsags pa grangs kyis mi chod/nga ni de lta bu'i gnas ris su ci nas kyang mi skye ba zhig byed dgos snyam pa sogs snying thag pa nas sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang par bsgom mo//gnyis pa mkha' la rgyu ba ni/btsan dang rgyal po shi 'dre 'byung po/ma mo the'u rang la sogs pa rnams te/ de dag kyang dus rtag tu 'jigs skrag dang 'khrul snang 'ba' zhig la spyod/ rtag tu bsam ba ngan pa la gnas pas gzhan la gnod pa'i las kho na la brtson cing shi ma thag dmyal ba sogs ngan song gi gting du 'gro ba mang / khyad par zhag bdun phrag re'i mtshams su sngar rang nyid nad dang mtshon dang 'gags la sogs pa gang gis shi ba'i sdug bsngal de nyid spyong nas/de gzhan la spo bar 'dod pas gang du phyin pa der yang gnod cing rang la mi phan/ sngon gyi mdza' bshes dang nye du la sogs pa'i drung du dga' bas byen kyang de dag la nad dang spyo 'bogs la sogs mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal 'byung /sngags pa nus pa can gyis mnan bsregs 'phangs gsum byas pas/ sa 'og mun pa'i gnas su bskal pa'i bar du mnan pa dang /sbyin sreg gi me la sreg pa dang /yungs thun dang rdo phye sogs kyis brabs pa brgyab pa na mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing lus dum bu stong du 'gro ba sogs rtag tu sdug bsngal ba kho na las ma 81

'das/ dgun nyi ma grang zhing dbyar zla ba 'ang tsha ba sogs log pa'i snang ba rnams kyang yi dwags spyi dang mthun par 'char/ kha cig bya dang khyi la sogs pa'i gzugs su yod pas gzugs byad yid du mi 'ong ba sogs sdug bsngal gyi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa la spyod pa yin pas de dag gi sdug bsngal kyang rang thog tu blangs te/ der skye ba'i sems can la byams pa dang snying rje bsgom pa sogs spyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar nyams su blang ngo //ngan song gi gnas gsum pa dud 'gro la'ang bying na gnas pa dang kha 'thor ba gnyis las/ dang po ni mtha'i rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na nya dang / chu srin dang / dung dang / sbal ba dang / 'bu srin la sogs pa chang 'gag gi sbang ma bzhin lcig lcig yod pa la sbrul dang chu srin la sogs pa che ba ri rab la lan mang po'i bar dkris pa dang / chung ba rdul phran dang khab rtse lta bu'i bar du yod cing / che ches chung zung rnams khyur mid byed/ chung chung gis chen po rnams thal mar 'bigs shing za/ srog chags che ba re re'i lus la chung ba du mas tshang bcas nas zas su byed pa dang / gling bar nyi ma mi 'char ba'i gnas su skyes pas rang gis yan lag dang nying lag brkyang bskum byed pa tsam yang mi mthong bar shin tu sdug bsngal/ blun zhing gti mug pas spang blang gi gnas thams cad la rbongs te sdug bsngal mu mtha' med pa'i gnas su skye ba yin/ kha 'thor ba'i dud 'gro lha dang mi yi yul na yod pa rnams kyang blun rbongs dang bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal kho na la spyod/ khyad par mi yul gyi dud 'gro mis bdag tu ma bzung ba'i ri dwags la sogs pa rnams ni 'jigs skrag gi snang ba kho na la spyod/ zas 82

kham gang za yang bag mi pheb bzhin du za/ gcig gis gcig la za zhing /rngon pa dang gcan gzan la sogs gsod pa po grangs mang / khras bye'u dang bye'u sa 'bu gsod pas mtshon/gcig gis gcig gsod pa'i las ngan pa kho na rtag tu gsogarngon pa la sogs pa rnams ni sems can de dag mnar zhing gsod pa'i las thabs la mkhas pas/rgya dang rnyi dang gog tshe dang me mda' la sogs gnod pa du mas 'phral du srog la rgol/ kha cig rang gi lus la skyes pa'i rwa dang spu dang pags pa la sogs pa'i ched du gsod de/ mu tig gi ched du nya phyis gsod pa dang / mche ba dang rus pa la sogs pa'i ched du glang po gsod pa dang / pags pa'i ched du stag gzig dang / sram dang wa sogs gsod pa dang gla rtsi'i ched du gla ba dang / sha dang khrag gi ched du rkyang 'brong la sogs pa gsod pa sogs rang gi lus nyid kyang rang nyid gsod pa'i rgyur skyes pas shin tu sdug bsngal/ mi la brten pa'i dud 'gro rnams ni blun zhing gti mug pas gsod pa'i gshed mas ral gri thogs te drung du sleb kyang mig sngo ce re lta ba las bros pa tsam yang mi shes/ de bzhin du zho bzho ba dang / khal 'gel ba dang / bya gcod pa dang / sna 'bigs pa dang / rbos rbo ba sogs bkol spyod kyi rnam grangs 'di ma myong snyam pa gcig kyang med/ rta khal sogs rgyab thams cad rmar song yang da dung yang khal 'gel ba dang / zhon nas 'gro ba sogs byed/ 'gro ma nus tsa na lcag gis brab cing rdos rdeg de rnams la dka' tshegs dang na tsha yod snyam pa ni mi byed/gnag phyugs dang lug rnams ni rgas nas 'chi ba la ma thug gi bar du bed bcad/ rgas tsa na rang gis gsod pa'am gzhan la 'tshong pa gang yin gyi sgo nas 83

thams cad kyang bshas su phab nas rang bzhin gyis 'chi ba ni gcig kyang med/de lta bu'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa la spyod pa yin pas/ de ltar sdug bsngal ba'i sems can mthong tsa na de rang nyid yin pa'i blo bzhag nas sdug bsngal ci tsam 'dug la sogs pa zhib tu bsams nas/ dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes pa spyi la snying rje drag po bsgom zhing khyad par rang la bsten pa'i dud 'gro sogs yod na byams brtses spyong ba dang / tha na 'bu sbrang dang srog chags phra mo tshun chad la'ang bde sdug gi tshor ba med pa ni gcig kyang med la/ de thams cad kyang rang gi pha ma ma byas pa'ang med pas thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje bsgom pa sogs spyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar nyams su blang ngo //de ltar ngan song gi gnas gsum po ni/ gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rnam grangs dos drag la rgyun ring / blun zhing gti mug la chos kyi snang ba med pas slar yang ngan song gi rgyu sgrub pa kho na las med/ de dag tu skyes na phyi nas thar ba dka' zhing / rang rgyud la ngan song de dag tu skye nges pa'i las tshe rabs 'di dang gzhan du byas pa du ma yod pa yin pas/ sngar byas kyi las la 'gyod pa phyin chad kyi bshags sdom sogs la snying thag pa nas 'bad/ der skyes pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje drag po bsgom/ rang gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge 'bras thams cad ngan song de dag tu skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi ched du bsngo ba bya/ gnas ngan de dag las thar pa'i smon lam gdab/ bdag gis da res theg pa chen po'i chos dang mjal nas/ rang gzhan gyi don gnyis 'grub pa'i lam sgrub tu yod pa yin pas chos phyir dka' ba spyad cing brtson pas 84

nyams su blangs te/ ngan song gi sems can de dag thams cad dag pa'i zhing du drangs par bya'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed/ de ltar byed nus par bla ma dang dkon mchog gis byen gyis rlobs shig snyam du lha dang bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa dang / ram zlar spran pa sogs bya/ de ltar byas pa'i dge ba'ang sems can gyi don du bsngo ba sogs dam pa gsum gyis zin pa nyams su blang ngo / /de ltar na ngan song gsum du skyes na sdug bsngal kyi rang bzhin yin kyang mtho ris rnam gsum ni bde zhing skyid pa yin nam snyam na/ mtho ris na'ang bde ba med de/dang po mi'i sdug bsngal ni/ mi rnams la rtsa ba'i sdug bsngal chen po gsum/ skye rga na 'chi'am sdug bsngal gyi chu bo chen po bzhi/ dgra sdang ba dang phrad kyi dogs pa'i sdug bsngal/ gnyen byams pa dang bral gyi dogs pa'i sdug bsngal/ mi 'dod pa thog tu 'bab pa'i sdug bsngal/ 'dod pa thog tu mi khel ba'i sdug bsngal rnams yod pa las/ rtsa ba'i sdug bsngal gsum gyi dang po 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ da lta skad cig mar bde bar yod 'phro la sdug bsngal du 'gyur ba ste/ lus la phan pa'i zas zos nas ngoms shing 'grangs te skyid par yod pa la srin pho bar langs nas/ glang thabs kyi nad drag po glo bur du byung ste sdug bsngal ba dang / da ltar skyid pa yod 'phro la/nor phyugs dgras ded pa dang /khang gzhi mes tshig pa/nad gdon drag po glo bur du byung ba/ phyi rol gyi gtam ngan thos pa sogs 'phral du sdug bsngal bar gyur pa rnams te/ spyir 'khor ba'i gnas ris 'dis bde skyid snyan gsum ltar snang ba/ gang la yang rtag pa dang brtan pa spu tsam yang med cing mthar sdug bsngal ba kho na las 'das pa yin pas skyo ba bskyed do// 85

gnyis pa sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal ni/ sdug bsngal snga ma sangs bzhin du phyi mas non pa mdze thog tu phol byung ba/ phol thog tu rma gtugs pa/ pha shi ba'i steng du ma shi ba/ dgras ded pa'i steng du mi gces pa shi ba lta bu ste/ 'khor ba'i gnas 'di gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi steng du sdug bsngal brtsegs pa kho nas dus 'da' ba las bde ba'i go skabs skad cig ma tsam yang med pa yin no//gsum pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni/ da lta rang res bde bar rlom pa rnams kyang dngos su sdug bsngal ltar mi mngon kyang don du sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kho na las ma 'das te/ zas zos pa gos gyon pa gnas khang dang longs spyod rgyan dang ston mo la sogs pa thams cad kyang sdig pa'i rgyus sgrub pa/ bya byed thams cad kyang sdig pa'i g.yo bkol 'ba' zhig las mi 'dug pas/ 'di thams cad kyi 'bras bu ni sdug bsngal ba kho na yin/ dper na ja dang rtsam pa lta bu la mtshon na/ ja ni rgya yul du btab pa'i ldum bu yin te/ de'i sa bon 'debs pa dang / lo ma 'breg pa sogs kyi dus srog chags bsad pa yang grangs kyis mi chod/ dar rtse mdo man chad nas mi yi khur brda byas 'ongs skabs mi re re kyang khag drug cu gnyis re khur nas 'ong / de thams cad kyang mgo la brten nas khur bas dpral ba'i pags pa zad de rus pa skya seng nge mthong kyang da dung yang khur/ mdo thog yan chad du mdzo g.yag dre'u sogs la bkal nas 'ongs skabs/ de thams cad kyang rgyab chad glo bug spu byi bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa gtad/ ja de nyo tshong gi dus kyang mna' dang khrel la mi brtsi g.yo sgyu dang rtsod pa 86

kho nas tshong byas/ tshong zong yang phal cher lug gi bal dang tsha ru sogs la byas/bal de yang dbyar kha'i dus lug shig dang zho skyes sogs srog chags dang spu nyag mang nyung med pa yod pa la/ de dag las phar cher ni gris breg pa'i dus mgo bcad sked pa sdum/ nang cha phyung ste bsad/ ma shi ba rnams kyang bal dang lhan du gcus dbugs 'thum la ngan song kho na byas pa yin/ tsha ru yang lu gu 'phral du skyes pa de dbang po thams cad rdzogs/ bde sdug gi tshor pa dar ldan/lus kyang nyams brtas/ gson pa'i dang po skyid par yod pa'i dus su 'phral du bsad pa yin/ rbongs pa dud 'gro yin kyang 'chi ba la ni 'tsher/ gson pa la ni dga'/gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal ni myong /phru gu bsad pa'i ma rnams kyang sdug bsngal ni bu gcig po shi ba'i ma ji ltar mthong chos su gyur pa de yin/ de lta bu'i rgyu rtsas nyos pa sogs la bsam na kham gcig tsam btung yang ngan song gi rgyu byed pa las mi 'dug rtsam pa yang /dang po zhing la slog brgyab pa'i gnas skabs/sa 'og gi 'bu thams cad sa steng du phyung / sa steng gi 'bu thams cad sa 'og tu mnan/ rmos glang gar song gi rjes su bya rog dang bye'u sogs kha dal khoms med par 'bu rgam gyin 'gro ba de yin/ de bzhin du zhing la chu 'dren skabs/ rlan la gnas pa'i srog chags thams cad skam la bkram/skam la gnas pa'i srog chags thams cad gsher gyis bsad/ de bzhin du sa bon 'debs pa 'greg pa brdung ba sogs kyi dus bsad pa'ang grangs kyis mi chod/ de dag la bsam na 'bu sbrang kho na phye byas pa 'gam pa dang 'dra/ de bzhin du mar dang 'o ma sogs kyang dkar gsum dang mngar gsum/ 'i/sa sdig med dang gtsang mar brtsi yang / rtol 87

dang be'u lu gu sogs phal che ba ni bsad/ma bsad pa rnams kyang / skyes ma thag nas 'o ma mngar mo kham gang yang nu longs med par ske la thag pa bzhag sdod na sding la btags/'gro na phan tshun sbrel/de thams cad kyi zas skal dang 'thung skal 'o ma kham gang yod pa de 'phrog nas nying khur byas/ ma'i lus kyi bcud/bu'i srog gi zungs phrogs pas ma shi ma gson tsam du gyur te/ ma 'bri rgog po dag kyang dpyid ka'i dus nyal mal nas ldang mi nus pa tsam du zungs zad/ bis lug rnams kyang phal cher ni mu ge kho nas ltog grir 'chi/ ma shi ba rnams kyang rke ba skem pa nyam chung ba/ 'gros gum gum pa shi la khad pa yog thod tsam re las med pa byas pa de yin/ de bzhin du da lta rang res skyid por brtsi ba thams cad kha la za rgyu/ rgyab la gyon rgyu/ rgyu zas dang longs spyod thams cad gang la bsams kyang sdig pa kho nas bsgrubs pa zhig ma gtogs med pas/ 'di thams cad kyi 'bras bu mthar ni ngan song gi sdug bsngal mu mtha' med pa la spyod dgos pa yin pas/ da lta skyid por snang ba thams cad kyang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin no//skye rga na 'chi bzhi las/ dang po skye ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ 'di ltar 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rnams ni/mngal nas skye ba yin pas/pha ma'i khu khrag gi dbus su dri za nye bar len pa'i rnam shes zhugs te/mer mer dang /nur nur dang /ltar ltar dang /mkhrang gyur dang / gor mo la sogs 'gyur ba'i gnas skabs kyi sdug bsngal nyams su myong / yan lag nying lag dang dbang po thams cad rdzogs pa'i gnas skabs na/ ma'i mngal gyi nang dog cing dri nga ba mun nag gi nang / btson khang du tshud pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong / mas kha zas tshan mo zos pas me nang du 88

bsregs pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal/ grang mo zos pas chu grang du bsgyur ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal/ nyal ba na ris non pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal/ 'grangs pa na brag gi bar du bcar ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal/ bkres pa na g.yang la lhung ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal/'gro 'dug bsgul bskyod byas pa na rlung gis khyer ba lta bu'i sbug bsngal sogs yod/de nas zla ba'i grangs rdzogs nas/btsa' ba'i dus srid pa las kyi rlung gis mgo mjug bsgyur te/ btsa' sgor drangs pa na gyad stobs po che zhig gis rkang pa nas bzung ste rtsig ngor brgyab pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal yod/ rus pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi bar nas 'byung ba'i tshe/ lcags kyi 'jur mig nas drangs pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal yod/ btsa' sgo dogs pa rnams btsa' mi nus par de nyid du 'chi ba'am/ yang na ma bu gnyis ka 'chi ba dang / min kyang shi la thug pa'i sdug bsngal myong ste/ u rgyan chen pos/ ma bu gnyis ka gshin yul gom phyed bor/ /ma yi kha rus ma gtogs rus tshigs bye/ /zhes gsungs/ btsas nas kyang stan gyi steng du lhung dus tsher ma'i dong du lhung ba lta bu/ rgyab kyi phru ma bshu dus gson por lpags pa bshus pa lta bu/mi gtsang ba bye dor byas dus tsher ma'i lcag gis brabs pa lta bu/ ma'i pang du blangs dus bye'u phrug khras khyer ba lta bu/ spyi bor mar byug dus bkyigs nas dong du 'phang ba lta bu la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal myong / de nas tsog pur bsnyal te 'jog pa'i dus su/ mi gtsang ba'i 'dam du tshud/ ltog skom na tsha la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal ci lta bu byung yang ngu ba kho na las med/ de ltar skyes nas lang tsho smin pa'i tshe na re zhig 'phel ba ltar snang yang / don du tshe ni nyin re bzhin zad cing 'chi ba la thag je nyer 'gro/ 'jig rten tshe 'di'i bya 89

bzhag grub pa dang zin pa'i dus med pa chu'i gnyer ma lta bu gcig rjes su gcig 'byung ba la spyod/ de dag thams cad kyang sdig pa 'ba' zhig dang 'brel pas ngan song gi rgyu byed pa yin pas shin tu sdug bsngal lo/ /de nas rgas pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ de ltar 'khor ba'i bya bzhag snying po med cing zin pa'i dus med pa spyod pa'i ngang du ma tshor bzhin du rgas pa'i sdug bsngal gyis —gtugs/ lus kyi stobs thams cad rim gyis nyams/ zhim por zos pa'i kha zas thams cad kyang mi 'ju/mig gi dbang po nyams pas thag ring dang chung ba'i gzugs mi mthong /rna ba'i dbang po nyams pas sgra skad rnams ji bzhin pa mi thos/ lce'i dbang po nyams pas bza' btung gi ro mi tshor zhing smra ngag gi sdeb mi thon/yid kyi dbang po nyams pas dran pa rbongs shing brjed ngas dang bying 'thib che/ kha'i so phreng lhungs pas sra ba'i zas mi choms shing tshig ldab ldib tu smra/lus kyi drod shor bas gos srab na mi dros shing / 'degs byed kyi stobs nyams pas lci na mi thega'adod pa'i longs spyod la dga' yang spyod pa'i mthu med/ lus kyi rtsa rlung rgud pas blo srab cing bzod sran chung / kun gyis brnyas bcos byed pas yi mug dang sdug bsngal skye/ lus kyi 'byung ba 'khrugs pas nad dang gnod pa mang / 'gro 'dug dang bsgul bskyod thams cad kyang mi nus bzhin du dka' bas byed dgos pa yin te/ rje mi las/ brtod phur 'don pa'i ldang lugs dang gcig /bya la 'jab pa'i 'gro lugs dang gnyis/ /sa do chad pa'i sdod lugs dang gsum/ /gsum 'di gsum 'dzom pa'i dus tshod na/ /yi phyi sgyu lus rgad pa'i yid pham ma/ /phyi pags pa 'dus pa'i gnyer ma dang gcig /nang sha khrag zad pa'i 'bur gob 90

dang gnyis/ /bar glen lkugs 'on long thom yar dang gsum/ /gsum 'di gsum 'dzoms pa'i dus tshod na//a phyi mi sdug ston pa'i khro gnyer can//lci la hrul ba'i dugs po dang gcig /grang la nyog pa'i bza' btung dang gnyis/ bags po bzhi sbyor gyi mal sa dang gsum/ /gsum 'di gsum 'dzom pa'i dus tshod na/ /ma phyi mis 'gom khyis 'gom gyi rtogs ldan ma/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ldangs pa'i tsho rang bzhin gyis 'phral du ldang mi nus par lag pa gnyis ka sa la btsugs nas sa sra ba las brtod phur 'don pa ltar ldangs/'gro ba'i tshe rked pa sgur bas mgo bo btegs mi nus shing gom pa'i 'degs 'jog kyang myur du byed mi nus par dal bus byes pa bya la 'jab pa ltar 'gro/ sdod pa'i tshe rkang lag gi lhu tshigs thams cad na bas dal bus sdod mi nus par lus kyi ljid phab ste sa do lung chad pa bzhin sdod/ lus kyi sha zad pas pags pa'i skyi 'dus te lus dang kha ngo thams cad gnyer mas gang / nang gi sha khrag bri bas rus pa'i tshigs thams cad mngon te 'gram rus dang lhu mgo thams cad phyi la 'bur/ yid kyi dran pa nyams pas glen lkugs dang 'on long du byur nas sems mi gsal zhing thom yor re sdod/lus kyi stobs nyams shing mdzes 'dod kyi gnas skabs nyams pas gos thams cad spru la hrul/ zas skom gyi lhag zhabs la spyod cing lces ro mi tshor pas zas thams cad grang la nyog /lus lci bas gang ltar byas kyang mi bde bas phyogs bzhi rten pa byas shing dus rgyun du mal nas ldang mi nus/ de'i tshe phyi'i sgyu lus rgad pas nang du yid pham zhing sdug bsngal che/ bzhin ras kyi mdzes bkrag nyams nas pags pa'i gnyer ma mang bas mi sdug pa'i khro gnyer ston/ kun gyi brnyas 91

bcos byed cing mgo thog tu 'gom nas song yang ldang mi nus pas gtsang btsog med par rtogs ldan ltar sdod pa sogs yin zhing / rgas pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod par 'chi bar smon yang / don du 'chi ba la nye bas shin tu skrag pa sogs rgas pa'i sdug bsngal ngan song gi 'gro ba dang 'dra bar myong ba yin no/ /na ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ lus 'di nyid 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can yin pas/de dag phan tshun ma nyams pa las rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan la sogs nad sna tshogs pas gzir ba'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba 'char/ lus dang dbang po thams cad dar la babs te stobs dang gzi mdangs rgyas pa'i mi rgod zhig yin kyang na ba'i zug gzer gyis btab ma thag nas bye'u la rdo phog pa bzhin lus stobs shor/ mal gyi gnying du lhung/ lus bsgul bskyod tsam byed pa yang dka'/khyed ci na zhes dris pa'i lan tsam yang myur du bshad pa'i nus pa med par khong ba'i gting nas skad mi thon bzhin du smra/ g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab gang du nyal yang bde ba'i dus med/zas skom gyi zhen pa dang bral/mtshan mo gnyid mi 'ong /nyin par nyin ring/ mtshan mo mtshan ring / sman gyi ro kha tsha sgyur gsum dang /gtar sreg gi sdug bsngal la sogs mi 'dod bzhin du spyod dgos/ na ba la brten nas 'chi ba yang glo bur du 'ong snyam nas 'jigs shing skrag gdon bgegs dang rgyab brten ngan pa'i dbang las sems la rang dbang mi 'dus/'khrul snang las kyang 'khrul snang kho na la spyod/ rang gis rang gsod pa dang /lceb pa sogs kyang byed/ mdze dang gza' la sogs pas nyen na/ gson pa nyid nas shi ba dang 'dra/ mi'i khyu nas bud/ rang ro rang gis mthong / byir nad pa 92

thams cad rang g.yog rang gis mi nus/ nad tshig zos pas gzhan gyi bya ba thams cad mig sngar mi 'babs/ rgyud sngar las gyong / nad yun ring drags na/nad g.yog byed pa yang sun nas ji bzhin mi nyan/ dus rtag tu na ba'i tshor bas nyen nas sdug bsngal ba'o/ /'chi ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ lus mal du lhung nas ldang mi shes/ zas skom mthong yang yi gar mi 'ong / 'chi ba'i tshor bas gdungs pas snying mi dga'/ pho tshod dang snyems pa'i gdeng shor/ 'khrul snang gi sun mas gtugs/ skyes chen po 'degs pa la thug gnyen bshes kyis mtha' bskor yang bshol ni mi thebs/ gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal rang gcig pos myong / longs spyod dpag tu med pa yod kyang khyer dbang ni med/blos ni mi thong /rjes su ni mi 'brang / sngar byas kyi sdig pa dran pas 'gyod pa skye/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal dran nas 'jigs shing skrag 'chi ba glo bur du slebs pas nyam nga / gson po'i snang ba nub pas bag grang / mi sdig pa can 'chi ba na 'chi khar brang lag 'thab cing brang sen rjes kyis bkang nas 'chi ste/ sngar sdig pa byas pa'i las dran te ngan song du skye ba la 'jigs shing skrag rang la rang dbang yod pa'i dus su 'chi khar phan pa'i chos shig ma 'grub snyam du 'gyod nas snying la zug gzer skyes te brang la spar mo btab pas brang sen rjes kyis bkang nas 'chi ba yin te/ji skad du/mi sdig can 'chi ba mthong tsa na/ /las rgyu 'bras ston pa'i slob dpon yin/ /zhes gsungs/ de lta bu dag ma shi ba'i gong nas ngan song gi bsu ma sleb ste/ snang ba thams cad 'jigs skrag dang / tshor ba thams cad sdug bsngal du skyes/ lus kyi 'byung ba sdud/ dbugs ni ngar/ yan lag ni g.yong / 'du shes 'khrul/ mig skya 93

log ge tshe pha rol du 'gro gshin rje'i sun mas sleb/ bar do'i snang ba shar/mgon dang skyabs ni med/ gcer bu lag stong du 'gro ba'i dus de ring gi nyi ma tsam la mi 'ong ba'i gdeng med/ de'i dus su phan nges pa ni dam pa'i chos kho na las su yang skyabs su 'gyur ba med pas/ ji skad du/ chos sems sa ma'i mngal nas skyes/ /skyes ma thag tu 'chi chos dran/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgas gzhon kun la 'chi ba glo bur du 'ong bas skyes pa tsam na 'chi khar phan pa'i chos bsgrub dgos pa yin pa la/ da lta phan chad 'chi ba ma dran pas dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gnas mal dang zang zing la phyi chus/nye du dang 'brel can la sogs pa'i don du chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis dus 'da' ba 'di mtshang re che snyam du bsam mo/ /de bzhin du dgra sdang ba dang 'phrad kyis dogs te/ nyin gyi bya ra mtshan gyi mel tshe rgyun gyi 'tsho skyong sogs brel do kho na'i ngang du dus 'da' yang / phan pa med par longs spyod dang 'byor pa thams cad kyang dgra dang thun mong du 'gyur/nyin gyi jag pa/mtshan gyi rkun ma/ 'phar spyang dang gcan gzan la sogs glo bur glo bur du 'ongs nas 'tshe bar bgyid de/ spyir longs spyod dang 'byor ba ni ci tsam yod pa de tsam du de bsags pa dang bsrung ba dang spel ba sogs sdug bsngal mtha' yas pa'i rang bzhin yin te/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ bsags dang bsrung dang spel bas nyam thag pas/ /nor ni phung khrol mtha' yas shes par bya/ /zhes dang / rje mi las kyang / nor dang po bdag skyid gzhan smon po/ /ci tsam yod kyang chog shes med/ /bar du ser sna'i mdud pas bcings/ /dge ba'i phyogs su gtong mi phod/ /dgra 'dre gnyis kyi g.yab mo yin/ /rang gis bsags pa mi yis 94

spyod/ /tha ma srog gi bdud du 'ong / /dgra bo'i nor gnyer sems la gzan/ /'khor ba'i bslu rdo spangs pa yin/ /bdud kyi mgo skor de nga mi 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'byor pa ci tsam du che ba de tsam du sdug bsngal che zhing / dper na rta gcig yod kyang / de dgras khyer dogs rkun mas rku dogs/ rtswa gzan ma 'khyong gi dogs pa sogs sdug bsngal rta tsam pa mang po yod/ de bzhin du lug gcig yod kyang sdug bsngal lug tsam/tha na ja 'khor zhig yod kyang /sdug bsngal ja 'khor zhig tsam nges par yod/ nor med tsa na dgra dang bral/ zhes pa ltar/'byor pa med na dgra dang bral te/ skyid pa yin pas sngon byon rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin longs spyod nor gyi chags zhen thams cad rtsa ba nas bcad/'tsho ba bya tshol la bsten nas dam pa'i chos kho na bsgrub dgos snyam du bsgom mo//gnyen byams pa dang bral gyi dogs pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ 'jig rten 'khor ba pa'i sems can thams cad rang phyogs la chags/ gzhan phyogs la sdang / nye du 'khor 'bangs gnyen dang mdza' bshes kyi phyogs su lhung pa yin pas/ de dag gi ched du sdug bsngal du ma la spyod/ nye du dang gnyen bshes su 'brel pa de dag kyang mi rtag par 'bral ba'i chos can yin pas/ phal cher shi ba'am yul phyogs gzhan du 'khyar ba dgra dang gnod pa la sogs pas nyen pa na/ de dag gi sdug bsngal de rang la byung ba las kyang thu/ khyad par pha ma ni bu la brtse zhing gdung bas/de 'khyags kyis dogs/ltog gis dogs/ skom gyis dogs/na yis dogs/shi yis dogs/ bu na ba las rang nyid 'chi ba 'dom nus pa tsam du snying brtse zhing de'i ched du sems nad kho na byed pas sdug bsngal/ de bzhin du gnyen dang 95

nye 'brel brtse ba la sogs pa de rnams dang bral du dogs pa'i sdug bsngal spyod pa yin kyang / legs par brtags na gnyen kyang gnyen du ma nges te/ pha ma sogs bu la brtse bar rlom kyang brtse lugs phyin ci log tu gyur nas phugs su gnod pa bskyal ba yin te/rgyu zas dang longs spyod byin/gtan grogs kyi chung ma bsus nas 'khor ba'i 'ching thag dang sbrel/ dgra 'dul lugs/ gnyen skyong lugs/ longs spyod spel lugs sogs mi dge ba'i las thabs du ma bslabs/ngan song gi gting nas mi thar ba zhig byed pa yin pas de dag las gnod tshab che ba med/bu dang bu mo la sogs pa yang dang po lus kyi bcud 'phrog bar du kha yi zas 'phrog tha ma lag gi nor 'phrog phar la brtse bar byas kyang tshur la rgol/rang gi tshe gang sdig sdug gtam ngan thams cad khyad du bsad de bsags pa'i rgyu zas longs spyod thams cad phongs pa med par byin kyang ngo so cung zad kyang med/ mi phal pa zhig la ja 'debs gcig byin pa'i dga' spro tsam rang gi bu la rgya dngul rdil tshad byin kyang med de/ nga rang gi sa pha'i rgyu rdzas nga rang gi los yin snyam pa las med/bu sring dang bu mo sogs kyang rang nor la hab thob byed/byen pa la ngo so med/yang byin kyang yang slong / tha na phreng ba'i grangs 'dzin gyi sngo ne legs po zhig yod kyang bslangs nas khyer/ legs na gzhan gyi dpal skyed cing / rang phyogs la phan pa med/ nyes na ni pha ming gi go khar lhung nas sdug la sbyor/ gnyen gzhan thams cad kyang / rang 'byor zhing skyid la phun sum tshogs pa'i dus na ni thams cad lha bzhin du lta/ phan ji thogs byed/ mi dgos kyang rgyu zas dang longs spyod ster/ rang rgud par gyur na ni nyes pa cung zad kyang ma byas 96

kyang tshur la dgra bzhin du lta/ phan btags pa'i lan du gnod pa skyel/ de ltar bu dang /bu mo gnyen dang nye ba rnams la snying po cung zad kyang med pa yin te/rje mi las/bu dang po lha bu yid 'ong po//snying brtse ba'i sems la bzod blag med/ /bar du bu lon 'ded drags po//thams cad byen kyang mgu dus med//mi yi bu mo nang du bcug drin chen pha ma phyi ru phud/ /pha yi bos kyang lan mi ster/ /ma yis bos kyang yong mi khug /tha ma khyim mtshes snying ring po//khram pa'i kha tshes byas pas phung / /rang skyes kyi dgra bo sems la gzan/ /'khor ba'i bshal thag spangs pa yin//'jig rten gyi bu tsha nga mi 'dod//ces dang /bu mo dang po lha phrug 'dzum kha mo/ /nor gang mang khyer ba'i dbang mo che/ /bar du lan chags 'khor med ma/ /pha la dngos su bslangs nas khyer/ /ma la skog tu brkus nas khyer/ /byin pa ngo so mi byed pa//drin chen pha ma snying rlung slong //tha ma srin mo gdong dmar ma//legs na gzhan gyi dpal skyed ma//nyes na rang gi byur sdud ma//phung byed kyi srin mo sems la gzan/ /sangs med kyi mya ngan spangs pa yin/ /phung gzhi'i bu mo nga mi 'dod/ /ces dang /gnyen dang po 'phrad dga' mthong 'dzum po/ /'dir byon dang 'dir bzhugs kyis lung ba 'gengs/ /bar du sha chang gi zas lan can/ /phar gcig lan du tshur gcig ster/ tha ma chags sdang gi gyod gzhi can/ /sdug grogs kyi gyong rtsa sems la gzan//skyid che'i za grogs de spangs pa yin//'jig rten gyi nye du nga mi 'dod/ /ces gsungs ba ltar yin no/ /de bzhin du 'dod pa thog tu mi khel ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na rang bde zhing skyid pa mi 'dod pa ni gcig kyang med mod de/de ltar 'dod pa ltar 'ong ba ni su yang med/ skyid 97

du re nas mkhar brtsigs pa yang zhig nas rang bsad pa dang / 'grangs su re nas zas zos pa yang nad du gyur te srog la rgol ba dang / rgyal du re nas g.yul ngor phyin pas 'phral du bsad pa dang / khe spogs 'dod pa tshong la phyin pa na dgras bcom ste sprang por gyur pa sogs tshe 'di'i bde skyid dang longs spyod 'byung du re bas 'bad rtsol dang rtsol spub ji tsam byas kyang / rang la sngon gyi las dbang zhig med na 'phral du lto 'grangs ba tsam yang mi 'ong zhing rang gzhan sdug la sbyar/ grub nges pa ngan song gi gting nas mi thar ba zhig grub pa ma gtogs ci yang med/ des na 'bad rtsol ri bo tsam byed pa las bsod nams me stag tsam bsags pa dga' ba yin pas grub dus med pa 'khor ba'i bya byed kyis ci bya/ de lta bu'i las la 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i dus nas ci tsam 'bad pa yin kyang 'bras bu sdug bsngal kho na las mi 'dug de sngon 'jig rten tshe 'di'i ched du mi tshe gcig gi stod smad la 'bad pa tsam/dam pa'i chos la 'bad na da tsam sangs rgya ba'am min kyang ngan song gi sdug bsngal gtan nas myong mi dgos pa zhig ni 'grub nges/ da res spang blang gi sa mtshams shes pa'i skabs 'dir 'grub dus med pa 'khor ba'i bya bzhag la re mi che bar 'grub par nges pa dam pa'i chos gsha' ma zhig bsgrub dgos snyam du bsgom mo//mi 'dod pa thog tu 'bab pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyi rnam grangs de dag thams cad 'dod pa'i gang zag gcig tsam yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na med kyang /mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal de dag kho na la longs spyod/ sngon gyi las dbang las rgyal po'i mnga' ris dang / phyug po'i bran 'khor lta bu rnams rang dbang 98

skad cig kyang med par mi 'dod bzhin du de dag gi dbang du gyur/nyes pa cung zad re'i phyir sdug bsngal du ma gtad kyang bya thabs bral/ da lta gsod sar khrid kyang / rang bsam gyis 'gro ba las 'bros pa tsam yang mi nus pas mtshon/ mi 'dod pa kho na thog tu 'babs te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ bza' tshang nye 'brel 'di dang dus rtag tu/ /mi 'bral 'grogs par 'dod kyang 'bral bar nges/ /bzang po'i gnas mal 'di ru dus rtag tu/ /mi 'bral 'dug par 'dod kyang 'gro bar nges/ /bde skyid longs spyod 'di dang dus rtag tu/ /mi 'bral spyod par 'dod kyang bor bar nges/ /dal 'byor mi lus mchog 'di dus rtag tu/ /mi 'bral rtag par 'dod kyang 'chi bar nges/ /bzang po'i bla ma 'di dang dus rtag tu//mi 'bral chos nyan 'dod kyang bral bar nges//dam pa'i grogs bzang rnams dang dus rtag tu/ /mi 'bral 'grogs par 'dod kyang 'bral nges pas/ /de ring nyid nas brtson pa'i go bgos te/ /'bral med bde chen gling du bgrod re ran/ /skyo shas gting nas skye ba'i grogs rnams la//chos med sprang bo bdag gis de skad bskul/ /zhes gsungs/ des na nor dang longs spyod bde skyid dang snyan grags la sogs 'byung ba'i rgyu/ rang la sngon bsags kyi dge 'bras zhig yod na ni mi 'dod kyang shugs kyis 'byung / de med na ci tsam 'bad rtsol dang rtsol sgrub byas kyang 'dod pa mi 'grub cing mi 'dod pa kho na 'du bas/ nor zad pa med pa chog shes kyi nor la brten nas yang dag pa'i dam chos ma bsgrubs na/ chos sgor zhugs nas 'jig rten tshe 'di bya bzhag sgrub pa ni rang sdug la dam pas khrel ba yin te/ rje mi las/ spyir rgyal ba mi yi dbang po des/ /chos rnams chos brgyad 99

'joms phyir gsungs/ /da lta mkhas par rlom pa rnams/ /chos brgyad che ru ma song ngam//rgyal bas tshul khrims bsrung ba de//'jig rten bya ba spang phyir gsungs//da lta'i khrims srung btsun pa rnams/ /bya bzhag mang du ma song ngam/ /sngon dus drang srong cha lugs de/ /nye du'i 'brel thag bcad phyir gsungs/ /da lta'i drang srong cha lugs rnams//ngo bsrung che ru ma song ngam//mdor na 'chi ba ma dran pa'i/ /dam chos ci byed gyin nar gda'/ /zhes gsungs so/ /da lta mi yul gling bzhi'i 'jig rten spyi dang bye brag rang re 'dzam bu'i gling par skyes pa rnams da lta snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bde ba'i gnas skabs spu tsam yang med par sdug bsngal kho na la spyod/ da dung lo dang zla ba zhag dang za ma snga dro dang phyi 'phred tsam song bzhin dus je snyigs/ bskal pa je ngan/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/ sems can gyi bde skyid thams cad rim pa bzhin nyams dma' ba la bsam nas skyo ba bskyed/gzhan yang 'dzam gling las kyi sa pa yin phyir/bzang ngan/skyid sdug legs nyes/mtho dman chos dang chos min thams cad ma nges pa yin pas/ de dag gi tshul mngon sum du mthong ba la bltas nas rang rgyud la spang blang byed dgos pa yin te/ kun mkhyen bla mas/ skabs su rang snang mthun pa'i rkyen grogs ltos/ /rang snang shes pas nyams myong grogs su 'char/ /skabs su mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen snang ltos/ /'khrul pa zhen log gnad du che ba yin/ /skabs su grogs dang gzhan gyi bla mar ltos/ /bzang ngan shes pas nyams len bskul ma yin/ /skabs su mkha' la 'byung bzhi'i cho 'phrul ltos/ /sems nyid ngang du 'bad rtsol zhig pa shes/ /skabs su rang gi yul mkhar longs spyod ltos/ /sgyu mar shes pas 'khrul 100
