cad kyang mar bla ma la thim/bla ma yang 'od du zhu nas 'od du yal te chos sku spros bral gdod ma'i ngang la sems rnam rtog gi 'phro 'du dang bral bar ci gnas su bzhag de las ldang pa'i tshe dge ba mtha' yas pa'i sems can gyi don du bsngo zhing / dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dkon mchog gsum po 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces brjod/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du sems dran shes dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas skyabs yul gyi lha tshogs de dag 'gro ba'i tshe phrag pa g.yas kyi nam mkhar bsgom/ de bskor ba byed pa'i gnas yin/ 'dug pa'i tshe spyi bo'i gtsug gi nam mkha' la bsgom/ de gsol ba 'debs pa'i rten yin/ za 'thung gi tshe mgrin pa'i dbus su bsgom/ de ci za ci 'thung gi phud mchod pa yin/ nyal pa'i tshe snying gi dbus su bsgom/ de 'khrul pa 'od gsal du sba ba'i gnad yin pas/ de ltar spyod lam thams cad du skyabs yul lha tshos/sa kyi ga/sal snang dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/dkon mchog rin po che nom pa gsum la yid khyed shes kyi dad pas blo bkal te skyabs 'gro kho na la brtson par bya'o//gsum pa bslab bya dang phan yon bstan pa la/ dang po bslab bya la/ spang bya gsum dang / bsgrub bya gsum dang /cha mthun gsum yod pa las/ dang po spang bya gsum ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas 'khor bar 'khor ba'i lha la phyag mi btsal zhes bya ste/ phyi rol mu stegs pa'i lha dbang phyug dang khyab 'jug la sogs rang nyid 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las ma grol ba rnams dang / gzhan yang yul lha dang gzhi bdag la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre mthu bo che rnams la phyi ma'i 204

skyabs gnas su bzung nas phyas/ dang mchod pa la sob/sa pa mi bya/ chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la 'tshe ba spang 'e/sa gsungs te/ sems can gzhan la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bya ba mi lam tsam du yang mi bya bar 'bad pa drag pos ci nus su bsrung / dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas grogs mu stegs can dang mi 'grogs zhes gsungs te/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la mi dad pa'i phyi rol mu stegs ba'i rigs dang mthun par mi 'grogs/ 'on kyang mu stegs can dngos bod na med kyang / rang gi bla ma dang chos la gshe zhing smod pa dang gsang sngags zab mo'i chos la skur pa 'debs pa la sogs mu stegs pa dang 'dra ba gzhan dang mi 'grogs/ bsgrub bya gsum ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su so/nga nas sangs rgyas dkon mchog/ si/ sku'i rten chag dum yan chad gus pas mchod/ spyi bos bteg/ ga/tsang sar bzhag sangs rgyas dkon mchos dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed de dad pa dang dag sna nga bya/ chos 'a skyabs su so/nga nas gsung rab yi ge'i ras ma na gcig yan chad la gus pa bskyed/ spyi bos mchod de chos dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas dge 'dun dkon mchog gi rten lhan pa dmar ser yan chad dge 'dun dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag nas gus pas mchod/ spyi bos btegs/ gtsang sar bzhag pa dang dag snang bya/ cha mthun gsum ni/ da lta rang la blang dor gyi gnas ston pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen la/ sangs rgyas dkon cog dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag nas tha na spu'i grib ma tsam la yang mi 'bong bar zhabs tos dang bsnyen bkur la 'bad/ bla ma dam pa des bka' ji ltar stsal ba'i gsung rna/mas la chos 205

dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag nas ci gsungs dang du blang zhing gsung gi zur tsam yang mi gcog bla ma'i 'khor dang slob ma rang gi grogs tshangs par mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la dge 'dun dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag ste lus ngag yid gsum gus pas bsten zhing mi mnyes pa skad cig ma tsam yang mi bya/ khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'dir skyabs yul gyi gtso bo bla ma yin pas/ bla ma'i sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas te/dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi ngo bor shes par byas nas/ ci mdzad legs mthong dang / blo gtad khyed shes kyi sgo nas bsten zhing rtag tu gsol 'debs la/ gal te rang gi sgo gsum gyi spyod pas thugs sun phyungs na skyabs yul thams cad spangs bar 'gro bas snying rus dang zhe bcad drag pos bla ma mnyes pa'i thabs la dus dang rnam pa thams cad du 'bad par bya/ spyir skyid sdug dang legs nyes na tsha dang sdug bsngal la sogs pa ci byung yang blo bla ma da so/na mchog kho na la gtad/ skyid na dkon mchog gi thugs rjer shes par bya dgos te/ 'jig rten 'di'i bde ba dang dge ba'i dngos po tha na tsha ba'i dus ser bu'i ngad phra mo tsam ldang ba tshun chad sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje dang byen rlabs yin par gsungs shing de bzhin du sems la dge ba'i rnam rtog skad cig ma zhig skyes pa yang sangs rgyas kyi byen rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mthu kho na yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ji ltar mtshan mo mun nag sprin rum na/glog 'gyu skad cig rab snang ston pa ltar/de bzhin sangs rgyas mthu yis brgya lam na/ 'jis rten bsod nams blo gros thang 'ga' 'byung / /zhes gsungs/ des na phan pa dang bde ba'i dngos po ci 206

yod pa sangs rgyas kyi thugs rjer shes par bya zhing / na tsha dang sdug bsngal gdon bgegs kyi bar chad la sogs pa ji lta bu byung yang / dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs pa ma gtogs na tsha dang gdon bgegs sel ba'i thabs gzhan la blo mi gtod/ gal te sman dpyad dang gto bcos sogs byed dgos byung na yang /de dag kyang dkon mchog gsum gyi phrin las su shes pas nyams su blang / gang snang ba thams cad dkon mchog gsum gyi rnam rol du shes pas dad pa dang dag snang sbyang / rang nyid phyogs gzhan du don gnyer la sogs par 'gro ba'i dus kyang / gar 'gro ba'i phyogs kyi yangs rgyas dang dkon mchog la phyag 'tshal te 'gro/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du snying thig gzhung gi skyabs 'gro dkon mchog gsum dngos sogs sam/ yang na theg pa spyi'i skyabs 'gro/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su 'chi'o/ /zhes skyabs 'gro bzhi skor du grags pa 'di dag la yi dam du bya/ gzhan la yang skyabs su 'gro ba'i bsngags pa brjod cing skyabs 'gro la bkod de rang gzhan thams cad kyi 'di phyi'i blo gtad dkon mchog gsum la bca' zhing skyabs 'gror 'bad/ nyal ba'i tshe yang sngar bshad par ltar tshogs zhing lha tshogs snying dbus su gsal btab ste/ de la sems gtad nas gnyid du 'jug pa'am/ de ltar mi nus na bla ma dang dkon mchog thams cad bdag la thugs rje dang brtse bas nye bar dgongs te bdag gi sngas na mngon sum du bzhugs yod snyam du dad pa dang dag snang bya zhing dkon mchog rjes su dran pa dang ma bral bar nyal/ bza' btung byed pa'i tshe yang dkon mchog gsum 207

mgrin par bsal btab ste bza' btung ge/ ros mchod pa'am/ de ltar ma nus na ci za ci 'thung thams cad kyi phud nas dkon mchog gsum mchod cig snyam du mos pa bya/ rang la rgas gsar pa lta bu gyon rgyu yod na yang dang po rang gis ma gyon pa'i gong du dkon mchog gsum mchod snyam du nam mkha' la deng tsam bya/de nas dkon mchog gsum gyis rang la gnang ba yin snyam du rang gis bgo phyi rol yul gyi rnam pa la yang me tog gi skyed mos tshal dang /chu klung rnyog pa med pa/khang bzang dang / nags tshal nyams dga' ba/ nor dang longs spyod rgya chen po/skyes pa dang bud med mdzes shing rgyan gyis brgyan pa la sogs pa rang gi yid dga' zhing chags par byed ba'i dngos po ci dang ci mthong yang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum po mchod snya ma du mos pa bya/ chu la gcu ba'i tshe yang dang po dkon mchog gsum la mchod 'phangs nas rjes su rang gi snod du gcu/ rang la tshe 'di'i bde skyed snyan grags rnyed pa la sogs pa 'dod cing yid 'ong ba ci byung yang dkon mchog gi thugs rje yin/ dkon mchog gsum por mchod snyam du mos gus dang dag snang bya/ rang gi phyag dang mchod pa lha bsgom sngags bzlas la sogs dge ba'i rtsa ba gang 'grub thams cad kyang dkon mchog gsum la mchod par 'bul zhing sems can gyi don du bsngo ba bya/ nya stong dus drug la sogs par dkon mchog gi mchod pa ci nus su bya zhing / rgyun du dkon mchog gsum gyi dus mchod mi bcag dus dang rnam pa thams cad du skyid sdug ci byung yang dkon mchog gsum 'a/ skyabs 'gro kho na mi/ brjed par bya/ de ltar byas pas mi lam du 'jigs skrag la sog/sa skyes pa'i tshe skyabs 'gro byed pa byung na bar dor yang de 208

ltar du 'byung ba yin pas de lta bur ma byung bar 'bad/ mdor na blo gtad dkon mchos gsum kho na la bcol nas/ srog la babs kyang skyabs 'gro mi gtong ba zhig dkos te/ sngon rgya sa/ra du nang ba'i dge bsnyen zhig mu stegs pa rnams kyis bzung nas khyod dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro byed pa gtong na mi gsod/ de mi gtong na khyod gsod pa yin zer ba la/ ngas tshig tsam du ni dkon mchog gi skyabs 'gro gtong / snying thag pa nas ni mi gtong zer bas dge bsnyen mu stegs pa rnams kyis bsad pa yin te/de lta bu zhig cis kyang dgos/dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba spangs na chos zab zab mo ji lta bu zhig nyams su blangs kyang nang pa'i khyur mi tshud de/ phyi pa nang pa skyabs 'gro'i khyad/ zer ba yin/ mi dge ba'i las la 'dzem bag bya ba dang / lha dang rtsa rlung sogs bsgo mas pas thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa mu stegs pa rnams la yang yod kyang /dkon mchog gi skyabs 'gro mi shes pas thar pa'i lam dang bral zhing gtan du 'khor ba las mi thar ba yin/ jo bo rje yo ti sha yang mdo sngags kyi chos rgya mtsho lta bu la mi mkhyen pa dang mi gzigs pa cung zad med kyang / de dag kun las kyang thog mar skyabs 'gro kho na gnad du che bar dgongs nas 'khor 'dus pa thams cad la skyabs 'gro kho na gsungs pas skyabs 'gro paṇḍi ta zhes grags/ des na thar ba'i lam du zhugs shing nang pa sangs rgyas pa zhig yin phyin chad skyabs 'gro dang skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya srog la babs kyang mi 'dor bar nyams su blang dgos te/ mdo las/ gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs 'gro ba/ de ni yang dag dbe/ bsnyen te/ nam du yang ni lha gzhan la/ skyabs su song ba ma yin no/ /dam pa'i 209

chos la skyabs 'gro ba/ /'tshe zhing gnod pa'i sems dang bral/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun skyabs 'gro ba/ /mu stegs can dang 'grogs mi bya/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ /da lta rang re dkon mchog gsum gyi rjes 'jug tu rlom pa rnams kyang / dkon mchog gi rten la sogs pa rnams la gus pa cung zad kyang med pas sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs dang gsung rab kyi glegs bam sogs la nor rdzas kyi 'du shes bzhag nas tshong byed pa dang / gta' mar 'jog pa sogs byed pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi sku glud la za ba zhes bya ste nyes pa shin tu lci/gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi sbu gzugs bris pa dang 'bur du yod pa sogs thig tshad sogs kyi gzhal nas bzo bcos byed pa'i skabs ma yin par/ dus gzhan du mi mdzes pa'i cha nas glengs te spyon rtog sogs byas na nyes pa shin tu lci bas de ltar mi bya/ gsung rab yi ge'i glegs bam la sogs pa yang sa rjen par 'jog pa dang / 'gom yug sogs byed pa dang / yig ldeb sgyur ba'i tshe mdzub mo mchil ma dang bcas pas reg pa sogs ma gus pa'i spyod lam byed pa thams cad nyes pa lhag par lci ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ lnga brgya'i tha mar gyur pa na/ /nga ni yi ge'i gzugs su gnas/ /nga yin snyam du yid byos la/ /de tshe de la gus pa gyis/ /zhes gsu ngas shing / 'jig rten pa'i kha skad la yang / bka' thog tu sku ma 'jog zer ba ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rten thams cad las / gsung rten ni blang dor gyi gnas ston pa dang / bstan pa'i rgyun 'dzin pa sogs kyis sangs rgyas dngos dang khyad par cung zad kyang med cing khyad par 'phags par gsungs pa yin/ der ma zad da lta phal cher gyis rdo rje dang dril bu ni rang 210

bzhin nyer spyad lta bu las dkon mchog gi rten yin snyam pa mi byed kyang / rdo rje ni sangs rgyas kyi thugs ye shes lnga la sogs pa mtshon zhing / dril bus kyang zhal gyi rnam pa yod pa rgyud sde 'og ma las rnam par snang mdzad dang / gong ma rnams las rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mar bshad pas sku'i rnam pa dang / yum brgyad kyi sa bon dngos su yi ge'i rnam pa dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi gsung chos kyi sgra dbyangs mtshon par byed pa yin pas sku gsung thugs rten gsum ka'i mtshan nyid tshang ba dang / khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs rdzogs tshang zhing dam tshig gi rdzas thun mong ma yin pa yin pas/brnyas bcos byas na nyes pa lci zhing dus rtag tu bkur ste'i sgo nas zhabs tog byed dgos pa yin no/ /de ltar skyabs su song ba'i phan yon yang / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba 'di ni chos thams cad kyi gzhi rten yin te/ gang gis skyabs su song ba tsam gyis thar pa'i sa bon 'debs pa dang / mi dge ba'i tshogs las ring du byed pa dang / dge ba gong du 'phel ba dang / sdom pa kun gyi rten gzhir 'gyur zhing /yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su 'gyur ba dang /gnas skabs su yang dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams kyis srung zhing smon pa yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang / rtag tu dkon mchog gsum gyi snang ba dang mi 'bral zhing tshe rabs dran pa dang / 'di phyir bde zhing mthar thugs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa la sogs phan yon dpag tu med par gsungs te/ skyabs 'gro bdun cu pa las/ sdom pa kun la yod mod kyang / /skyabs su ma song ba la med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar so thar gyi dge slong dge tshul dge bsnyen sogs kyi sdom pa 211

thams cad kyi yang rten du skyabs 'gro med thabs med cing / de las gzhan du byang chub mchog/ tu sems bskyed pa dang / gsang sngags rdo rje theb/ pa'i dbang bskur ba sogs thams cad kyi sngon du skyabs su 'gro ba mtshan nyid chang ba 'gro dgos shing / tha na nyin gcig gi gso sbyo nga tsam yin pa'i sngon du'ang skyabs 'gro med thabs med pas sdom pa dang yon tan thams cad kyi rten gzhi byed pa yin/dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan shes nas dad pas skyabs su 'gro ba lta ci tha na sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i sgra tsam rna bar thos pa dang / sku gsung thugs kyi rten gang rigs la 'brel ba cung zad tsam byas pa la'ang rgyud la thar pa'i sa bon thebs nas mthar mya ngan las 'das pa thob par 'gyur te/ sngon phag gcig khyis ded nas mchod rten zhig yod pa la bskor ba byas pas de'i rgyud la thar ba'i sa bon thebs par 'dul ba las gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang sātstsha gcig gis mi gsum sangs rgyas zer ba yin te/ sngon lam ka zhig na sātstsha zhig yod pa mi gzhan zhig gis mthong ste satstsha 'di 'di ltar bzhag na char pas myur du 'jig pas mi 'jig par bya'o snyam nas drung de na lham khrad dor ba zhig yod ba bkab nas bzhag yang mi gzhan zhig gis lham phrad shin tu mi gtsang ba 'di sna rgyu'i steng du bkab pa ma legs so snyam nas dor bas/ lha ma 'gebs pa po dang 'dor ba po gnyis kas bsam pa bzang po'i 'bras bus phyi ma rgyal srid thob pa yin te/ ji skad du/ bsam pa bzang pos mchil lham zhig /thub pa'i dbu la bzhag pa dang / /gzhan gyis de nyid bsal byas pa/ gnyis kas rgyal srid thob par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs/ des na dang po sātstsha 'debs pa po dang / bar du 212

lham 'gebs pa po dang / tha mar de bsal ba po gsum ka yang gnas skabs su rgyal srid sogs mngon mtho'i bde 'bras thob cing mthar thug thar pa'i sa bon thebs te rim gyis 'tshang rgya ba'ang yin no/ /mi dge ba'i tshogs las ring du byed pa yang yin te/ snying thag pas dad gus drag po'i sgo nas dkon mchog la skyabs su song na sngar byas kyi las mi dge ba yang srab pa dang zad par 'gyur zhing / phyin chad kyang dkon mchog gi thugs rjes rgyud byin gyis brlabs nas snang ba dge bar 'gyur bas mi dge ba'i las mi byed pa yang yin te/ rgyal po ma skyes dgras pha bsad pa yang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song bas dmyal ba zhag bdun myongs nas thar bar gsungs pa dang / lhas byin mtshams med pa'i las gsum byas pas gson bzhin du dmyal ba'i mes bsregs pa'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi gsungs la yid ches nas/ ngas da ni rus pa'i gnying nas sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes brjod pas rang sangs rgyas rus pa can bya bar 'gyur bar gsungs pa lta bu yin/ des na da lta rang re rnams bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drin las dam pa'i chos yang dag pa thos te/ dge ba'i las sgrub blo dang / mi dge ba spong blo cung zad tsam re skyes pa'i skabs 'dir/ snying thag pa nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la 'bad na rgyud byin gyis brlabs te/ dad pa dang dag snang / nges 'byung dang skyo shas/ rgyu 'bras la yid ches la sogs lam gyi yon tan thams cad gong nas gong 'phel du 'gyur zhing / de ltar ma yin par bla ma dang dkon mchog la skyabs 'gro dang gsol ba 'debs pa btang snyoms su lus na/ da lta nges 'byung dang skyo shas sogs ci tsam bzang bar 213

yod kyang / snang ba brid mkhas/ rig pa col chung / rnam rtog bslu skyen pas da lta dge bar yod 'phro la yang / mi dge bar 'gyur 'gro ba la tshegs med pas phyin chad kyi mi dge ba rgyun gcod pa yang skyabs 'gro las lhag pa med par shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang / sgrub pa brtson 'grus can la bdud rnams lhag par sdang /zhes dang /chos zab tsa na nag po'i bdud kyang zab//ces gsungs ba ltar/da lta dus snyigs mar thug pas zab mo'i don bsgom pa dang /dge ba rlabs po che byed pa rnams la/ 'jig rten tshe 'di'i bslu brid dang / gnyen grogs kyis bshol 'debs/ /na tsha dang gdon bgegs kyi 'gal rkyen/ rang gi yid la the tshom dang rnam rtog la sogs chos kyi bar chad ni cir yang brdzu zhing dge ba'i tshogs 'joms pa yin pas/ de dag gnyen po dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro sogs snying thag pa nas 'bad na/ chos kyi bar chad thams cad mthun rkyen du 'char zhing dge ba gong nas gong 'phel du 'gyur/ der ma zad da lta'i dus su dud nag pa rnams nas kyang lo gcig gi bar du na tsha dang god kha sogs mi 'byung ba'i srung ba byed pa yin zer nas dbang lung dang gzhi bsnyen sogs gang yang med pa'i bla ma dpon g.yog kha shas bos te/ drag sgrub kyi dkyil 'khor zhig zhal phye/bskyed rdzogs gang yang med pa'i mig phor khog tsam re bsgrad nas zan gong zhig gi steng du zhe sdang bzod dka' ba bskyed de/ khug khug sod sod/ya ya/rgyob rgyob zer zhing thos tsa na snang ba rtsub reg la 'ong ba zhig bton nas sha khrag gi dmar mchod kho na byed 'dug ste/de lta bu de legs par brtags na/ rje btsun mi las/ye shes pa'i lha 'jig rten pa'i srung skyob la spyan 'dren pa de rgyal po khri thog nas 214

phebs te phyags dar gyi las bcol ba dang 'dra gsungs pa dang / rje dam pa sangs rgyas kyis/gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor grong ba'i ra tshang du bzhengs nas gnyen po yin pa skad/ ces gsungs pa ltar gsang sngags bon du gyer 'i nyes pa 'go zhing / bsgral las byed pa de yang rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba med pa'i gang zag gis/ bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che bsgrub pa'i phyir du zhing bcu tshang pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol ba la gnang ba yin gyi/ rang gzhan gyi phyogs zhen dang bcas pas zhe sdang rang mtshan pas bsgral las byas na pha rol bsgral bar mi nus shing rang nyid dmyal bar skye ba'i rgyu byed pa dang / bskyed rdzogs dang dam tshig med par sha khrag gi dmar mchod kho na byas pas ye shes pa'i lha dang chos skyong ba'i srung ma mi 'grub cing / nag phyogs pa'i lha 'dre rnams 'dus nas de'i mchod pa dang gtor ma sogs la longs spyod de/ 'phral du phan pa ltar byed kyang phugs su mi 'dod pa du ma sbyin pa yin pas/ de bas blo gtad dkon mchog la bcol/rgyud zhi zhing dul ba'i bla ma dang ser mo ba bos nas skyabs 'gro 'bum ther re bsags bcug na srung ba la yang de las lhag pa med de dkon mchog gi skyabs 'og tu tshud/ tshe 'dir mi 'dod pa thams cad mi 'byung zhing 'dod dgu'i bsam pa thams cad ngang gis 'grub/ dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams kyis srung zhing nag phyogs kyi gdon bgegs rnams nye mi nus pa yin te/ sngon rkun po byed pa zhig gzhan gyis bzung nas/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o sogs skyabs 'gro char re dang sbrags dbyug pas na nges pa re brgyab nas mngags btang bas/skyabs 'gro'i tshig de rnams na tsha'i zug zu dang dbyer med du yid la lhang lhang 215

gsal bzhin zam pa zhig gi sna 'os/ tu nyal nas bsdad bas/ zam thog na tshur lha 'dre mang po 'ong ba rnams 'di dkon mchog la skyabs 'gro byed pa zhig 'dug zer nas co dir gyis bros song / des na snying thag pa nas dkon mchog la skyabs su song na tshe 'di'i gnod pa sel ba la de las lhag pa med cing / phyi ma thar ba dang rnam mkhyen gyi go 'phang yang thob pa sogs phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab ste/dri ma med pa'i mdo las/skyabs su song ba'i bsod nams gang //gal te de la gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang yang / /de ni de bas lhag par 'gyur/ /zhes dang /phar phyin bsdus paXlas/ skyabs song bsod nams gzugs mchis na/ /khams gsum 'di yang snod du chung / /rgya mtsho chen po chu yi gter/ /phul gyis gzhal bar ga la nus/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas skyabs su sems can su 'gro ba/ /bdud rnams bye bas bsad par mi nus te/ /tshul khrims nyams shing blo ni 'khrugs gyur kyang / /de ni nges par skye ba'i pha rol 'gro/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar phan yon chad med pa dang ldan pas na chos thams cad kyi rten gzhi skya sa su 'gro ba'i gnas 'di la nan tan du bya dgos so/ /skyabs gsum brten kyang snying nas yid ches dman/ /bslab gsum nod kyang bsrung sdom yal bar bor/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra snying med sems can rnams//mi ldog dad pa brtan par byen gyis rlobs/ /lam thams cad kyi rmang rdo skyabs su 'gro ba'i khrid do/ /216

gnyis pa/ byang chub mtshog tu sems bskyed pa/shes rab chen pos myang 'das mngon du mdzad//snying rje chen pos 'khor ba dang du blangs/ /zabs la mkhas pas 'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs//mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis pa theg chen gyi rtsa ba byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i khrid la gsum/ tshad med bzhi'i blo sbyong ba/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ sbon 'jug gi bslab bya bzung ba'o/ /dang po tshad med bzhi'i blo sbyong ba la/ spyir byams pa dang snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms bzhi las/thog mar byams pa nas smos kyang / 'dir nyams su blangs nas rim pa bzhin blo sbyong ba'i tshe/ dang po btang snyoms nas ma sbyangs na/ byams pa dang snying rje sogs phyogs ris can du shor nas rnam pa dag pa zhig mi 'ong ba yin pas/ des na dang po btang stoms nas blo sbyong ba yin/ btang snyoms zhes bya ba ni/ dgra la zhe sdang btang / gnyen la dag/'a gdung btang / sems can thams cad la nye ring dang chags sdang med par snyoms pa la btang snyoms zhes bya/ da lta'i gnas skabs na pha ma dang gnyen 'dun la sogs rang phyogs la shin tu chags/ dgra dang de'i phyogs la sdang zhen mi bzad par byed pa 'di yang ma brtags pa'i skyon yin/ tshe rabs snga ma rnam/sa su da lta'i dgra 'di rnams kyis 217

kyang rang gi gnyen byas nas brtse bas 'grogs/ mthun pas bskyangs/ phan btags pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab/ da lta gnyen du brtsi ba 'di rnams kyang tshe rabs snga ma la rang gi dgrar gyur te gnod pa byas pa yang du ma yod pa sngar bshad pa ltar/ 'phags pa ka tyā nas/ pha sha za zhing ma la rdeg /las ngan dgra bo pang na bzung / /chung mas khyo yi rus pa 'cha'/ /'khor ba'i chos la gad mo bro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang /der ma zad sngon chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sras mo lha lcam padma gsal zhes bya ba dgung lo bcu bdun lon pa zhig 'das skabs/chos rgyal gyis slob dpon rin po che la/ bdag gi sras mo lha lcam 'di las dag pa zhig kyang yin pa 'dra ste/ bdag rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi bu mor skyes/khyed lo paṇa sangs rgyas dngos lta bu 'di tsam gyi zhal mjal ba yin/'on kyang tshe thung ngu 'di lta bu 'gyur ba ji ltar lags/ zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas khyed kyi sras mo lha lcam 'di las dag pas khyed kyi sras mor skyes pa ci yang min/sngon padma bdag dang chos rgyal chen po bo rnyi sa twa rnams rigs ngan gyi bu gsum du skyes nas/ mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor bzhengs pa'i skabs su lha lcam 'di sbrang bu tre ma zhig gi lus blangs nas yod pas/ rgyal po nyid kyi rtse'u chung la zos pa'i tshe/ rgyal pos dran med du phyag gis byabs pas sbrang bu shi bar gyur pa de'i tshe srog gi lan chags kyis khyed kyi sras mor skyes pa yin gsungs/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos la de lta bu'i lan chags kyi bu rgyud yod na skye bo bzhan la lta yang ci smos/ des na da lta rang re pha ma dang bu rgyud du 'brel/brtse gdung dang 'dun pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byed/218

de la sdug bsngal dang mi 'dod pa byung na rang la byung ba las kyang thu ba'i mya ngan 'byung ba rnams kyang / sngon gcig gis gcig la gnod pa bskyal ba'i lan chags 'khor ba sha stag yin/ da lta rang gi dgra ru gyur pa 'di rnams kyang tshe rabs snga ma rnams su pha ma ma byas pa ni su yang med/ da lta yang dgra la dgrar bzung yang de rang la gnod pa'i nges pa'ang med de/ rang gis dgrar bzung yang des tshur la dgrar mi 'dzin pa dang / dgrar 'dzin kyang gnod pa skyel mi nus pa yang yod la/ 'phral du gnod pa bskyal yang de'i rgyus rang gi tshe 'di'i snyan grags 'phel ba dang / dam pa'i chos dang mjal ba sogs mthar thug gi phan bder 'gyur ba yang yod/ rang gi thabs kyis de'i yid dang bstun nas 'jam po'i tshig gis shad sbyangs te mthun par byas na/ gnyen du 'gyur ba la yang tshegs med/ de bzhin du da lta gnyen du bzung ba rnams kyang bu tshas pha ma bslus pa dang gsod pa sogs byed pa yang yod cing / rang dang mi mthun pa'i 'gal zla rnams dang bsdongs nas/ de'i phyogs bzung ste nor 'phrog rtsod pa 'gyed pa sogs du ma yod pa dang / gal te mthun pa ltar yod na ni/ de la sdug bsngal dang mi 'dod pa sogs byung na rang byung ba las kyang thu ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba dang / gnyen dang bu tsha la sogs pa de dag gi ched du sdig rlabs po che bsags nas phyi ma dmyal bar 'phen pa dang / rang gi chos yang dag pa zhig bsgrub par 'dod kyang de dag gis bshol 'debs pa dang / pha ma dang bu brgyud sogs blos ma thong bas chos phyi bshol du lus nas bsgrub long mi 'byung ba sogs dgra las kyang thu ba'i gnod pa skyel ba yin/ de bzhin du skye ba phyi ma phan 219

chad la yang da lta rang gis dgrar 'dzin pa 'di dag rang gi bu rgyud du skye ba dang / gnyen noms dgrar skye ba sogs nges pa med/ des na dgra gnyen gyi snang ba skad cig ma 'di la bden par bzung nas chags sdang gis las ngan bsags/rang nyid ngan song gi gteng rdo byed pa zhig byas pa la dgos pa ci yod/ des na rang gis mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad la pha ma dang bu tsha'i 'du shes nye bar bzhag ste/ sngon gyi dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin dgra sa/nyen mnyam pa nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /snyam du bsam zhing / dang po rang gi yid la kyi/na tu mi dga' zhing khong khro dang zhe sdang skye ba'i yul rnams la thabs du ma'i sgo nas khong khro dang zhe sdang mi skye ba'i tshul la blo sbyangs nas/ rang bzhin gyi mi phan gnod gang yang med pa'i bar ma rnams dang snyoms par bya/ de nas bar rnams kyang tshe rabs thog ma med pa'i dus nas rang gi pha ma byas pa la grangs kyis mi chod pa sogs la bsams nas/ da lta skye ba 'di'i pha ma dngos dang 'dra bar brtse gdung gi blo ma skyes bar du blo sbyang zhing bsgom/ mthar dgra gnyen bar ma gsum gang rung du snang ba'i sems can thams cad rang gi tshe 'di'i pha ma dang khyad med du snying rje'i blo ma skyes bar du bsgom/ de ltar ma byung na rang bzhin du dgra gnyen gang la yang snying rje dang zhe sdang sogs mi skye bar snyoms pa tsam byung yang / de ni phan med gnod med gti mug btang snyoms pa zhes bya ste btang stoms tshad med pa'i go mi chod/ des na btang stoms tshad med pa drang srong gi mgron 'gyed pa lta bu zhes bya ba/ dper na drang srong rnams mgron nam ston mo 'gyed pa'i tshe mtho dman drag zhan bzang ngan rab 'bring thams cad la khyad med par 'gyed pa 220

dang mtshungs par/nam mkhas gar khyab kyi sems can thams sa cad snying rje chen po'i yul du mnyam zhing snyoms pa zhig dgos pa yin pas/de ltar ma byung gi bar du blo sbyang / de nas byams pa bsgom pa ni/ de ltar btang stoms tshad med par bsgoms pas khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad byams pa chen po'i yul du snyoms par byas pa de dag thams cad la dmigs nas/dper na bu tsha zung ngu pha mas skyong ba na/bu des tshur la log sgrub byas pa dang rang gi dka' tshegs thams cad khyad du bsad de/ bu de bde thabs skyid thabs 'jam thabs kho na la lus ngag yig gsum gyi sgo nas brtson pa ltar du/ sems can de dag tshe 'di dang phyi mar bde ba dang legs pa'i thabs sna tshogs la rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi 'bad pa 'don/ sems can de dag thams cad kyang rang bde na skyid na snyam du rang gi bde skyid kho na don du gnyer ba las/ mi bde ba dang sdug bsngal 'dod pa nyid su yang med pa/ 'on kyang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba bsgrub mi shes par mi dge ba bzu la longs spyod pas zhe 'dod dang lag len phyin ci log tu gyur nas 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang 'ong ba sdug bsngal kho na 'ong ba'i sems can 'di thams cad/ rang rang so so'i 'dod pa ltar bde ba dang skyid pa kho na byung na ci ma rung snyam du yang dang yang du bsgom zhing / mthar rang la bde ba 'dod pa ci lta bar sems can thams cad la yang bde ba kho na 'dod pa rang dang khyad med du ma byung gi bar du bsgom/ de bzhin du mdo sde dag las/ byams pa'i lus kyi las dang / byams pa'i ngag si las dang / byams pa'i yid kyi las zhes gsungs pa ltar/kha yis tshig bshad kyang /lag gis bya ba byed kyang / sems can gzhan la 221

gnod pa med par drangs shing byams pa'i tshul kho na bya/ spyod 'jug las/ mig gis sems can lta na yang / /drang zhing byams pa'i tshul gyis blta/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar tha na mig gis sems can gzhan la lta na yang / 'dzum zhing yid duX'ong ba'i tshul gyi lta ba las/ sdang mig sogs khro ba'i tshul gyis mi blta ste/ sngon mi dpon btsan po gzhan la mig log kho na lta ba zhig yod pa/ phyis dud gcig gi ma skyed 'og tu lhag ma za ba'i yi dwags su skyes pa dang / 'phags pa'i gang zag khyad par can la mig log bltas pas/ dmyal bar skyes par gsungs pa sogs yod pas/ lus kyi spyod lam thams cad kyang 'jam zhing yid du 'ong ba'i sgo nas gzhan la mi gnod cing phan gdags pa lhur len/ngag gis tshig gcig smra yang /de gzhan la khyad gsod sun 'byen zur za sogs mi bya bar/ bden pa dang snyan par smra/ yid kyi sgo nas kyang gzhan la phan par byas na/ de'i bzang lan 'ong du re ba dang / spyod lam dang ngag 'jam smra ba sogs kyis/ gzhan gyis rang la byang chub sems dpar mthong thabs kyi tshul 'chos byed pa sogs ma yin par/ snying thag pa nas gzhan la phan par 'dod pa dang / bde ba 'dod pa kho na bya/ bdag skye ba nas skye ba/ tshe rabs nas tshe rabs thams cad du sems can gzhan gyi tha na ba spu'i khung bu gcig tsam la gnod pa byed par ma gyur cig /phan 'dogs par gyur cig snyam du yang nas yang du smon lam gdab/ khyad par rang la bsten pa'i dud 'gro dang 'khor g.yog tha na sgo khye yan chad la rdung rdeg dang bkol spyod kyis ha cang mnar ba sogs mi bya bar/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas byams par bya/ da lta bran khol dang sgo khyi sogs su 222

skyes nas thams cad kyis brnyas bcos dang sdang ba sogs byed pa 'di rnams kyang sngon dbang yod rer skyes skabs gzhan la khyad gsod dang / brnyas bcos sogs byas pa'i las 'bras smin pa dang lan chags 'khor ba yin/ da lta rang la thob thang dang longs spyod yod pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas gzhan la brnyas par byas na/ skye ba phyi ma la de'i lan chags 'khor nas rang yang gzhan gyi bran khol sogs byed par 'gyur ba yin pas rang las dman pa la lhag par yang byams bar bya/ khyad par rang gi pha ma dang gzhan yun ring gi nad ba sogs la sgo gsum gyis phan par byas tshad phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ jo bo rje lha gcig gi zhal nas/ thag ring gi mgron po/ yun ring gi nad pa/ pha ma rgas 'khogs sogs la byams par byas na stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can bsgom pa dang 'dra bar gsungs/ khyad par pha ma ni bu la lhag par brtse zhing drin che bas rgas pa'i dus pha ma'i zhe gcod pa ni sdig pa lhag par du lci zhing / bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang yum gyi drin lan bsab phyir sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha yul du byon nas chos gsungs/ bus phrag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis su pha ma gnyis khur te sa chen po la bskor ba byed pa tsam gyi zhabs tog bsgrubs kyang pha ma'i drin lan mi 'khor zhing pha ma chos la btsud na drin lan 'khor bar gsungs pas/ dus rtag tu lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas pha ma'i zhabs tog bsgrub/ blo chos la 'gyur ba'i thabs la 'bad/ gzhan yang o rgyan chen pos/ rgas pa yi mug ma 'jug bkur stes skyongs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang las rgan pa thams cad la lus ngag gi byams pa byed cing yid la ci 'thad kyis skyongs/ lar deng sang rang 223

re rnams nas 'khor ba'i 'dug chus sgrub pa la sems can la gnod mi byed pa'i thabs mi 'dug zer kyang thabs yod de/ sngon li yul du dge tshul gnyis kyis 'phags pa 'jam dpal bsgrubs pas/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal mjal te/ nga dang khyed gnyis las 'brel med/ khyed gnyis kyi tshe rabs kyi lha skal 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yin/ spyan ras gzigs de da lta bod na rgyal po byed cing bzhugs yod pas der song zhig gsungs/ khong gnyis bod du 'ong bas lha sa'i lcags ri'i rgyab na/ mi mang po bsad pa dang btson du bzung ba mthong nas 'di rnams ci yin dris pas/ rgyal pos chad pa bcad pa yin zer/ rgyal po de spyan ras gzigs min par 'dug /nged gnyis la yang chad pa gcod las che bas bros pa drag snyam/ khong gnyis bros 'ong ba rgyal pos mkhyen nas 'bod mi btang nas mdun du bos/ khyed gnyis 'jigs mi dgos/ bod dmu rgod gdul dka' bas ngas/ chad pas bcad pa'i mi bsad pa dang gtub pa sogs sprul ba byas pa yin gyi/ dngos su rang gis sems can gcig gi ba spu'i khung bu tsam la gnod pa bskyal ba med gsungs/ khong bod kha ba can gyi rgyal srid skyong zhing phyogs kyi rgyal po sde bzhi mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ mtha' yi dmag dpung thams cad btul te phyogs kyi so kha bsrungs/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi mdzad pa rgya chen po de lta bu mdzad dgos kyang sems can gcig gi ba spu'i khung bu la yang gnod pa ma bskyal na/da lta rang re'i gzhis ngan 'bu tshang lta bu 'di 'dzin pa la sems can la gnod pa ma bskyal pa'i thabs med pa ga la yin/ sems can la gnod pa bskyal pas gnod lan rang la 'khor nas tshe 'di dang phyi mar sdug bsngal mtha' 224

med pa spyod pa'i rgyu byed pa las/tshe 'di tsam du yang phan pa mi 'grub ste/ mi bsad pa la stong dang / rku byas pa la 'jal sprod pa sogs rang gi nor dang longs spyod chud gzan pa ma gtogs/ de dag la brten nas longs spyod 'grub pa ni su yang mi 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /des na byams pa tshad med pa bya mas bye'u gso ba lta bu zhes bya ste/ bya mas bye'u gso ba'i tshe/ dang po tshang 'jam zhing bde bar btsas/de nas kyang gshog pas bkab/drod la bcar/ spyod lam thams cad 'jam po'i sgo nas bye'u de 'phur ma song gi bar du skyong ba dang 'dra bar/khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas byams par bya ba la bslab par bya'o/ /de nas snying rje bsgom pa ni/ sdug bsngal drag pos mnar ba'i sems can zhig la dmigs nas de sdug bsngal gyi gnas dang bral bar 'dod pa yin/ gang zhig nag can btson dong du bcug pa de nyid mthar gsod du nye ba'am/ shan pa'i mdun sar dud 'gro 'chi kha ma lta bu'i sems can sdug bsngal drag pos gdung ba zhig blo yul du bsams la/de la brtse ba'i yul ma dang bu'i 'du shes bskyed/ ces gsungs pas/ dper na nag can gyi btson pa zhig rgyal pos gsod par khrid pa'am/ bsha' lug shan pas bzung ste bkyig bzhin pa sogs la bltas nas/ sems can gzhan de dang de yin snyams pa'i blo de bor nas/ de nga rang yin na ji ltar byed snyam du pha rol sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can de la rang nyid yin pa'i blo bzhag da ci byed bros sa dang gab sa/skyabs dang skyob pa ni med/ 'bros ni mi nus/ 'phur ni mi shes/ shed dang dpung gis rgol mi thub/ da lta skad cig ma 'di'i bar la tshe 'di'i snang ba thams cad 225

dang 'bral/ tha na gces par bskyangs pa'i lus kyang shul du bzhag nas/ tshe phyi ma'i lam po cher 'gro dgos pa 'di ya re nga snyam pa la sogs de dag gi sdug bsngal rang thog tu blangs nas blo sbyang / yang na bsha' lug gsod sar khrid pa lta bu la bltas nas/ 'di nga'i sa ma rgan mo de yin na ji ltar byed snyam du de lug yin pa'i blo de bor nas/ snying thag pa nas rang gi ma rgan de yin par bsgom/nga'i ma rgan mo de nyes pa cung zad kyang med par gzhan gyis 'di ltar gsod na da ci byed/ nga'i ma rgan la sdug bsngal ci lta bu zhig yod snyam du snying thag pa nas rang rgyud la blang / der ma rgan mo de 'phral du shan pas gsod pa'i sdug bsngal las thar 'dod snying brtse dung dung ba skyes tsa na 'di snyam du/ da lta sbug bsngal byong ba 'di rang gi da lta'i pha ma min kyang / skye ba nas tshe rabs kyi pha ma ni nges par yin/ pha mar gyur nas da lta'i pha ma bzhin du drin chen pos bskyangs pa sha stag yin pas da lta'i pha ma dang khyad mi 'dug /'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal drag pos mnar ba'i pha ma 'di snyeng re rje/ 'di da lta nyid du myur bar nyid du skad cig nyid du sdug bsngal 'di las thar na ci ma rung snyam du snying rje drag po shas mi bzod pa mchi ma thon thon du bsgom/ der snying rje skye bar 'dug na/ sdug bsngal 'di lta bu myong ba ni/ sngon mi dge ba byas pa'i las 'bras yin/ da lta mi dge ba'i las la spyo da pa rnams kyang phyi nas 'di lta bu'i sbug bsngal myong bar nges pas snyingaXre rje snyam du/ srog gcod byed pa sogs sdug bsnga la gyi rgyu bsgrub pa rnams la dmigs nas snying rje bsgom/ de nas dmyal ba dang yi dwags sogs su skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal la dmigs nas/ de dag rang yin pa 226

dang / pha ma yi na pa sogs kyi blo bzhag ste/ snying rje bsgom pa la 'bad/ mthar khams gsum gyi sems can 'di thams cad/ nam mkhas gar khyab sems can gyis khyab cing / sems can gyis gar khyab las ngan dang sdug bsngal kyis khyab pas/ las ngan dang sdug bsngal kho na la spyod pa'i sems can 'di rnams snying re rje/ 'di thams cad rigs drug so so'i las snang sdug bsngal bag chags thams cad dang bral nas/ gtan gyi bde ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na ci ma rung snyam du snying thag pa nas bsgom/ de ltar snying rje bsgom pa de yang dang po'i gnas skabs su sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa'i sems can gang rung re re dmigs yul du byas nas de kho na la bsgo ma/ de nas rim pa bzhin du blo sbyang ste/mthar sems can thams cad la spyi khyab tu bsgom pa sogs ma byas na/ snying rje bsgom pa de yang spyi 'byams go yul lta bur shor nas ci bzhin pa mi 'ong / khyad par rang la bsten pa'i phyugs lug dang khyer rta sogs kyi sdug bsngal dang dka' las la bltas nas snying rje bsgom/ de yang da ltar rang re rnams nas rang gi sgo phyugs kyi dud 'gro rnams la sna 'bigs pa dang / bya gcod pa/ spu btogs pa/gson khrag 'byin pa sogs dmyal ba dang 'dra ba'i sdug bsngal du ma gtad nas/de dag la sdug bsngal yod snyam pa'i snang ba tsam yang mi byed par 'dug pa 'di/legs par brtags na snying rje ma bsgoms pa'i skyon yin/ legs par brtags na da lta rang gi skra nyag ma gcig 'then nas btog na yo tsha tsha zer zhing bzod mi nus pa lta bu'i zug rngu yod/ de bzhin du gnag phyugs rnam/sa lus kyi rtsid pa ci yod thams cad gcus phur brgyab nas shed kyis 'then/ shul du dmar rjen du 227

phud/ spu nyag ma re re'i shul nas khrag thigs pa re 'babs/ na tsha dang sdug bsngal ma bzod par 'khun bu byed kyang de la sdug bsngal yod snyam pa mi byed par/ rang gi lag ngor chu bur du song ba la mi bzod pa skye/ de bzhin du rta khal sogs zhon nas 'gro ba'i tshe yang rang gi 'phong na nas sga thog tu sdod mi nus par bzur te sdod dgos skabs kyang / rta khal de la ni dka' las sam sdug bsngal cung zad yod snyam pa mi byed/ cis kyang 'gro mi nus par hu thug gom rdugs pa'i skabs/ da rung yang 'dis ngan gshis byas nas mi 'gro ba yin snyam ste/zhe sdang langs nas rdeg btsog byed pa las de la sha tsha skad gcig kyang mi skye/khyad par bsha' lug sogs gsod pa'i skabs/ dang po mang pa'i khyu nas bzung ba'i tshe/ de la 'jigs skrag gi snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pas/ dang po gang du bzung sa der sha la khrag tshom 'byung / de rjes lus gnam sa bsgyur yan lag 'dreng bas bkyig mchu tha gus dkris/ dbugs phyi nang gi rgyu 'grul bcad de gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal dos drag po spyong ba'i skabs su yang da dung cung zad 'chi ba 'gor na shan pa las ngan phal cher zhe sdang langs nas 'di la 'chi rgyu mi 'dug zer te brdung rdeg sogs byed/ shi ma thag de'i pags pa bshus nang lto phyung / de ma thag gnag phyugs gzhan zhig la khong khrag bton te/ de yang lus gom tshugs mi thub par 'khyor ro ro 'gro ba zhig byas/ shi khrag dang gson khrag gnyis bsres pas sngar bsad pa de'i nang lto g.yos nas za phod pa 'di las kyi srin po dngos su 'dug da legs par bsam na dud 'gro de dag rnams kyi sdug bsngal la bltas nas/ de rang yin par bsgoms na ci 'dra zhig 'dug rang gi 228

mchu lag pas bkab nas dbugs 'gags te cung zad sdod dang / de la na tsha dang 'jigs skrag ci lta bu zhig 'dug de ltar legs par brtags nas de lta bu'i sdug bsngal drag po la khor mor spyod pa'i sems can de thams cad snying re rje/ de thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rnam grangs de dag las skyob pa'i nus pa bdag la yod na ci ma rung snyam du yang dang yang du bsgom/ khyad par byams pa dang snying rje'i mnga' bdag bla ma ser mo ba rnams yin dgos pa las/ bla ma dang ser mo ba rnams la byams pa dang snying rje spu tsam yang med par sems can sbug la gtad pa khyim pa rnams las kyang thu ba 'di sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mtha' la thug ste/ sha za dang srin po mchod gnas su byed pa'i skabs la babs pa yin/sngon bdag cag gi ston pa shākya thub pa yang 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du bor te rab tu byung / 'khor dgra bcom pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad lhung bzed dang mkhar gsil bsnams te zhabs thang du bsod snyoms la phebs pa las/ rta khal dang dre'u sogs yod pa lta ci/ bcom ldan 'das nyid la chibs pa zhig kyang chibs rgyu med pa de/ sems can sdug la gtad pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs min par dgongs nas ma chibs pa yin gyi/bcom ldan 'das thabs rdugs nas rta rgan zhig chibs rgyu ma rnyed pa ga la yin/da lta rang re'i ser mo ba rnams grong chog sogs la 'byon skabs g.yag rgan re'i sna yo long du phug nas der rnga ma'i thag pa rtsub nges pa re drangs/ de'i rgyab tu zhon nas phyag gnyis kyi shed phyung ste thag pa 'then res kyis sna nang du drud pas g.yag rgan sna'i na tsha ma bzod par skor ling byed pa na shed phyung ste lcags 229

rgyun gyis brab der 'phang la lcag gis brab pa'i na tsha ma bzod par rgyug tsa na yang sna nas 'then/ yang sna'i na tsha ma bzod pa rang sdad tsa na lcag gis brab/ de gnyis res mos kyis song song bas lus ngal dub dang sdug bsngal du rmyar/ spu nyag ma re nas rdul thigs pa re 'babs/ lce dos phyar tsam drud de 'gro mi nus par dbugs har sgra 'don pa'i tshe/ da dung yang 'di legs par mi 'gro ba ci yin snyam ste zhe sdang langs nas lcag yu dbyug pa des 'phang la brab/ de yang zhe sdang gis shed phyung ches pas dbyug pa de dum bu gnyis byas/ chag 'phro de sked gseb du drangs/ rdo mdung zhig blangs/ sga thog nas phyir la 'khor te g.yag rgan gyi tshang ra la brdung gyin 'gro ba de snying rje cung zad kyang rgyud la ma skyes pas lan/da de tsa na g.yag rgan de la rang yin pa'i blo zhig bzhag rang gi rgyab tu mi theg pa'i khur chen po zhig bskur/sna thag pas drangs/'phangs lcag gi brab/rtsibs ma yob chen gyis bcom pas mdun rgyab dang g.yi sa g.yon thams cad na zus tsha zug gi ngang la skad cig tsam yang ngal gso long med par gyen mthon po la 'dzegs/ thur gzar mo la babs/ chu chen po la 'bog thang chen po la bgrod/zas kham gcig kyang za long med par da nangs nam langs nas do dgong nyi ma dmar thag ma chad bar mi 'dod bzhin du 'gro dgos byung na/ de la dka' tshegs dang ngal dub ci lta bu zhig yod/ na tsha dang bkres skom ci lta bu zhig spyong snyam nas sdug bsngal rang thog tu blangs na/snying rje drag po shas mi bzod pa zhig mi skye ba'i thabs med/ de bzhin du spyir bla ma dang ser mo ba zhes bya ba ris med pa'i sems can thams cad kyi skyabs dang skyob pa mgon dang dpung gnyen yin 230

pa la/ rang la bza' btung dang 'bul ba byed pa'i yon bdag der rang phyogs su bzung nas de la srungs shig dang skyobs shig zer zhing dbang skur dang byin rlabs byed/ las ngan gyi rgyus 'phangs pas lus ngan blangs pa'i yi dwags dang 'byung po gnod byed kyi 'dre de gzhan phyogs su bzung / de la zhe sdang skyes te sod sod dang rgyob rgyob zer nas brdung deg gi stangs ka byed/ lha 'dre gnod byed/ de gsod rgyu dang brdung rgyu zhig tu 'dzin pa de yang rang rgyud chags sdang gi dbang du shor nas mnyam pa'i snying rje chen po ma skyes pas lan/ da legs par brtags na yon bdag las kyang gnod byed de snying je ste/ gnod byed kyi lha 'dre de las ngan gyi rgyus 'phangs/las ngan yi dwags su skyes pas/na tsha dang 'jigs skra ga mi/ snang ba dpag tu med/ rtag/ tu bkres skom dang ngal dub kho na la spyod/snang ba thams cad dogs par 'char rgyud zhe sdang dang gdug rtsub che bas shi ma thag dmyal b.raX'agro ba mang bas de las snying rje ba su yod/ yos/ bdag/ de la na tsha dang zug rngu skyes kyang des las ngan 'dzad pa ma gtogs las ngan mi gsogaka/nod byed des bsam ngan gyis gzhan la gnod pa byas pas las ngan gyi rgyus ngan song gi gting du 'phen pa yin/ des na rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje che bas drag shul dang mngon spyod kyi las kyis lha 'dre bskrad pa dang bsdigs pa sogs gsungs pa de yang / lha 'dre de kho rang snying rje bas/ dper na byes pa chung ngu nyan du ma btul pa la mas brngung rdeg byed pa lta bu dang /sdig pa dang mi dge ba kho na la longs spyod nga/'i sems/ can de las ngan gyi rgyun bcad nas rnam shes dag pa'i zhing du 'phen nus na bsgral las byed pa sogs sa/nang ba yin gyi/ yon 231

bdag dang grwa 'khor sogs rang phyogs su bzung nas de la chags/ lha 'dre dang gnod byed de gzhan phyogs su bzung nas de la sdang / chags sdang gi dbang gis rang phyogs srung ba dang gzhan phyogs brdung ba'i thabs rgyal bas gsungs pa ga la yin/ de lta bu'i chags sdang gi blo dang ldan phyin lha 'dre yid kyi gzugs can de dag bskrad pa dang brdungs pa sogs byas kyang nyan du mi btub cing slar rang la gnod pa byed/ chags sdang gi blo can lta ci/ lha 'dre rang rgyud du bzung nas song na dga' ba tsam gyi blo yod kyang lha 'dre mi thul ba/ sngon rje btsun mi la mchong lung khyung gi rdzong na bzhugs skabs/ bgegs kyi rgyal bo be nā ya kas cho 'phrul byung ste/ yo tsa ra mig phor khog tsam bsgrad pa lnga gzim khang du 'dug pa/bla ma dang yi dam la gsol ba btab rung ma song / yi dam gyi bskyed rim bsgoms nas drag sngags bzlas kyang 'gror ma 'dod pa'i tshe/ nga la lho brag mar pas/ snang srid sems su ngo sprad cing / sems nyid 'od gsal stong par ngo sprad pa yin pas/ gdon bgegs phyi rol du bzung nas song na dga' ba 'di byed don mi 'dug dgongs te/ lha 'dre rang snang du shes pa'i lta ba'i ngar gdeng skyes nas nang du 'tshangs kyis byon pas/ khong rnams skrag nas mig rig rig byed cing mi snang bar gyur/ de bzhin brag srin mo'i glu las kyang / lar bag chags bdud 'di sems las byung / /sems kyi de nyid ma shes na/ /khyod song zhig byas pas nga mi 'gro/ /rang sems stong par ma rtogs na/ /'dre nga yis mi tshad gzhan yang yod/ /rang sems rang gis ngo shes na/ /mi mthun rkyen rnams grogs su 'char/ /nga brag srin mo yang 'bangs su mchi/ /zhes pa ltar/lha 'dre rang sems su 232

shes pa'i lta ba'i gdeng dang ma ldan na/ zhe sdang gi lha 'dre 'dul ga la nus/ /de bzhin du sbyin bdag gi khyem du 'byon skabs kyang yon bdag des bshas lug ci tsam zhig bsad nas drangs kyang thugs la dogs pa tsam yang med par dgyes bzhin du gsol/ khyad par srung ba dang gsol mchod sogs byed pa'i skabs rdzas sha gtsang ma zhig dgos zer nas/da lta 'phral du bsad pa'i sha tshil khrag tsa re rlangs phal le ba de la gtsang mar 'dzin cing / de dag gis gtor ma dang mchod rdzas thams cad brgyan te rngam rngam dang rdzig rjig byed pa de dag bon dang mu stegs pa lta bu zhig gi chos lugs yin na ma gtogs nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs ni min/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs yin na chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la 'tshe ba spang dgos rgyu yin pa la/ gang du 'gro yang der sems can re'i srog la 'tshe ba byin nas bsad/ sha khrag la longs spyod na skyabs 'gro dang ci'i phyir mi 'gal/ khyad par theg pa chen po'i byang chub sems dpa'i lugs la mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi skyabs dang skyob pa byed dgos rgyu la/ gang bskyab par bya rgyu'i sems can las ngan de la snying rje spu tsam yang med par/ bskyab bya sems can de bsad nas sha khrag g.yos su byas/ skyob pa po byang chub sems dpa' de'i drung du bzhag tsa na dgyes bzhin du rkan sgra thag ge gsol 'gro na de las thu ba dang sdug pa ci yod/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung rnams las/ sha khrag mchod pa gzhung bzhin ma tshogs te/ si ha phra men thug/sa dang ci 'gal ba//yul gyi mkha' 'gro'i sku la bzod par gsol//zhes gsungs te/ sha khrag gi mchod pa gzhung bzhin du tshogs pa zhes bya ba de/ 233

gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde'i gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin du tshogs dgos pa la zer ba yin/gsang sngags kyi gzhung nas ji ltar bshad na/ sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga//bza' bca' btung ba phyi yi tshogs/ /zhes bya ste/ gsang sngags kyi dam rdzas su 'os pa'i sha lnga po/ mi sha dang / rta sha dang / khyi sha la sogs pa kha zas kyi ched du gsod par mi 'gyur sdig med kyi sha lnga po tshogs rdzas su bshams pa sha khrag mchod pa gzhung bzhin du tshogs pa yin/ de ltar ma yin par gtsang dme'i gnyis rtog gis bcings nas/ mi sha dang / khyi sha sogs la mi gtsang ba dman par 'dzin zhing kha zas kyi ched du 'phral la bsad pa sha zhim pa dang tsho ba la gtsang mar 'dzin na/ dang du blang ba'i dam tshig lnga// gtsang dmer bltas dang bag med spyad/ /ces bya ba'i gtsang dmer lta ba yin pas dang du blang ba'i dam tshig dang 'gal/ rung ba'i sha lnga po yin kyang kha zas bdud rtsir sgyur nus pa dang / dben par dngos grub sgrub pa 'i tshe ma yin par/ sha'i ro 'a sred pas grong yul du bag med du zos na/dang blang gi dam tshig bag med du spyad pa zhes bya ste/de yang 'gal/ des na rdzas sha gtsang ba zhes bya ba de yang kha zas kyi don du bsad pa ma yin zhing / rang gi las kyis shi ba'i sha zhes sems can rang gi las kyi dbang gis rgas nas tshe zad pa'am/ nad kyis shi ba la sogs pa'i sha la zer ba yin/ de ltar ma yin par 'phral du bsad pa'i sha khrag dron mo dkyil 'khor du bzhag na lha ye shes pa thams cad brgyal 'gro bar mnyam med dwags po rin po ches ga/sungs/ gzhan yang lha ye shes pa spyan drangs nas/ bsad pa'i sha khrag gis mchod na ma'i sngon du bu bshas pa dang 'dra zhes gsungs te/ dper na ma 234 ༷

mgron du bos nas de'i sngon du bu bsad pa'i sha bzhag na ma de dga' 'am mi dga'/ de bzhin du rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa'i ma bzhin du brtse bas dgongs te bzhugs pa la/ las ngan gyi gzhan dbang du gyur ba'i dud 'gro bsam med cig bsad nas sha khrag gi mchod pa byas pas rgyal ba dgyes pa'i thabs med de/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ gang zhig lus la kun nas me 'bar ba/ /'dod pa kun gyis yid bder mi 'gyur ltar/ /de bzhin sems can gnod pa byas na yang / /thugs rje che rnams dgyes pa'i thabs med do//zhes gsungs/des na bsad pa'i sha khrag kho na la longs spyod bzhin sha mchod dang khrag mchod byas te srung ma gsol mchod so/ga/sa byas tshe/ lha ye shes pa rnams dang / rgyal bstan srung ba'i chos skyong rnams kyang byang zub sems dpa' sha stag yin pas/ de dag gi shan pa'i 'dun pa lta bus sems can bsad pa'i mchod rdzas la bzhes pa lta ci/ de'i phyogs tsam du nye mi nus/ nag phyogs kyi lha 'dre mthu bo che bsad pa'i sha dron mo dang /khrag dron mo la dga' ba/ sems can la gnod pa'i las la rtag par brtson pa de dag der 'dus nas de'i sha khrag gi mchod pa byas pa la longs spyad de/ gnas skabs su dmar chog byed pa de'i rjes su 'brang zhing mthun rkyen phran bu re sgrub/ rtag par sems can la gnod pa 'ba' zhig byed pas/ na tsha dang ye 'drog glo bur du gtong zhing der yang dmar chog byed de 'ong nas sha mchod dang khrag mchod byas pas re zhig phan par ltar byed/ khong gnyis gcig grogs gcig gis byed de rtag tu 'bral ba med par sha za so la chas pa ltar/za rlom/'cha' rlom// rnyed rlom 235

kho nas rgyu/ dmar chog mkhan po de yang lha 'dre ma rungs pa de dag gis rgyud brlams pas sngar nges 'byung dang skyo shas/ dad pa dang dag snang / chos kyi snang ba yod pa de dag thams cad 'grib/ sangs rgyas nam mkhar 'phur yang dad pa dang / sems can rgyu ma lug kyang snyeng rje med par las kyi srin po dmag la chas pa ltar/gdong dmar phyur re/shes pa khro ling nge/rgyud rtsub hrag ge/rtag tu gzer re ba zhig byas/ lha 'dre'i bsdongs grogs byas pas ngag nus dang byin rlabs yod pa'i snyems 'chang zhing / shi ma thag dmyal bar rdo 'phangs pa ltar 'gro ba'am/ yang na las ngan gyi kha cung zad ma gang bas/ lha 'dre ma rungs pa'i 'khor du skyes te sems can gyi srog la dbang ba'am khra dang spyang ki la sogs rkyen bar 'gyur ba yin/ sngon chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku ring la rgyal po'i sku'i rim gror/bon po rnams kyis sha mchod dang khrag mchod byas ba'i tshe/o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ paṇa chen bi ma mi tra/ mkhan chen byang chub sems dpa' la sogs lo paṇa rnams kyis bon po'i g.yas la gzigs nas thugs shin tu ma dga' ste/ bstan pa gcig la ston pa gnyis mi 'ong / /chos lugs gcig la byed lugs gnyis mi 'byung / /chos kyi khrims dang mi mthun bon lugs 'di/ /sdig pa phal gyi thun mongs ma yin pas/ /'di 'dra byed bcug nged rnams rang yul 'gro/ zhes gsungs shing / paṇḍi ta thams cad gros med par thugs blo gcig tu gyur te/ rgyal pos chos gsungs par zhus kyang chos mi gsungs/ bzhes pa drangs kyang mi bzhes par bzhugs pa yin/ da lta rang re sngon gyi paṇa grub byang zub sems dpa' de dag gi rjes 'jug yin par rlom zhing / gsang sngags kyi cho 236

gzab mo thams cad bon du gyer te sems can la gnod pa byas na/ bstan pa'i bla btsong dkon mchog gi rkang 'dren/rang gzhan dmyal bar 'phen pa yin pas/dus rtag tu dman pa'i sa bzung / hrul po'i gos gyon/ sems can thams cad la phan ci thogs byed cing byams pa dang snying rje gnyis po 'di kho na rgyud la skye nges kyi bar du chig sgril du 'bad na kha ton dang dge sbyor/ sems can gyi 'gro don sogs g.yer po che'i chos zhig ma 'grub kyang rung ste/ chos yang dag pa sdud pa'i mdo las/sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas chos mang po la bslab par mi bgyi yi/chos gcig la bslab par bgyi'o//de gang zhe na snying rje chen po'o//gang la snying rje chen po yod pa de la sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad lag mthil du yod pa ltar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ sngon dge bshes ston pa'i drung du sku mched gsum dang khams lung pa'i slob ma yin pa'i btsun pa zhig mjal du byung ba la/ston pas pu to ba khong ci mdzad kyin gda' gsungs pas/ khong gis dge 'dun brgya phrag mang po la chos gsungs gyin gda' zhus pas/ ngo mtshar che/ de yang gcig yin gsungs/ dge bshes phu chung ba khong ci mdzad kyin gda' gsungs pas/ rang gzhan gyi yo byad mang pos rten gsum 'ba' zhig bzhengs shing gda' zhus pas sngar bzhin gsungs/ dgon pa ba khong ci mdzad kyin gda' gsungs pas/ khong sgom 'ba' zhig mdzad kyin gda' zhus pas/ sngar bzhin gsungs/ khams pa lung pa khong ci mdzad kyin gda' gsungs pas/ khong pa grog kha re ru bzhugs/ dbu btums te bshum pa 'ba' zhig mdzad cing gda' zhus pas/ ston pas dbu zhwa phud/ thugs kar thal mo sbyar/ spyan chab mang po phyung nas shin tu ngo mtshar che/ 237

chos bya ba khong gis byas pa yin/ 'di'i yon tan mang po bshad rgyu yod de/ da lta bshad na khong mi mnyes par 'dus gsungs/ khams pa lung ba khong dbu btums nas bshum pa 'ba' zhig/ mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'khor ba na sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sems can rnams la dbo/ngas nas snying rje kho na bsgo mas te bshum pa yin/de bzhin du byams pa dang snying rje gnyis po 'di gal che ba'i rgyu mtshan mang po spyan snga bas gsungs pa'i tshe/ glang thang pas phyag mdzad de/ bdag dus 'di nas bzung ste byams snying rje 'ba' zhig sgom par zhu zhus pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pas dbu zhwa phud/shin tu yang cha bzang lags zhes lan gsum gsungs/rang rgyud kyi sdig sgrib sbyo nga ba la yang snying rje las lhag pa med de/ sngon rgya gar du dam pa'i chos mngon nga/ la dgra lan ga/sum byung bas nub pa na// bram ze'i dge slong ma gsal ba'i tshul khrims zhes bya bas bdag bud med du gyur pa/ skye ba dman pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bsta/na pa ga/sal bar byed mi nus pas skyes/ pa dang 'grogs te bu bskyed la/dam pa'i chos mngon pa dar du gzhug ko/ dgongs nas/rgyal rig/sa shig dang 'dus pa las 'phags pa thogs med dang / bram ze zhig dang 'dus pas dbyig gnyen 'khrungs/ sras gnyis ka cher skyes nas pha'i las dri ba la ma na re/ khyed gnyis pha'i las kyi don du bskyed pa ma yin gyi/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar bya ba'i don du bskyed pa yin pas chos slob la/ dam pa'i chos mngon pa'i bstan pa dar ba zhig gyis shig zer bas// dbyig gnyen kha che'i 'dus bzang bi drung du mngon pa slob pa la song / thogs med kyis ri bo bya rkang can du phyin nas rgyal ba byams pa'i zhal mjal te gdams ngag zhus chog pa 238

'ig bya dbro/ngas nas byams pa bsgrub/ lo drus/ gi bar du dka' ba spyad de bsgoms pas mi lam bzang po tsam yang ma byung / der khong gis da mi 'grub pa yin pa 'dra dgongs yi chad de byon pas/ lam ka zhig na mi zhig gis lcags kyi sdong po chen po zhig ras 'jam pos phyi yin 'dug khyod kyis 'di 'di ltar phyis nas ci byed pa yin dris pas/ nga la khab med pas/ ngas 'di zad nas khab cig byed 'dod pa yin zer/ khong gi thugs dgongs la lcags kyi sdong po chen po 'di ras 'jam po 'dis phyis pas zad nas khab tu gyur ba'i dus mi 'ong / brgya la 'ong yang de'i tshe kho ga la yod/ 'jig rten pa rnams don med pa'i las la 'di tsam gyis dka' las byed pa la bltas na/ ngas dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa la snying rus ye ma nus par 'dug dbo/ngas phyir log nas byon te/ slar yang lo gsum gyi bar du bsgrubs kyang rtags tsam yang ma byung / da ni nges par mi 'grub pa 'dra dgongs nas byon pas/yang lam kha zhig na brag ri chen po dgung la reg/ pa zhis gi drung na mi zhig gi bya sgro zhig chu nang du shan nas brag de la byab cing 'dugakhyod ci byed pa yin dris pas/ 'di'i brag 'di mtho ches nas nga rang gi khang pa brag 'di'i nub na yod pa'i steng du nyi ma mi 'char bar 'dug pas/ brag 'di gzad nas med par byed pa yin zer/ khong gi thugs la yang sngar ltar dgongs nas slar log ste lo gsum du bsgrubs kyang mi lam bzang po tsam yang ma byung bas khong yi chad de/ da ni cis kyang mi 'grub par 'dus dbongs nas byon 'ongs pas/ lam kha zhis/ na khyi mo rkang pa gnyis zha ba zhi/ga khog smad thams cad 'bus g.yengs rung da dung gzhan la 'e sdang skyes nas khog stod khong gi steng du 239

zug cing khog smad drud nas 'dzin du 'ong ba ltar byed pa la/ khong snying rje drag po shas mi bzod pa zhig skyes/ sku lus kyi sha bcad de byin nas khog smad kyi 'bu bsal bar 'dod pa phyag gis bsal na 'bu bsad kyis dogs/ 'bu 'di rnams lces blangs te bsal dgos dgongs kyang khyi'i lus thams cad rul ba dang rnag gis gang pas mthong bzhin du lces reg ma nus te spyan btsums nas ljags brkyangs pas/ ljags khyi ro la ma thug par sa la thug song / spyan byes nas bltas pas khyi ro mi snang bar rje btsun byams pa 'od kor re bzhugs 'dug thugs rje re chung de tsam du zhal mi ston pa zhus pas/ ngas khyod la zhal ma bstan pa min/ nga dang khyod la 'bral ba med kyang / khyod sdig sgrib ches bas ma mthong ba yin/khyod kyi lo bcu gnyis su sgrub pa byas pas sdig sgrib cung srab pas khyi mo ru mthong zhing / da lta snying rje chen po skyes pas sgrib pa lhag ma med par dag ste nga rang dngos su mthong ba yin/ da yid mi ches na nga rang phrag par thogs la mi thams cad la ston dang gsungs/thogs med kyis byams pa phrag pa g.yas su thogs te/tshong 'dus su phyin nas mi thams cad la nga'i phrag pa na ci 'dug gsungs pas/thams cad kyis ci yang mi 'dug zer/ cung zad bag chags srab ba'i rgan mo zhig gis khyod kyi phrag pa na khyi ro rul pa zhig 'dug zer/der thogs med mgon po byams pas dga' ldan lha yul du khrid de byams chos sde lnga sogs bstan nas/slar mi yul du byon te theg pa chen po'i bstan pa dar bar mdzad pa yin/ des na sdig pa sbyong ba la yang snying rje las lhag pa'i chos med cing / byang chub kyi sems thun mong ma yin pa rgyud la skye ba'i rgyu ma nor ba yin pas thabs du ma'i 240

sgo nas snying rje 'di bsgom pa la 'bad dgos/ de ltar snying rje bsgom pa de yang ma lag sdum ma'i bu chus khur ba lta bu zhes bya ste/ ma lag pa med pa zhig gi bu chus khyer na/ bu la snying brtse ba'i sdug bsngal drag po shas mi bzod pa skye/ rang la lag pa med pas chu nang nas 'don ni mi nus/ da ci drag na snyam du thabs kho na sems shing snying nas mi bzod par 'o dod 'bod cing rgyug pa dang 'dra bar khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi chu bos khyer/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor byeng ba la shas mi bzod pa'i snying rje skye yang rang la de dag sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i nus pa med/ da ci byed snyam du snying thag pa nas bla ma dang dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs shing bsgoms par bya'o/ /de nas dga' ba bsgom pa ni/ gang zhig rigs rus stobs 'byor mnga' thang dang ldan pa la sogs mtho ris kyi yul na bde zhing skyid pa/ tshe ring ba/'khor mang ba/ longs spyod dang ldan pa zhig dmigs yul du bsams nas/de la 'gran sems dang phrag dog med par/da rung 'di bas kyang mngon mtho'i dpal gyis 'byor zhing / 'tshe ba med pa/shes rab che ba la sogs phun sum tshogs pa du mas 'byor bar shog cig /sems can gzhan rnams kyang 'di lta bu'i go 'phang la gnas na nga re dga' snyam du yang dang yang du bsgom/ de yang dang po gang la skye sla ba'i yul rang gi nye ba dang mdza' bshes la sogs pa la yon tan dang bde skyid yod pa la dmigs nas dga' ba bsgom/ de rgyud la skyes nas bar ma rnams la bsgom/ de nas rang la gnod byed kyi dgra dang khyad par phrag dog gi gnas su gyur pa thams cad la/gzhan 'byor phun tshogs la mi bzod pa'i blo ngan gyi rtsa ba drungs nas phyung ste/ 241

bde ba dang ldan pa'i cha thams cad la dga' ba khyad par can du bsgom zhing mthar dmigs ba med pa'i ngang la bzhag de yang dga' ba ni phrag dog med pa'i blo yin pas thabs sna tshogs pas blo sbyangs te phrag dog gi blo ngan 'di rgyud la mi skye ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos/ khyad par rgyal ba'i sras po byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sems can thams cad kyi don du sems bskyed nas sems can de dag thams cad gtan du bde ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang dang /'phral du bde ba mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang la bkod dgos rgyu yin pa la/sems can rang rang gi las dbang gis yon tan nam 'byor pa phra mo re thob pa la/ mi dga' ba skye ba'i thabs ci la yod/ rang rgyud phrag dog gis bslad phyin chad gzhan gyi yon tan mi mthong zhing /rang gi sdig chab po che gsog pa yin te/sngon rje btsun mi la sku bsod dang phrin las rgyas pa'i skabs/ mtshan nyid kyi ston pa dar blo zhes bya ba phrag dos skyes nas rgol du byung ba 'a / rje bcum gyis mngon mkhyen dang rdzu 'phrul ci tsam zhig/ bstan kyang yid mi ches shing log lta dang skur 'debs kho na byed pas phyis gdon chen po zhig tu skyes pa dang / yang dge bshes rtsag phu pa zhes bya ba'i mchan nyid pa zhig gis rje btsun la dug drangs pa sogs kyang phrag dog kho na'i dbang gis yin/des na phrag dog can gyi gang zag de la/sangs rgyas dngos su byon kyang 'dren mi nus te rang rgyud phras/ dog gis bslad pas gzhan gyi yon tan mi mthong / yon tan ma mthong bas dad pa spu tsam yang mi skye/ dad pa ma skyes/ nga/sa thugs rje dang byen rlabs/ kyi sno /da du mi rung /lhas byin dang legs skar gnyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi gcung yin pas khong ga/nyis 212

phrab/ dog gis rgyud 'khrug/sa te/ bcom ldan 'das la dad pa cung zad skyer ma 'dod pas tshe gcig/ tu ston pa'i drung na gnas kyang 'dul ba'i thabs med ba yin/ der ma zad gzhan la bsam pa ngan pa kho na bzung bas de la cung zad kyang mi gnod kyang rang gi sdig tshab po che gsog pa yin te/ sngon dge bshes che rab gnyis 'gran zlar yod pa la/ gcig la bud med yod zer ba thos pas nye gnas la ja zhim pa zhig skol cig gtam snyan thos zer/ ja bskol nas drangs te gtam snyan ci gsan zhus pas/rang re'i 'gran zla de la bud med byung zer lo/de kun spangs grags rgyal gyis gsan pas/ zhal nag ting song nas de gnyis sdig pa gang che'am/ gsungs zer/ de ltar phrag dog dang 'gran sems sogs rtag tu sgo ma pa de rang 'a mi phan gzhan la mi gnod/ don med du rang gi sdig gsog/ pa yin pas de lta bu'i bsam pa ngan pa de spangs te/ dus rtag tu gzhan la rigs/ dang gzug/sa dang nor dang thos pa la sog/sa yon tan dang mthun rkyen ci tsam 'byor pa la snying thag pa nas dga' ba bsgom zhing / 'di la 'di lta bu'i yon tan dang 'byor pa sogs yod pa nga re dga'/da dung 'di la 'di dag las lhag pa'i stobs dang 'byor pa thos pa yon tan la sogs pa'i dpal gyis 'byor zhing phun sum tshogs par gyur na ci ma rung snyam du snying thag pa nas bsgom/dga' ba tshad med pa rnga mos rnge'u stor nas rnyed pa lta bu zhes bya ste/ rnga mo de sems can gzhan las kyang bu la lhag par brtse ba yin pas/ de'i rnge'u de stor na de tsam gyi mya ngan che zhing / gal te rnyed na bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dga' ba skye ba de lta bur bslab bo/ de ltar tshad med pa bzhi po de dab/ byang chub kyi sems 243

mtshan nyid pa rang rgyud la skye ba'i rgyu ma nor ba yin pas/ ci nas kyang rgyud la ma skyes bar du bsgom dgos/ de ltar tshad med pa bzhi bo de yang don tshur bsdus te go sla bar byas na/ bsam pa bzang po zhig la 'du ba yin pas dus dang rnam pa thams cad du bsam pa bzang po kho na la bslab dgos/ sngon jo bo rje lha cig phyag bsnyung ba la 'brom ston gyi pang du bzhag nas 'di la khyod kyis byin rlabs shig gyis dang / khyed la bsam pa bzang po yod pa yin gsungs/bsam pa bzang po kho na gtsigs su mdzad/ khams bde byed pa la yang bsam pa bzang po byung ngam gsungs/ zhal ta mdzad ba thams cad la yang bsam pa bzang po gyis sang gsungs pa yin/ bsam pa bzang ngan 'di'i dbang gis las dkar nag dang stobs che chung thams cad kyang bsgyur 'gro ba yin/ bsam pa bzang na lus ngag gi las gang byas dge bar 'gyur ba yin te/ sngar da steng du lham krad bzhag pa'i lo rgyus lta bu dang / bsam pa ngan na rnam pa dge ba ltar snang ba rnams kyang don du mi dge bar 'gyur bas/ dus rnam pa thams cad du bsam pa bzang po la bslab dgos/ji skad du/ bsam pa bzang na sa dang lam yang bzang bsam pa ngan na sa dang lam yang ngan/ /thams cad bsam pa dag la rags las pas /rtag par bsam pa bzang la 'bad par bya//zhes gsungs/bsam pa bzang na sa dang lam yang ji ltar bzang na/ sngon rgan mo ma bu gnyis lag sbrel byas nas zu chen po zhig la 'bog pas/ma bu gnyis ka zus khyer song /mas bsam pa la bu mo 'di chus mi khyer ba zhig byung na nga rang chus khyer kyang khyer snyam/ bu mos bsam pa la/ sa ma chus ma khyer na nga rang khyer kyang khyer snyam/ gnyis kas gcig gis 244

gcig la bsam pa bzang po byed bzhin chu nang du shi bas gnyis ka tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skyes pa yin/ yang sngon bya sa ko khar/ gru zhig gi nang du btsun pa drug bang chen pa zhig dang bdun zhugs nas byin pas/ gru btang nas chu'i bzhi cha tsam song ba dang gru pa na re gru lci 'dug pas rkyal shes pa zhig yod na bobs yang na nga zu nang du 'bab pa yin pas khyed tsho'i gcig gis skya ba zungs zer ba la/ thams cad kyis chu la rkyal ba dang / skya ba 'dzin pa gnyis ka mi shes par 'dug pas/ bang phyin pas thams cad 'chi ba bas nga gcig pu shi ba drag zer nas chu la mchongs pas/ de ma thag 'ja' zug me tog gi char babs/ rkyal mi shes kyang chu'i pha ri la sleb nas ma shi ba yin/ de sngon chos byas pa zhig min kyang 'phral du bsam pa bzang po gcig skyes pa la yang de lta bu'i phan yon yod pa yin/ bsam pa ngan na sa dang lam yang ji ltar ngan na/ sngon sprang bo zhig rgya sgo'i 'gags su nyal nas rgyal po 'di mgo chad nas shi ste nga rang rgyal po byas na ji ma rung snyam pa yang dang yang du blo la skyes/ nangs par gnyid du shor nas nyal yod pa'i tshe rgyal po shing rta la zhon nas 'ong bas shing rta'i 'khor los kho'i ske la brgyab ste mgo bcad pa yin/ lar rang gis chos zhus pa'i don po dus dang rnam pa thams cad du dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis bzung nas rang rgyud la brtag dpyad ma byas na don med chags sdang gi blo drag pos las ngan tshabs po che gsog 'gro ba la tshegs med pa yin/ sprang rgan de yang 'grub mi srid pa'i bsam blo de lta bu zhig skyes pas 'bras bu 'phral du smin pa yin te/ rgyal po pho brang bi/ dbus na rin po che'i khri la bde skyid dang ldan par gzims nas bzhugs yod 245

pa'i dbu chad don kyang med/ ga/la te chad nas rgyal po grongs song yang rgyal po'i sras kyis rgyal srid mi byed/ blon po stag gzig dom dred lta bu yod pa de dag gis rgyal sa mi 'dzin par/ sprang rgan kho ser kha se rgyal sa la 'god don ci la yod/ des na rang rgyud la legs par ma brtags na/ don med du de lta bu'i bsam pa ngan pa yang skye srid pa yin pas/ dge bshes sha bo pa'i zhal nas/ srid pa mang po 'phel gyi yid kyi rgyal srid ma spyongs/ zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang / sngon bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa sbyin bdag gi khyim du bsod snyoms la spyan drangs pa'i tshe/ slong mo ba rgyal rigs kyi khye'u zhig dang /bram ze'i khye'u zhig ste gnyis yod pa/ bram ze'i rigs kyi khre'i des sangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyis bsod snyoms ma bzhes gong bslangs pas ci yang ma rnyed/rgyal rigs kyi khye'u des bzhes pa zin nas bslangs pas lhung bzed kyi lhag ma kha zas bzang po mang po rnyed/ de gnyis phyi dro lam bar 'ig tu gtam byas par/rgyal rigs kyi khye'u de na re/ gal te nga la nor dang longs spyod zhig yod na ngas bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa la ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du na bza' dang / bsod stoms kyis mchod de/ yo byad thams cad kyis bstabs nas bsnyen bkur bgyid do zer/ bram ze'i khye'u na re/ gal te nga la dbang zhig yod nas yul gyi rgyal po yin na ngas dge sbyong mgo reg de 'khor dang bcas pa'i mgo drungs nas bcad do zer/ der rgyal rigs kyi khye'u de yul gzhan zhig tu phyin nas shing sdong chen po zhig gi grib ma la bsdad pas/ shing gzhan gyi grib ma yol nas song yang khye'u yod pa'i grib ma de ma yol bar bsdad/ yul de'i rgyal po shi 246

nas sras med pas mi bsod nams dang dbang thang gang che ba de rgyal po byed do zer nas thams cad kyis btsal bas/ khye'u de gung yol kyang grib mas ma btang bar gnyid log pa mthong bas bslangs nas rgyal srid la bkod/ phyis kho rang gi 'dod pa ltar sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la yang mchod pa yin/ bram ze'i khye'u de lam 'gags zhig tu nyal bsdad pas/ shing rta 'khyams pas rke la phog ste mgo bcad pa'i lo rgyus kyang yod/des na rtag tu bsam pa bzang po kho na la bslabs na tshe 'dir yang bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub/ dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams kyis srung zhing sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob/ci byas dge bar 'gyur zhing 'chi kha gnad gcod mi 'byung /phyi ma lha dang mi yi go 'phang thob cing / mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba yin pas/ tsab tsob tu rang rgyud la mi rtog par phyag dang bskor ba kha ton dang bzlas brjod sogs dge ba rgya chen bo byed khul las/rtag tu rang gi rgyud la brtags nas bsam pa bzang po la bslab pa gal che'o//gnyis pa soms bskyed pa dngos la/ blo stobs kyi khyad par gyis dbye na gsum yod de/ rgyal po rnams dang po rang nyid kyis pha rol gyi sde thams cad zil gyis mnan/ rang phyogs kyi dpung bstod de sngon la rang nyid rgyal po byas nas/ de rjes su sde mnga' ris skyong bar 'dod 8 bzhin du/ thog mar rang nyid sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa byas nas/ de'i rjes su sems can thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par 'dod pa rgyal po lta bu'i sems bskyed/mnyan pa zhes bya ba gru ba rnams kyis rang dang grur zhugs pa'i mi la sogs pa 247

thams cad mnyam du chu'i pha rol tu 'gro bar 'dod ba ltar/ rang dang sems can thams cad lhan cig tu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa mnyan pa lta bu'i sems bskyed/ phyugs rje rnams kyis dang por phyugs lug rnams rtswa chu rnyed pa dang / 'phar spyang sogs kyis gnod pa med par byas te sngon du ded/rang nyid de'i phyi bzhin 'brangs te rjes nas 'ong ba dang 'dra bar/sngon la khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la bkod nas phyi nas rang nyid 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa dang gsum las/dang po rgyal po lta bu ni 'dod chen po'i sems bskyed ces bya ste blo stobs tha ma yin/ gnyis pa mnyan pa lta bu ni/ye shes dam pa'i sems bskyed ces bya ste/ blo stobs 'bring po yin zhing dper na rje btsun byams pa lta bu'i sems bskyed yin par gsungs/ rdzi bo lta bu ni dpe med pa'i sems bskyed ces bya ste/ shin tu blo stobs chen po dang ldan pa/ dper na rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs lta bu'i sems bskyed yin par gsungs pa yin/ sa mtshams kyis dbye na/ tshogs sbyor gyi lam na mos pas spyod pa'i sems bskyed/ sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar la lhag bsam rnam dag gi sems bskyed/ dag pa'i sa gsum na rnam par smin pa'i sems bskyed/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed dang bzhi yod/ sems bskyed rang gi ngo bos dbye na kun rdzob sems bskyed dang / don dam sems bskyed gnyis yod/ kun rdzob sems bskyed la yang nang gses kyi dbye ba gnyis te/ smon pa sems bskyed dang / 'jug pa sems bskyed gnyis/ de yang spyod 'jug las/ 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ /bye brag ji ltar shes pa 248

ltar//de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi//bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ dper na nyi ma lha sa lta bu zhig tu 'gro ba la/ dang po nga lha sar gcig 'gro snyam pa ltar du/ dang po ngas sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa zhig bya snyam pa 'gro bar 'dod pa lta bu smon pa'i sems bskyed/ lha sar 'gro ba dngos kyi gro chas dang khal rta sogs sta gon byas nas dngos su lam du zhugs te 'gro ba ltar/ sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i ched du sbyin pa gtong / tshul khrims bsrung /bzod pa bsgom/brtson 'grus brtsam/bsam gtan la mnyam par 'jogashes rab la blo sbyang snyam nas lam pha rol tu phyin pa drug la dngos su slob pa ni/'gro ba dngos lta bu 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems yin/ de lta bu'i smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed de gnyis ka kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems yin zhing /tshogs sbyor gyi lam du de lta bu'i sems bskyed la bsten nas yun ring bor blo sbyangs pa'i mthu las/ mthar mthong lam du chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs de bzhin nyid/ spros pa thams cad bral ba'i ye shes stong pa nyid kyi don mngon sum du rtogs pa ni don dam pa'i sems bskyed yin/ don dam sems bskyed mtshan nyid pa bsgom stobs kyis thob dgos pas cho ga la mi ltos/ 'dir las dang po pas kun rdzob sems bskyed cho ga la ltos pa yin pas bla ma las len tshul sems bskyed 'bog chog ltar bya/ de ltar thob pa'i sems bskyed de mi nyams shing gong du 'phel ba'i phyir du dus dang rnam pa thams cad du 'di ltar yang dang yang du blang dgos/ de yang mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems 249

dpa' la sogs pa thams cad sems bskyed kyi dbang por skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing ji lta ba bzhin gsal gdab/ 'di ltar nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa'i sems can 'di thams cad tshe rabs thog ma med pa tshun chad du rang gi pha mar ma gyur pa ni gcig kyang med/ pha mar gyur pa'i tshe da lta'i pha ma bzhin du gces spras sna tshogs kyis bskyangs/zas su phud byen/gos kyi rtse g.yogs/shin tu byams pa'i sgo nas bskyed bsrings pa'i drin can sha stag yin par nges la/ de lta bu'i pha ma drin can de dag thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po'i rba la bying /gti mug gi mun pa 'thug pos bsgribs/ lam dang lam ma yin pa'i blang dor ni mi shes/yang dag pa'i lam ston gyi bshes gnyen dang ni bral/skyabs dang skyob pa/mgon dang dpung gnyen/ re ltos dang skyabs gnas su yang med par long ba bshes bral thang stong du 'khyams pa lta bu'i ma rgan de thams cad 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir bzhag nas/ rang nyid ga/cig/ pu zhig thar pa la dbos pa ci yod/de'i phyir bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas sngon gyi rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mdzad spyod rlabs po che la bslab cing /'khor ba na sems can gcig kyang mi gnas pa/ de tsam du brtson 'grus brtsam mo snyam pas/ ho sna tshogs snang ba chu zla'i rdzun ris kyis/'khor ba lu gu rgyud du 'khyams pa'i 'gro/ /rang rig 'od gsal dbyings su ngal gso phyir/ /tshad med bzhi yi ngang nas sems bskyed do/ /zhes ci mang du brjod pa'i mthar/ tshogs zhing bi lha tshog/sa rnams la mos gus dung dung pa zhig byas pas/lha tshogs thams cad mtha' nas rim pa bzhin du 'od du yal te dbus kyi 250

bla ma skyabs gsum kun 'dus la thim/ bla ma yang 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis skyabs yul lha tshogs de dag gi thugs rgyud na bzhugs pa'i don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems rang rgyud la lhang gis skyed par bsam/ byang chub sems mchog rin po che/ /ma skyes pa rnams skye gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa yang / /gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /ces smon lam dang / 'jam dpal dpa' bos sogs kyis bsngo ba bya/ de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa 'di ni/rgyal bas chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong ga/sungs pa thams cad kyi snying po dril dril pa/ yod na des chog med na thabs chags kyi gdams pa/ nad brgya sman gcig sman dkar po chig thub lta bu yin/ gzhan tshogs bsags pa/ sgrib pa sbya nga pa/lha bsgom pa/ sngags bzlas pa la sogs chos nyams su len pa thams cad kyang byang chub kyi sems yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'di rgyud la skye ba'i thabs tsam du nyams su len pa yi na gyi/ byang chub kyi sems la ma bsten par rang rang so so'i lam gyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par mi nus/ byang chub kyi sems 'di rgyud la skyes na chos gang bsgrub thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur 'gro ba yin pas/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du rang rgyud la byang chub kyi sems nyag ma re skye ba'i thabs la sgo du ma nas bslab/ rang la byang zub kyi sems kyi man ngag ston pa'i bla ma de yang chos theg pa chen po'i lam du 'dzud pa po yin pas// gdams ngag ga/zhan ston pa las bka' drin lhas/ par che ba yin te/ jo bo rje lha cig sgas bla ma sa/'an gyi mtshan nas brjod pa'i tshe phyag thugs kar thal mo sbyar/ jo bo gser gling pa'i mchan nas brjod pa'i tshe/ 25 1

phyag thal mo spyi bor sbyar te spyan chab g.yo bzhin du gsung ba la/ slob ma rnams kyis jo bos bla ma rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod pa la khyad par 'di tsam mdzad pa bla ma de rnams kyi thugs rgyud kyi yon tan la che chung yod pa yin nam/ bka' drin la che chung gi khyad yod pa gang yin zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/nga'i bla ma de thams cad grub pa thob pa sha stag yin pas yon tan la che chung med/bka' drin la che chung yod de/ nga'i rgyud kyi byang chub kyi sems nyag ma gcig po 'di jo bo gser gling pa'i bka' drin gyis thob pa yin pas khong bka' drin che gsungs/de ltar sems bskyed pa de yang / sems mchog bskyed pa mi gzu skyes pa gtso/zhes pa yin pas/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyis sems rang rgyud la nges par skyes pa zhig dgos kyi/ don sems thog tu ma blangs par sems bskyed 'bum phrag mang po bton kyang snying po til 'bru tsam yang med de/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar byang chub tu sems bskyed par khas blangs nas de bzhin du mi byed na/ rgyal ba sras bcas bslu bar 'gyur ba yin pas nyes pa lci ba las med pas/ dus rtag tu sems can thams cad la g.yo sgyu spangs te/ byang chub kyi sems rgyud la bskyed pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /gsum pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i bslab bya bstan pa la/ byang chub smon pa'i bslab bya bdag gzhan mnyam pa/ brje ba/ bdag bas gzhan gces pa bsgom pa dang gsum/'jug pa'i bslab bya pha rol tu phyin pa drug nyams su blang ba rnams las/dang po bdag gzhan mnyam pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa ni/ 'di ltar thog ma med pa'i dus nas 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po 'dir 'khyams pa'i rgyu nga 252

med la nga dang / bdag med la bdag tu bzung nas bdag kho na gces par bzung bas lan pa yin/ des na 'di ltar brtag dgos te/ da lta rang gis dus dang rnam pa thams cad du rang la bde ba kho na 'dod cing sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa sna gcig kyang mi 'dod/ tha na lus la tsher ma zug pa dang / me stag lhung ba tsam yang 'phral du sdug bsngal mi bzod pa skyes nas sa tsha tsha zer zhing bsran mi bzod/ rgyab nas shig gis zos na yang de ma thag de la zhe sdang drag po zhig glo bur du langs te bsnyabs nas shig de bzung / sen mo gcig gi steng du bzhag nas gcig gis shed kyis gcur/ shig bsad zin kyang da dung yang zhe sdang gi dbang gis sen mo yang yang brdar bar byed/ lar da lta phal cher shig bsad pa la sdig pa med snyam pa 'dug kyang / shig gsod pa 'di thams cad kun slong zhe sdang gis bslangs pa yin pas dmyal ba bsdus 'joms su skyes pa'i rgyu ma nor ba yin/ des na rang la sdug bsngal chung ngu de tsam yang mi bzod par/ de'i lan du gzhan la gnod pa dang sdug bsngal chen po byed pa 'di ngo re tsha/ khams gsum gyi sems can 'di dag thams cad kyang rang la bde ba thams cad 'dod/sdug bsngal sna gcig kyang mi 'dod pa rang dang 'dra ba kho na yin/ de ltar bde ba ni 'dod/ sdug bsngal ni mi 'dod kyang / bde ba'i rgyu chos dge ba bcu sgrub mi shes par/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba kho na la brtson pas zhe 'dod dang lag len phyin ci log tu gyur te/ sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig gis gdung ba'i sems can 'di thams cad thog ma med pa'i dus nas bdag gi pha ma ma byas pa ni gcig kyang med/ bdag da res mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dam pas rjes su bzung / dam pa'i 253

chos kyi sgor zhugs/ khe nyen gyi khyad par shes pa yin pas/ rbongs pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i ma rgan sems can thams cad rang dang khyad par med par brtse bas skyong / log spub dang phyogs ris bzod par byas te/dgra gnyen mnyam pa nyid du bsgom par bya'o/ /snyam du yang yang bsgom/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du rang la phan pa dang bde ba'i dngos po ci ltar 'dod pa de gzhan yang de ltar 'dod pas/ rang gi bde ba bsgrub pa'i ched du 'bad rtsol dang brtson 'grus byed pa ltar/ gzhan gyi bde ba sgrub pa'i ched du yang de ltar brtson/ rang la sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa phra mo tsam yang spong ba la brtson pa ltar/ gzhan la yang sdus bsngal phra mo tshun chad spong pa la brtson/ rang la bde skyid dang longs spyod sogs yod na dga' ba ltar/ gzhan la bde skyid dang longs spyod sogs yod pa la snying thag pa nas dga' ba bsgom/ mdor na khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad rang dang dbyer med du bltas nas/ 'phral dang yun gyi bde ba 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i thabs kho na lhur len dgos pa yin te/ rje dam pa sangs rgyas la/ drung pa gzi rna can gyis gdams ngag tshig gcig gis chog pa zhig zhus pas/ khyed rang ci ltar 'dod pa de gzhan rnams kyang de ltar 'dod pa yin pas de dang sbyor cig gsungs/ des na rang la gces par 'dzin pa dang / gzhan la sdang bar 'dzin pa'i chags sdang gi blo ngan rtsa ba drungs nas phyungs te bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa bdag gzhan brje ba byang chub kyi sems ni/ dngos su na tsha dang bkres skom la sogs sdug bsngal gyis gdung ba'i sems can mthong chos su yod pa'am/ min na sdug bsngal gyis gdung ba'i 254
