sems can zhig mdun du bsams nas/ rang gi dbugs phyir rgyu—ba'i tshe/ bdag gi bde ba dang legs pa lus dang longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa gos phud de g.yogs pa ltar khong la sbyin/ khong gi sdug bsngal ci yod pa de dag thams cad rang nyid kyi dang du blang bar bsam pa dang lhan cig dbugs nang du rngubs pas/ de nyid bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral bar bsam pa'i gtong len sems can gcig nas thams cad kyi bar la rim par bsgom/ dngos su rang la mi 'dod pa dang sdug bsngal la sogs pa byung ba'i tshe yang / khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas na 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can du ma yod pa de dag thams cad kyang snying re rje/ de thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi skal pa bdag la smin zhing / de dag thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral/ bde ba dang ldan par shog cig snyam du snying thag pa nas bsgom/ rang la bde ba dang skyid pa la sogs pa byung na/ bdag gi bde ba 'dis sems can thams cad bde bar gyur cig snyam du bsgom/de ltar bdag gzhan brje ba byang chub kyi sems 'di ni/chos theg pa chen po'i lam du zhugs pa thams cad kyi bsgom bya mthar thug gi snying po ma nor ba yin te/ 'di lan cig rgyud la skyes bas kyang bskal pa mang po'i sdig sgrib 'dag bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs/ ngan song dang ngan 'gro log par spung ba'i skye gnas las thar bar 'gyur ba yin te/sngon bdag cag gi ston pa 'di shing rta 'dren pa'i dmyal bar skyes pa'i tshe/grogs ka ma ru ba bya ba dang khong gnyis kyis dmyal ba'i shing rta 'dren pa las/khong gnyis ka stobs chung 'dren ma nus pa la/ dmyal srung rnams kyis mtshon cha 255

rab tu 'bar bas bsnun zhing 'tshog pas shin tu sdug bsngal bas/ khong gis bsam pa la/nged gnyis kas drangs kyang mi 'drong bar sdug bsngal bar mtshungs par 'dug pa la/ bdag gcig pus sdug bsngal bar drangs la/ 'di bde bar gzhug dgos dgongs te/ dmyal srung rnams la 'di'i thag pa yang bdag gi gnya' ba la thogs shig bdag gcig pus shing rta drang bar bya'o byas pas/dmyal srung khros te/ sems can rang rang gi las la spyod pa la sus ci bya zer nas khong gi dbu la tho lum bsnun pas/ bsam pa bzang po'i mthus dmyal ba nas tshe 'phos te lha yul du skyes/ 'di thub pa'i gzhan phan gyi thog ma yin par gsungs/de bzhin du sngon bcom ldan 'das nyid ded dpon mdza' bo'i bu mor skyes pa'i tshe yang bdag gzhan brje ba 'di thugs rgyud la skyes ma thag ngan song gi sdug bsngal las grol pa yin te/ de yang sngon khyim bdag mdza' bo zhes bya ba zhig gi bu skyes tshad shi nas/ theng cig bu zhig skyes pa sos su re nas ming bu mor btags/khyem bdag rgya mtshor nor bu len du byen pas gru gzings zhig ste shi/bu de cher skyes nas rang gi ma la pha'i rigs gang yin dris pas/drang por brjod na rgya mtshor song gis dogs nas 'bru 'tshong ba'i rigs yin byas pas/ des kyang 'bru tshong byas pas nyin re bzhin karsha pa ṇi bzhi re rnyed pas ma la bsnyen bkur byas pa na/ 'bru tshong byed pa gzhan rnams kyis khyed 'bru tshong byed pa'i rigs ma yin pas/ 'bru tshong byed pa mi rigs so zer nas bkag pa la/ khong slar 'ong nas yang ma la rigs gang yin dris pas/ spos tshong ba'i rigs yin zer bas/ yang spos 'tshong byas te nyin re bzhin karsha pa ṇi brgyad re rnyed pa ma 256

la zhabs tog byas/ yang spos 'tshong rnams kyis bkag pas gos 'tshong ba'i rigs yin zer nas gos btsongs pas/ nyin re bzhin ka zla pa ṇi bcu drug re rnyed pa ma la byin/ yang gos 'tshong ba rnams kyis bkag pas rin po che 'tshong ba'i rigs yin zer nas rin po che 'tshong ba'i las byas pas/ nyin re bzhin karsha pa ṇi sum cu so gnyis re rnyed pa yang ma la byen/ der tshong pa gzhan rnams kyis khyed rgya mtsho nas nor bu lon pa'i rigs yin pas rang gi rigs kyi las gyis shig zer bas/ khong khyim du 'ong nas ma la/ nga rang nor bu lon pa'i rigs yin par 'dug pas/rgya mtsho chen por nor bu len du 'gro ba yin zer ba la/ ma na re/ khyod nor bu lon pa'i rigs yin kyang / khyod kyi pha dang mes po la sogs pa thams cad rgya mtshor nor bu len du phyin nas shi ba yin pas/ khyod kyang song na 'chir 'ong pas ma 'gro bar 'dir sdod la tshong gyis byas kyang/ kho nyan du ma btub par rgya mtshor 'gro ba'i chas thams cad sta gon byas nas/ 'gro ba'i tshe mas gtong ma phod par bu'i gos kyi mtha' nas bzung ste ngus pas bu khros te nga rang rgya mtshor 'gro ba la khyod kyis bkra mi shis pa byas te ngus zer nas ma yi mgo la rdog pas bsnun nas song bas rgya mtshor gru gzings zhig ste khong thams cad chur byeng ste phal cher shi/khos shing leb cig la 'jus pas mtsho gling zhig tu thon/ der dga' ba zhes bya ba'i grong rin po che'i khang pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar phyin pas/mdzes sdug gi lha mo bzhi byung ste/ dar zab 'bol brtsegs kyi gdan bting / dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi mchod pa phul te 'gro bar rtsom pa na khyod lho phyogs su ma 'gro zhig nyes pa chen po 'byung nyen yod zer kyang / ma 257

nyan par phyin pas/dga' ba can zhes bya ba'i grong sngar bas mdzes par sleb ste/mdzes sdug gi bu mo brgyad kyis sngar ltar zhabs tog byas te/lho phyogs su ma 'gro zhig nyes pa 'byung ngo zer yang ma nyan par phyin pas/ ra ro zhes bya'i grong sngar bas phun sum tshogs par slebs te/ mdzes sdug gi lha mo bcu drug gis bsus nas zhabs tog byas te lho phyogs su ma 'gro zhig nyes pa chen po 'byung ngo zer/yang phyin pas mkhar dkar po rtse mo dgung la reg pa zhig 'dug pa bla ma tshangs pa'i mkhar zhes bya ba yin te/ der phyin pas mdzes sdug gi lha mo sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis bsus nas dar zab 'bol brtsegs kyi gdan bting / dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi mchod pa phul te 'dir sdod zer yang khong 'gro 'dod pa zhig byung nas 'gro bar rtsom pa na/ khyod ci nas 'gro yang lho phyogs su ma 'gro zhig nyes pa 'byung ngo zer/ 'on kyang lho phyogs su 'gro 'dod pa zhig byung nas phyin pas lcags kyi mkhar dgung la reg pa zhig gi sgo drung na/ mi nag po mig dmar ljig ge ba lag na lcags kyi dbyug pa ring po thog pa zhig 'dug pa la mkhar 'di'i nang na ci yod pa yin dris pas/ ci yang mi smra bar 'dug drung du phyin pas de 'dra ba mang po 'dug de dag mthong ba na khong sha zing spu zing byed cing nyes pa na nyes pa/ nyes ba 'byung zer ba de 'di yin par 'dug dgongs bzhin mkhar de'i nang du phyin pas/mi zhig gi mgo la lcags kyi 'khor lo zhig 'khor te klad pa skya tha la la gtor gyin 'dug khyod las ci byas ba yin dris pas/ nga ma'i mgo la rdog pa bsnun pa'i rnam smin myong ba yin/ khyod bla ma tshangs pa'i mkhar gyi bde skyid de la longs spyod nas mi 'dug par 'dir sdug bsngal nyo ru ci phyir 258

'ong ba yin zer bas/'o na nga yang 'dir las kyis khrid pa yin pa 'dra dgongs pas/ de ma thag nam mkha' nas/ gang bcings pa de nyid grol bar gyur cigagang grol ba de nyid bcing bar gyur cig /zer ba'i sgra grags te 'khor lo khong gi dbu thog tu 'khor nas sngar ltar klad pa skya tha la la gtor zhing na tsha dang sdug bsngal drag po bzod dka' ba byung bas/ de'i rkyen gyis khong rang 'dra ba'i sems can rnams la snying rje drag po skyes te/ 'khor ba'i gnas ris 'di na nga dang 'dra bar ma'i mgo la rdog pa bsnun te sdug bsngal spyong ba'i sems can yang du ma yod/ de dag thams cad kyis sdug bsngal kyang bdag la smin te bdag kho nas myong bar shog cig /sems can gzhan thams cad kyi 'di 'dra ba'i sdug bsngal skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du mi myong bar shog cig snyam pa byung bas/de ma thag 'khor lo nam mkha' la 'phags te/ khong sdug bsngal las grol nas tā la bdun srid kyi steng na bde cham me 'dug de lta bu'i bdag gzhan brje ba byang chub kyi sems 'di ni/byang chub bsgrub pa la med du mi rung ba'i chos mthar thug pa yin pas/ sngon bka' gdams kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyang thugs dam gyi mthil 'di la mdzad pa yin te/ sngon dge bshes 'chad kha ba de gsar rnying gi chos dang tshad ma'i pu ste mang po mkhyen pa yin pa la/ skabs shig dge bshes lcags shing ba'i drung du byon pas/khong gi dbu sngas na dpe chung pu ste zhig 'dug de zhal bye nas gzigs pas de'i nang na/khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la sbyin/ /gyong dang bub kha rang gis blang / /zer ba zhig 'dug pas/ chos ngo mtshar can zhig yin par 'dug dgongs nas/ chos 'di ji skad bya ba yin gsungs pas/ 259

'di glang thang pa'i tshig rkang brgyad ma bya ba yin zer/ 'di'i gdams ngag de su la yod dris pas/ dge bshes glang thang pa la yod zer/ de zhu ru 'gro dgongs te lha sar byon/ zhag 'ga' bskor ba mdzad nas bzhugs pas/ dgong cig glang thang nas 'ong ba'i mdze pho gcig gis glang thang pa grong zer/gdan sa pa ci 'dra yod dris pas zhang zhung ba dang / mdo sde pa bya ba gnyis yod de khong gnyis gdan sa su byed la mi 'chams par 'dug zer/ khong rnam pa gnyis gdan sa ngas byed kyi pham rgyal brtsad nas ma 'chams pa min/ zhang zhung pa na re khyed bsgres shos lags pas gdan sa mdzad par zhu/ ngas kyang glang thang pa dang khyad med du 'khur zer/ mdo sde pa na re khyed yon tan che bas gdan sa mdzad par zhu zer/ khong gnyis dag snang sbyong nges yin kyang / khong gis bla ma'i gdan sa la ma 'chams zer ba skyon can du go nas/ de gnyis mi 'chams lugs kyi chos de med par 'dug gdams ngag de yod pa su drag zhes rtsad bcad pas/ thams cad kyis sha ra ba drag zer/ sha ra ba de dge 'dun stong re tsam la pu ste mang po'i gzhung bshad mdzad cing 'dug pa la/zhag 'ga' nyan yang khong 'dod pa'i chos kyi tshig zur tsam yang ma byung / 'di la yang chos de e yod mi shes par 'dugayod med dris la yod na sdod/ med na 'gro dgos dgongs te/ sha ra ba mchod rten la bskor ba mdzad pa'i drung du phyin nas na bza' bting ste/ 'di la cung zhig bzhugs par zhu/ zhu ba cig bdog lags zhu pas/ jo bo khyed la gros thag ma chod pa ci yod/ngas ni 'dun ma thams cad stan thog tu bcad pa yin gsungs/der khong gis bdag gis mthong ba'i chos zhig na/khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la sbyin// 260

spyong dang bub kha rang gis blang / /bya ba gcig gda'/ der bdag gi blo la 'phrod pa zhig byung ste/ chos de zab mi zab ci ltar lags zhus pas/ jo bo de khyed kyi blo la 'phrod rung mi 'phrod rung /sangs rgyas thob par mi 'dod na ma gtogs/ thob par 'dod na chos de med thabs med pa zhig yin gsungs/ de'i ga/dmas ngag de bla ma la yod dam zhus pas yod/ nga'i nyams len thams cad kyi gtso bo de yin gsungs/ 'o na gdams ngag de bdag la gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ khyod yun ring por nga'i rtsar sdod nus sam nus na ster gsungs/ der khong nas lo drug la blo sbyong tshar gcig nyams khrid du byas te bsgoms pas bdag gces 'dzin gyi 'khri ba gtan nas med pa zhig byung ba yin/ des na bdag gzhan brje ba byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa 'di ni/tshe 'dir yang na tsha dang sdug bsngal la sogs zhi ba/ lha 'dre dang gdon bgegs 'dul ba la sogs pa la yang 'di las lhag pa'i gdams pa med pas/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du bdag gces 'dzin gyi blo ngan 'di dug ltar spangs te/ bdag gzhan brje ba byang chub kyi sems 'di bsgom pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /gsum pa bdag bas gzhan gces pa bsgom pa ni/ bdag 'khor bar gnas rung / dmyal bar skyes rung / na rung / tsha rung / nyams nyes ci byung yang bzod par bya yi/sems can gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin par shog cigabadag gi bde ba dang dge ba'i 'bras bu khong la rdzogs par shog cig snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsam zhing dngos su yang de ltar nyams su blang ba ste/ dper na jo bo'i bla ma byams pa'i rnal 'byoྈ pa dang / dharma ra khri ta dang / bdag cag gi ston 261

pa 'di rgyal po padma ra skru skye ba bzhes pa dang /rus sbal du skye ba bzhes pa dang /rgyal po gtsug na nor bur skye ba bzhes pa'i dus la sogs pa ltar yin te/ de yang jo bo'i bla ma byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa bya ba des chos gsungs pa'i rtsa ru mi gcig gis khyi la rdo brgyab pas/bla mas sa na na gsungs nas khri thog nas 'gyel/gzhan rnams kyis khye la ci yang mi lto bar 'dug pa la tshul 'chos re che snyam pa byung bas/ bla mas de mkhyen nas sku rgyab bstan pas khyi la rdo brgyab pa'i thad na khyu re skrangs 'dug pas thams cad yid ches te/khyi la rdo brgyab pa'i na tsha dngos su khong gis blangs pa yin/ de bzhin bla ma dharma ra khri ta bya ba de dang po nyan thos bye zag spru ba'i bka ta yin/sku tshe 'di la sngon chad theg chen gyi chos ma thos kyang /theg chen gyi rigs la gnas pas snying rje chen po rtsol med du mnga'/ khong bzhugs pa'i nye 'khor du mi zhig nad drag po zhig gis jebs pa la/sman pa na re/nad 'di la mi gson po'i sha zhig yod na phan te mi rnyed/gzhan thabs med zer/des phan na ngas sbyin gyis gsungs nas rang gi brla sha bcad nas byen/ nad pas sha de zos pas phan/ khong la stong nyid ma rtogs pas zug rngu chen po byung yang snying rje che bas 'gyod pa ma skyes/ nad pa la phan nam dris pas/ kho na re bdag gi nad la phan lags te khyed 'o brgyal du bcug zer/ khyed bde na nga shi yang bzod gsungs/ zug che bas mnal cung zad kyang ma byung / tho rang mnal zim tsam cig byung ba'i mnal lam na/ mi dkar po zhig byung nas byang chub thob par 'dod pas khyod kyi 'di lta bu'i dka' ba spyad dgos/ legs so legs so gsungs nas rma la ljags mchil btab nas phyag gis byabs pas rben pa'ang 262

med par song ba mis/ mnal sad tsa na de bzhin song 'dug mi de thugs rje chen po yin par 'dug de nas gnas lugs kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin thugs la 'khrungs te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dbu ma rig pa'i tshogs kyi tshig rnams zhal du sha ra ra 'don pa zhig byung bar gda'/yang sngon thub pa 'di rgyal po padma bya bar 'khrungs pa'i dus su/ dus gcig gi tshe khong gi mnga' ris su nad yams chen po byung nas mi mang po shi bas/ rgyal bos sman pa rnams bos nas/'di la cis phan dris pas/nad 'di la nya ro nyi ta'i sha yod na phan/ gzhan gang phan nad kyi grib kyis rmugs nas mi shes par 'dug zhus pas/ rgyal pos dus bzang la babs pa'i snga dro khrus byas/gos gsar pa gyon/gso sbyong blangs/dkon mchog la mchod pa rgya chen po phul/ gsol ba drag po btab nas/ bdag shi ma thag chu klung ldog byed du nya ro hi tar skye bar gyur cig ces smon lam btab ste/khang bzang khru stong yod pa'i kha nas mchong ngo / de ma thag chu der nya der brdzus nas skyes/ de nas mi'i skad du nga nya ro nyi ta yin pas/ nga'i sha longs la zo zhig ces smras pas thams cad kyi sha blangs te/ gzhogs gcig gi sha zad tsa na/gzhogs bsgyur cing bcad pas gcig zad tsam na gcig gi sha skyes te/ de ltar res mos kyis zos pas nad pa thams cad la phan no/ /der mi thams cad la nga khyed tsho'i rgyal po padma yin te/ngas khyed rnams nad las skyob pa'i ched du rang gi srog blos btang nas nya ro hi tar skyes pa yin pas/ khyed tshos nga la drin lan du sdig pa spongs la dge ba ci nus sgrubs shig gsungs pas/ de dag gis kyang bka' bzhin du bsgrubs pas/ de nas bzung ste de dag ngan 'gro log par ma 263

lhung ngo / /gzhan yang thub pa 'di nyid rus sbal chen po zhig tu 'khrungs pa'i dus su/tshong ba lnga brgya rgya mtshor phyin pas gru zhig ste/'chi la thug pa la rus sbal gyis mi'i skad du thams cad nga la zhon cig ngas bsgral gyis gsungs nas tshong pa thams cad khur te bsgral bas ngal shing dub ste mtsho mthar gnyid pas/ sbrang bu ke ta ka brgyad khris khong gi khrag 'jib pas/gnyid sad de bltas pas sprang bu mang po 'dug chur phyin pa'am 'gre ldog byas na sbrang bu 'chi bar dogs nas de ka la bzhugs te sku srog btang bas/ sangs rgyas pa'i dus su sbrang bu rnams lha brgyad khrir gyur nas chos nyan pas/ de dag gis bden pa mthong pa yin/ yang thub pa 'di yul sha ke ta bya bar rgyal po gser gyi gtsug tor bya ba dang / btsun mo mdzes ldan dga' byed ma'i sras su 'khrungs/ 'di'i dbu la nor bu rin po che'i gtsug tor yod pa las bdud rtsi 'bab cing de lcags la reg pas/ lcags rnams gser du sgyur bar nus ba zhig rang chas su byung bas/ de'i mtshan yang gtsug na nor bu zhes bya bar btags so//'di 'khrungs dus rin po che sna tshogs kyi char yang babs so/ /de la glang po bzang po'i ri bya ba'i glang po'i mchog cig kyang yod do/ /rgyal po des 'jig rten chos bzhin du skyong zhing rtag tu sbyin pa rgya chen po byas pas/ phongs pa dang slong pa rgyun chad par byas so/ /drang srong 'bri khu bya ba la padma las skyes pa'i bu mo mtshan ldan cig yod pa/ rgyal po la btsun mor phul lo/ /de la sras padma'i gtsug tor zhes bya ba rgyal po nyid dang mtshungs pa zhig btsas so/ /de nas rgyal po mchod sbyin rgya chen po byed par 'dod nas/ drang srong 'bri khu dang / rgyal po bzod dka' sogs skyes bo mang po bsdus so/ /de'i tshe 264

brgya byen gyis rgyal po'i bsam pa brtags pa'i phyir/ srin por sprul nas sbyin sreg gi me nang nas 'thon te/ rgyal po'i drung du 'ong nas bza' btung bslangs so/ /rgyal pos bza' btung sna tshogs byin pas bzar ma 'dod/ cung zad bgad nas nga la bsad ma thag pa'i sha khrag dron mo dgos zhes smras pas/ rgyal po cung zad mya ngan du gyur te/ 'tshe ba mi byed pas de 'dra mi rnyed cing / bdag gi srog bcad kyang 'tshe ba byed par mi nus la/ ma byin na 'di yang re thag 'chad na ji ltar bya dgongs pas/ da ni rang gi sha khrag sbyin pa'i dus la bab po snyam ste nga rang gi sha khrag sbyin gyis gsungs pas/ 'khor rnams rtab rtab por gyur te thams cad kyis bzlog kyang ma bzlog par/ rang gi rtse chung la gtar nas khrag 'thung du bcug pas/des kyang mgrin par thug gi bar du 'thungs so//yang rang gi sha rnams bcad cing byin pas des kyang rus pa la thug gi bar du zos pas/'khor thams cad mya ngan gyis non zhing / khyad par btsun mo brgyal nas sa la 'gyel lo/ /da dung yang rgyal po dran pa ma nyams par 'dug pas/ brgya byin shin tu rangs ste/ bdag ni brgya byin lags pas sha khrag mi 'tshal gyi/ sbyin pa'i 'phro gcad du gsol/ zhes smras nas/ lha'i bdud rtsi blangs nas rgyal po'i rma la btab pas rgyal po'ang snga ma kho na bzhin gyur to/ /de nas rgyal pos glang po bzang po'i ri mdun na 'don tshangs pa'i shing rta la phul lo/ /de'i tshe drang srong ma ru rtse'i slob ma bsam gtan thob pa zhig byung ba la bkur ste chen po byas nas khyed ci bzhed dris pas/ nga'i slob dpon la rig byed bslab pa'i yon du/ slob dpon rgas shing g.yog gis phongs pas/ g.yog zhig dbul bar 'dod nas khyed kyi 265

btsun mo dang sras slong du mchis so byas pas/ rgyal pos kyang gnang ngo / des kyang khyer te slob dpon la phul lo/ /rgyal po bzod dka' glang po la chags nas rang gi yul du log ste/ glang po nga la sbyin dgos zer ba'i 'phrin btang bas/ glang po bram ze la byin tshar byas kyang ma nyan par/ glang po mi ster na dmag byed zer nas/dmag khyer byung ba la/rgyal po gtsug na shin tu yid dbyung bar gyur te/kye ma 'dod pa'i dbang gis mdza' bshes kyi dam pa nyid kyang skad cig gis dgra'i mchog tu gyur to/ bdag gis g.yul bshams na bde blag tu thub ste/sems can mang po la gnod pas bdag rang 'bros par bya dgongs pa dang /rang sangs rgyas bzhi drung du byon nas/ rgyal po chen po nags su gshegs pa'i dus la bab po gsungs nas rdzu 'phrul gzhan brten gyis nags su gshegs so/der blon po rnams kyis ma ru tse can du sras slong du phyin pas des kyang byin no/ /de nas sras kyis dmag dpon byas te 'thabs pas bzod dka' pham nas rang gi gnas su bros so/ /der bzod dka' bsam sbyor ngan pa'i dbang gis yul der nad dang mu ge chen po byung ba la/ bzod dkas bram ze rnams la cis phan dris pas/ rgyal po gtsug na'i gtsug tor gyi nor bu de yod na phan pas slong du phyin pa drag zer ro/ /mi ster las che byas pas/ de la slong ba la mi ster ba med ces grags pas cis kyang ster zer nas/ bram ze zhig slong du btang ngo / /de'i tshe rgyal po gtsug na nags tshal gyi gnas rnams lta zhing song song bas ma ru tse'i gnas dang nye bo zhig tu phyin to/ /de'i tshe gtsug na'i btsun mos rtsa ba dang lo ma la sogs tshol ba la nags su rgyu ba dang / rngon pa zhig dang 'phrad nas/ rngon pas 266

btsun mo gtses pas nyen te/ rgyal po gtsug na bdag bskyab tu gsol zhes smre sngags bton pas/rgyal pos rgyang ring po nas tshor te/ci yin snyam nas ltar phyin pas/ rngon pas rgyang ring po nas 'ong ba mthong nas drang srong du rtog ste/ dmod pas 'jigs nas bros so/ rgyal pos btsun mo rgyal srid kyi bde ba rgya chen po la longs spyod pa/ sdug bsngal chen po de lta bu nyams su myong ba gzigs pas thugs dbyung ste/ kye ma 'dus byas kyi chos gang la yang yid brtan pa med do snyam du dgongs so/ /de'i tshe bzod dkas btang ba'i bram zes rgyal po gtsug na'i drung du phyin te lo rgyus brjod nas/ gtsug tor bslangs pas khyod rang chod la khyer gsungs pas/bram zes kyang gtsug tor bcad nas phyin pas/bzod dka'i yul gyi nad dang mu ge thams cad rgyun chad do/ /rgyal po gtsug na gtsug tor bcad pa'i na zug gis rkyen byas nas/tsha dmyal rnams la snying rje skyes nas brgyal te sa la 'gyel lo/ /de'i ltas bzang pos bskul te lha'i tshogs mang po dang rgyal po'i 'khor mang po der 'dus nas/ rgyal po la ci nongs zhus pas/ rgyal po yar tsog gis bzhengs/ gdong gi khrag rnams phyag gis cung zad phyis nas/ bzod dka' gtsug tor slong du byung nas byin pa yin gsungs/ de byen pa la thugs 'dod ci bdog zhus pas/ bzod dka'i yul gyi nad dang mu ge sogs la phan du re ba ma gtogs rang 'dod gcig kyang med/ 'on kyang 'dod pa chen po gcig rtag tu yod gsungs/ de gang lags zhus pas/sems can thams cad bskyab par 'dod pa zhig yin gsungs/ 'o na 'gyod par ma gyur tam zhus pas/ 'gyod pa med gsungs/ 'o brgyal ba'i rnam 'gyur la bltas na yid mi ches so/ /zhus pas/ ngas 267

gtsug tor bzod dka' 'khor bcas la byin pa la 'gyod pa ma skyes na/ nga'i lus snga ma kho na bzhin du gyur cig gsungs pas/ de bzhin du gyur to/ /der 'khor rnams kyis pho brang du gshegs par zhus pas ma gnang ba la/ yang rang sangs rgyas bzhi byon nas/ dgra rnams la'ang phan par mdzad na gnyen rnams ci ste dor/ da ni pho brang du gshegs par rigs so gsungs nas/ der pho brang du gshegs te 'khor rnams phan bde la bkod pa yin no//don gnyis pa 'jug pa'i bslab bya pha rol tu phyin pa drug ni/ sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan te/ thabs spyod pa'i phyogs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lnga/ shes rab ye shes kyi tshogs te drug yin/dang po sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la/ zang zing gi sbyin pa/ chos kyi sbyin pa/ mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa dang gsum yin/ zang zing gi sbyin pa de la gtong ba dang /gtong ba chen po/ shin tu gtong ba dang gsum yod/ gtong ba ni tha na ja theb dang / nas phor gang yan chad rgyu rdzas gzhan la sbyin pa de yin/ de la rang gi bsam pa rnam par dag na dngos po la che zung med de/ltung bshags las kyang tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa la zas kham gcig tsam bstsal ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba zhes gsungs/ rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba'i mnga' bdag yin pas gzungs sngags la sogs pa'i mthu la brten nas chu thigs dang nas 'bru tsam gyi sbyin pas kyang /yi dwags kyi rigs ga ka'i klung gi bye ma snyed mang po la phan thogs par gsungs/dkar gsur dmar gsur la sogs pa 'di dag kyang mkha' la rgyu ba'i yi dwag/sa kyi rigs la phan lhag par che zhing / de la brten nas sems can gyi srog la za 268

ba'i 'byung po mi ma yin pa rnams/ gnas skabs dri gsur gyi zas kyis tshims pa dang / chos kyi sbyin pas rgyud grol ba sogs la brten nas sems can gyi srog la mi 'tshe bas sems can mang po 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob pas/ skyabs kyi sbyin pa yang yin te/ don du sbyin pa rnam pa gsum ka tshang / des na zu sbyin dang gsur bsngo la sogs pa byed pa ni/ bya sla la chod che ba'i chos yin pas/ lo re bzhin chu gtor 'bum ther re tsam bsngo ba dang / rgyun du yang gsur dang chu gtor ma chags par byed pa gal che ba yin/ de bzhin du rang la rgyu rdzas longs spyod cung zad re 'byor pa byung na yang / de la shi spar 'thams nas tshe 'di phyi gnyis ka'i don du spyod mi bra bar/ ci tsam zhig yod med kyang snyam nas mug skad 'don pa ni da lta nyid nas yi dwags kyi rgyu mthun sleb pa yin pas/ de ltar mi byed par yang dkon mchog la mchod pa/ mar ngan slong la sbyin gtong la sogs pa mchod sbyin gyi phyogs la 'bad dgos te/ rje mi la'i zhal nas kyang /lto kha nas brus la sbyin pa thong / zhes gsungs/ de ltar ma yin par rang 'dod kyi dbang du btang na/ lho 'dzam bu gling gi rgyu rdzas longs spyod thams cad mi gcig la yod kyang chog mi shes/ rang la yod pa de kha nas 'bug mi dra bar yar mchod mar sbyin byed rgyu de da gzod gzhan nas e rnyed snyam pa lta bu zhig 'char 'ong ba yin/lar zang zing gi sbyin pa la sogs rgyu rdzas kyi dngos pos chos byed pa 'di byang zub sems dpa' khyim pa la gtso bor gsungs pa yin pas/ rab tu byung ba rnams kyi 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa kho na la bslab/ ri khrod dang dgon pa brten te dka' spyad dang snying rus kyi sgo nas lam lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum 269

nyams su len pa de gal che ba yin/ rang gi dge sbyor bcag nas tshong dang so nam la sogs g.yo sgyu dang sdig pa'i sgo nas rgyu rdzas bsags te/ des yar mchod mar sbyin byed pa sogs chos byed par rlom pa rnams ni/ chos chos bzhin ma byas na chos kyis slar ngan song gi rgyu byed bya ba de yin pas/de la snying po ci yang med/des na dus dang rnam pa thams cad du chog shes kho na la bsten pa 'di gal che ba yin no/ /gtong ba chen po zhes bya ba ni/rta dang glang po bu dang bu mo la sogs rang la lhag par rtsis che ba dang / dkon pa'i rigs gzhan la sbyin pa de yin/shin tu gtong ba ni rang gi lus dang srog dang yan lag la sogs pa sbyin par gtong ba ste/ dper na rgyal bu snying stobs chen pos stag mor lus sbyin btang ba dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis rgyal po bde spyod kyi bu la dbu sbyin par btang ba dang / lha lcam rngo bzang mos stag mor lus sbyin btang ba la sogs pa de lta bu yin te/ 'di dag sa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ma gtogs so so'i skye bo phal gyis nyams su blang mi nus pas da lta blo yis lus srog longs spyod thams cad la chags pa med par sems can gyi don du bsngo zhing / phyis nas dngos su gtong nus par smon lam 'debs pa yin/ chos kyi sbyin pa ni/gzhan la dbang bsgur/ chos bshad/ lung 'bogs pa sogs gzhan rgyud dge ba la sbyor ba'i thabs byed pa de yin/'on kyang rang 'dod rtsa ba nas ma zad kyi bar gzhan don sgrub lo byas kyang gzugs brnyan tsam las mi 'ong ste/ jo bo la 'khor slob rnams kyis/ tshogs pa skyong ba'i dus nam yin/ gzhan don byed pa'i dus nam yin/ gshin po la 'pho ba 'debs pa'i dus nam yin zhus pas/ tshogs pa skyong 270

ba'i dus stong nyid rtogs shing mngon shes skyes pa'i dus yin/ gzhan don byed pa'i dus rang don zad tsa na yin/ gshin po la 'pho ba 'debs pa'i dus mthong lam thob nas yin gsungs/ yang jo bo'i zhal nas/ da lta snyigs ma'i dus su pho zo 'don pa'i dus ma yin/snying rus 'don pa'i dus yin/ che sa bzung ba'i dus ma yin/ dman sa bzung pa'i dus yin/ 'khor g.yog bsten pa'i dus ma yin/dben pa bsten pa'i dus yin/ slob ma bsrel ba'i dus ma yin/ rang nyid bsrel ba'i dus yin/tshig rjes bsrung ba'i dus ma yin/ don la bsam pa'i dus yin/phan tshun 'gro ba'i dus ma yin/ sa gcig tu sdod pa'i dus yin gsungs/ yang dge bshes ston pa la/sku mched gsum gyis/dben par nyams su len pa dang /sems can la chos kyis phan 'dogs pa gnyis khebs gang che lags zhus pas/ston pa'i zhal nas/ rang rgyud la nyams rtogs ci yang med pa'i las dang po pa'i gang zag gis sems can 'a chos kyis phan btags kyang mi thogs te/ byen rlabs snod stong pa byo ba dang 'dra ste/ byin rlabs la 'ong rgyu med/ gdams ngag sbang ma ma mnan par bsing ba'i chang dang 'dra ste/ gdams ngag la ro bcud med/ drod thob la brtan pa ma thob pa'i mos pas spyod pa'i gang zag gis sems can gyi don byar mi btub te/ byin rlabs bum pa gang byo dang 'dra ste/ gzhan gang tsam na rang nyid stong bar 'gyur/ gdams ngag sgron me lag brgyud dang 'dra ste/ gzhan gsal tsam na rang nyid 'gribs par 'gyur/ sa thob na mar sems can gyi don grub tshad bya ba yin te/ byen rlabs bum pa bzang po'i dngos grub dang 'dra ste/ gzhan thams cad smin par byas kyang / rang nyid la gang stong 271

med/ gdams ngag mar me'i gzhi ma dang 'dra ste/ gzhan gsal bar byas kyang /rang la 'grib pa med pa yin/ des na da lta snyigs ma'i dus 'dir so so'i skye bos dben par byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo goms par bya ba ma yin par/ sems can la dngos su phan gdags pa'i dus ma yin/ rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa srung ba'i dus yin/dper na sman chen po'i ljon shing gi myu gu de bcad pa'i dus ma yin/ srung ba'i dus yin gsungs/ des na dngos su sems can la chos kyis sbyin ba gtong ba ni cung zad dka'/ rang gis nyams su ma blangs par chos gzhan la bshad pa 'dis ni gzhan la phan ci yang mi thogs/ chos bshad pa la brten nas 'bul ba dang rnyed nor bsdu ba ni/ rgya gar dam pas/ nor sgrub pa'i zong chos la byed gsungs pa de yin pas/ rang 'dod ma zad kyi bar du/gzhan don byed pa la mi rings par rang gis kha ton dang bzlas brjod/ rgyal ba'i bka' gsung rab bklags pa sogs dkar phyogs kyi lha 'dre rnams kyis nyan nas rgyud grol ba'i smon lam byed/ chu gtor dang lus sbyin la sogs pa'i mjug tu/sdig pa ci yang mi bya sogs chos sbyin yod pa de tsam gyis 'thus par bya/rang 'dod zad pa'i dus su/zhi bde dang sos dal gyi dbang du skad cig kyang ma lus par gzhan don kho na gtso bor bya ba'i dus la bab pa yin pas de ltar bya/mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa ni/ sems can skyabs med pa la skyabs/ mgon med pa la mgon/dpung gnyen med pa la dpung gnyen byed pa thams cad dang /khyad par bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dus byas kyi dge ba thams cad las/ sems can gyi srog skyabs pa phan yon che bar gsungs pas/dbang yod rnams nas/ ri 272

rgya dang klung rgya sdom pa dang / gzhan dag nas kyang / gsod sar khrid pa'i bsha' lug bslu ba dang / 'chi bar nye ba'i nya dang 'bu sbrang gi skyabs byed pa sogs dngos su thabs sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas sems can la phan 'dogs pa lhur len pa yin no/ / de ltar sbyin pa rnam pa 'di dag ni/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig gi yang gtso che shos yin te/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung las/ rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig tu//sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//gnyis pa tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la/nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims dang gsum yod/ dang po nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims ni/ lus ngag yid kyi sgo nas gzhan don du mi 'gyur ba'i mi dge ba bcu po thams cad dug bzhin du spong ba de yin/dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba cha phra mo re yan chad dus dang rnam pa thams cad du ci 'grub gang 'grub tu byed pa de yin/lar 'jig rten pa phal pa'i kha skad la yang / dge ba kha zhor lag zhor/ sdig pa 'gro zhor 'dug zhor zer ba ltar/ rang gi dus dang rnam pa thams cad du dran shes dang bag yod kyi sgo nas brtags te/ spang blang gi gnas la ma 'bad na/ tha na rtsed mo tsam gyi zhor la'ang sdig pa tshab po che du ma sog 'gro ba yin pas/ ji skad du/ sdig pa chung ngu tsam la yang / /mi gnod snyam du brnyas mi bya/ /me stag phra mo gcig gis kyang / /rtswa phung ri tsam sreg par byed/ /ces gsungs/ de bzhin du dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ dran dang shes bzhin gyis bzung nas nyams su blangs na/ dge ba'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa yang zhar dang zhor la 'grub 'gro ba yin te/ tha na 273

lam kha zhig na ma ṇi rdo mkhar zhig yod kyang de la zhwa phud dang zhe sa bya/de g.yas phyogs su bzhag ste bskor ba'i tshul gyis 'gro/ de yang dam pa gsum gyis zin par byas na/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyu ma nor bar 'gro bas/ji skad du/dge ba phra mo tsam la yang //mi phan snyam du brnyas mi bya//chu yi thigs pa bsags pa yis//snod chen rim gyis gang bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar/ sngon gyi dus su phag gcig khyis ded de mchod rten la bskor ba byas pa dang / srin 'bu bdun shing lo'i steng nas chur lhungs pa chu yi 'khor phyogs kyis chu nang yod pa'i mchod rten la bskor ba bdun byas pa sogs kyang thar pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i lo rgyus lta bu yin pas/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du sdig pa sna re yan chad spang / dge ba sna re yan chad ci 'grub bsgrub/ de dag sems can gyi don du bsngo ba la byang zub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang sdom pa thams cad 'dus pa yin no/ /sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar rang 'dod rtsa ba nas zad pa'i dus su/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la bsten nas sems can gyi don dngos su bsgrub pa la 'bad pa de yin /las dang po pa'i dus su/ dge sgrub sdig spang gi bslab bya gang nyams su len pa dam pa gsum gyis zin pa'i sgo nas sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo ba de la 'dus pa yin no//gsum pa bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gsum te/ gzhan gyi log sgrub bzod pa'i bzod pa/ chos phyir dka' spyad bzod pa'i bzod pa/ zab mo'i don la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa dang gsum yod/ dang po gzhan gyi log sgrub bzod pa'i bzod pa ni/gzhan gyis rang la dngos su rdung rdeg dang / 'phrog bcom tshig ngan 274

smra ba sogs dang / lkog nas mi snyan par brjod pa sogs la zhe sdang dang khong khro mi bya bar slar la byams pa dang snying rje bskyed nas de dag la phan 'dogs pa de yin/ de ltar ma byas par khong khro'i dbang du btang na/ bskal pa stong gi tshogs bsags khong khro gcig gis 'joms/ zer ba ltar yin te/ spyod 'jug las/bskal pa stong du bsags pa yi/ /sbyin dang bde gshegs mchod la sogs/ /legs spyad gang yin de kun kyang / /khong khro gcig gis 'joms par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ des na zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa med/ /bzod pa lta bu'i dka' thub med/ /de bas bzod pa nan tan tu/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khrong khro'i nyes dmigs dran nas dus dang rnam pa thams cad du bzod pa bsgom pa la 'bad dgos te/ rgya gar dam pas/ dgra sdang las kyi 'khrul snang yin pa la/ /zhe sdang gdug sems skyur cig ding ri ba/ /zhes dang / jo bo rje lha gcig gi zhal nas kyang / gnod pa byed pa la khong ma khro/ /gnod pa byed pa la khong khro na/ /bzod pa ci tsam na bsgom/ /zhes gsungs/ des na rang la tshur ngan smras dang gnod pa ma nyes pa'i kha yog la sogs pa byung na de la khong khro dang 'khon 'dzin spangs na/ des sdig pa dang sgrib pa mang du 'dzad cing /bzod pa la brten nas tshogs rlabs po che rdzogs pa yin pas/ gnod pa byed pa la bla ma ltar blta dgos te/ zhe sdang skye yul med na bzod pa su la bsgom zer ba de yin/ lar da lta'i dus na de bla ma'am dge slong bzang po zhig yin te khong khro che zer/ 'jig rten gyi khams na skyon ga'i ga la (nga rdzo las thu ba med na/khong khro che bzhin tu bzang po zhig ji ltar yin/ rgya gar dam pa'i zhal nas kyang / 'dod 276

chags kyi las brgya bas/ zhe sdang gi las skad cig ma gcig sdig pa che ba yin te ma go zhes gsungs/ chos rgyud la skyes pa'i gang zag de/ lus ngag yid gsum ras bal rdog pas mnan pa'am/ phye thug la zo mar btab pa ltar 'jam lhan gyis song ba zhig dgos/ de ltar ma yin par dge sbyor cung zad re 'grub pa'am/srung sdom sna re tsam dag pa la/nga ni de dang de lta bu yin no//snyam du dus rtag tu nga rgyal gyis rgyud khengs nas/ gzhan pha rol po'i tshig gcig gi smra lugs legs nyes la'ang nga la brnyas byung / nga la smad byung zer nas rgyud khro ling nge yod pa de chos dang rang rgyud so sor song nas chos kyis sems la cung zad kyang ma phan pa'i rtags yin/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen spyan snga ba'i zhal nas/ 'o cag thos bsam sgom gsum byas gyin/ nga bdag je cher song nas bzod sran sha'u bas chung ba/ ko long gtsang btsan pas dam par 'dug pa 'di thos bsam sgom gsum log par song ba'i rtags yin/ zhes gsungs/ des na dus dang rnam pa thams cad du dma' mo'i sa bzung / hrul po'i gos gyon/ bzang ngan 'bring gsum gong du khur nas byams snying rje byang zub sems la gzhi bcol te rang rgyud chos kyis 'dul ba ni nyams len gnad ma nor ba yin pas/ sems la mi phan pa'i lta ba mtho mtho dang sgom pa zab zab mo stong las kyang dga' ba yin/chos phyir dka' spyad bzod pa'i bzod pa ni/ dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i ched du dka' tshegs tsha grang thams cad khyad du bsad nas bsgrub dgos te/ rgyud las kyang / me tshogs spu gri'i mtsho yang brgal nas ni/ /phyi mthar thug gi bar du dam chos btsal//zhes gsungs/sngon gyi jo bo bka' gdams pa dag gi gtad pa bzhi 276

zhes bya ba/ blo phugs chos la gtad/ chos phugs sprang la gtad/ sprang phugs shi la gtad/shi phugs grog stong la gtad ces gsungs/ da lta rang re rnams nas chos la dka' spyad dang snying rus cung zad kyang mi dgos par/ 'jig rten tsho 'dir bya ba spub pa'i zhor la bde skyid snyan gsum dang ldan pa'i ngang nas chos 'grub tu re/ gzhan la yang de ltar yod par rlom nas/ de bla ma bzang po zhig yin chos 'jig rten gnyis ka 'dzom yod zer te/chos 'jig rten gnyis ka 'dzom thabs ga la yod/ chos 'jig rten gnyis ka 'dzom par rlom pa de la/'jig rten bzang po re 'dzom yod shas che ma gtogs chos yang dag pa de med thag chod/chos dang 'jig rten gnyis ka mnyam du spub par rlom pa de/ khab rtse gnyis kyis bzo drub pa dang / me zu gnyis snod gcig tu 'jog pa dang / rta gnyis kha yar mar du bskor nas mnyam du zhon nas 'gro bar rlom pa dang 'dra ste 'grub thabs gtan nas med/ gang zag cig la bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas shākya thub pa las lhag pa zhig yod thabs med de/ des kyang chos 'jig rten gnyis ka mnyam du 'grub pa'i thabs ma dgongs nas 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyang mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du bor nas chu bo ni ra po na'i drung du lo drug gi bar du lo re la chu thigs pa re dang nas 'bru re gsol nas dka' spyad dang snying rus mdzad pa yin/ rje btsun mi la ras pa lta bus kyang / sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i dus kha zas med/ rgyab gos med mdzad nas/ za kho na gsol te spub pa mdzad pas lus thams cad keng rus ltar song / lus la spu sngo zhol ba skyes/ gzhan dag gis mthong tshe mi yin nam 'dre yin ngo shes par ma gyur par dka' spyad dang snying 277

rus mdzad de chos nyams su len pa de/ chos dang 'jig rten mnyam du spub pa'i thabs med pa'i don yin gyi/ mi la ras pa thabs rdugs nas chos dang 'jig rten mnyam du sgrub ma shes pa ga la yin/ de bzhin du grub chen me long rdo rjes kyang gla khe'i shun pa kho na gsol te/ lo dgu'i bar du sgrub pa mdzad pas grub pa thob pa dang / kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po klong chen rab 'byams pas kyang /dngul chu ril bu nyi shu rtsa gcig gis zla ba mang po'i 'tsho ba mdzad pa dang /kha ba bab dus snye zhig gi nang du 'dzul nas gos gdan gnyis ka'i go bcad de chos phyogs su dka' ba spyad pa sogs/ sngon gyi grub thob thams cad 'jig rten tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad rgyab tu bsgyur nas dka' spyad dang snying rus kyi sgo nas bsgrubs te grub pa thob pa sha stag yin gyi/ 'jig rten tshe 'di'i bya ba sgrub pa'i zhor la bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzoms pa'i ngang nas chos bsgrubs te grub pa su yang med/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i zhal nas kyang / lto 'bol ba gos dro ba sdod gnas skyid pa/sbyin bdag legs pa zhig gi sta gon byas phyin chad chos ma 'grub gong du bdud 'grub tshar ba yin/ zhes gsungs/ dge bshes sha bo pa'i zhal nas kyang /snying nas chos byed na blo rtse sprang po la gtad dgos/ sprang po'i tha ma 'chir 'jug nus pa zhig dgos pa yin/ blo sna de lta bu zhig skyes na/lha 'dre mi gsum gyis 'o brgyal du mi 'jug nges pa yin/ zhes gsungs/ rje mi la'i zhal nas kyang / nga na na dri mi med pa dang / /shi na ngu mi med pa ru/ /ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na/ /rnal 'byor bsam pa rdzogs pa yin/ /sgo na mi rjes med pa dang /nang na khrag rjes med pa ru/ /ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na/ /rnal 'byor bsam pa 278

rdzogs pa yin/ /gar song dri mi med pa dang //'dir song gtad so med pa ru//ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na/ /rnal 'byor bsam pa rdzogs pa yin/ /ro rul 'bu yis za ba dang / /rtsa rgyus sbrang bus 'jibs pa ru//ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na//rnal 'byor bsam pa rdzogs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs/ des na 'jig rten tshe 'dir zhen pa thams cad rlung la bskur nas dka' tshegs dang tsha grang thams cad khyad du bsad de chos spub pa zhig cis kyang dgos pa yin no/ zab mo'i don la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa ni/ zab mo stong pa nyid kyi gnas lugs dang / khyad par rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs bya rtsol dang bral ba'i gnad/ dge sdig rgyu 'bras las 'das pa'i rdo rje'i gad mo bcu gnyis dang / ngo mtshar ba'i tshig chen brgyad la sogs pa thos pa na/ de dag la log lta mi skye zhing de dag gi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa lon pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya/ de ltar ma yin par de dag la log lta skyes pa'am/skur pa btab na chos spong ba'i las zhes bya ste/bskal pa grangs med pa'i bar du dmyal ba'i gting nas mi thar ba'i rgyu yin/ de skad du yang / mtshams med lnga las thu ba'i las ngan pa/ /chos spong pas las ngan bsags pa mthol lo bshags/ /zhes gsungs/ jo bo rje lha cig gi drung du rgya gar gyi dge slong sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la gnas pa gnyis byung / jo bos gang zag gi bdag med gsungs pas khong gnyis dga'/ chos kyi bdag med gsungs pa'i tshe 'jigs 'jigs de ltar mi gsungs bar zhu zer/ zab mdo 'don pa thos pa'i tshe rna ba 'gebs pas/jo bo thugs chad de byams snying rje byang chub kyis sems la blo sbyangs nas chos zab mo la yid che pas zhig med na/ srung 279

sdom dag pa gcig pus gar yang mi phyin par 'dug gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i dus kyang stong pa nyid zab mo'i don bstan pa thos pas/ dge slong mngon pa'i nga rgyal can mang po'i kha nas khrag tsha ba sgyugs te shi ba dar / dmyal bar skyes pa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus yod pa lta bu yin pas/ zab mo'i chos dang de ston pa'i gang zag la snying thag pa nas mos gus bya zhing / gal te rang nyid blo chung ba'i skyon gyis mos par ma gyur kyang / skur pa 'debs pa spang bar bya ba ni ci nas gal che'o//bzhi pa brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la'ang / go cha'i brtson 'grus/sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus/ chog par mi 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus dang gsum yin/dang po go cha'i brtson 'grus ni/ sngon gyi dam pa gong ma rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rnam thar dang mdzad spyod/ chos phyir dka' ba sprud pa'i lo rgyus sogs ji dang ji lta bu zhig thos kyang khong rnams sangs rgyas dang byang sems yin pas de ltar mdzad pa yin/ rang res de lta bu zhig ga la nus snyam du sgyid mi lug par/ khong rnam pas de ltar mdzad pas grub pa thob par 'dug nga yang de dag gi rjes 'jug yin pas de las lhag pa zhig ma thon kyang / de lta bu zhig ma 'grub par thabs mi 'dug snyam pa dang / khong rnam pas kyang de lta bu'i dka' spyad dang snying rus dgos na/ rang re las ngan gyi khur gyis non/thog ma med pa'i dus nas chos la sbyangs 'phro med pa zhig gis dka' sprud dang snyeng rus ci'i phyir mi dgos/ des na da res dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma mjal/zab mo'i gdams ngag thob/yang dag pa'i 280

chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i skal pa yod pa'i dus 'dir dka' ba dang du blang /lci ba rgyab tu khur/ lus srog 'ben du btsug sha khrag gzan du bor te/snying thag pa nas chos shig mi sgrub re snyam du dam bca' ba de yin/sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus ni/chos la byed blo dang sgrub blo zhig yod kyang / sang bya dang gnang bya'i ngang du mi tsha'i nyi ma zad nas/chos sgrub 'dod kyi ngang nas mi tshe 'dzad pa de spang dgos te/'brug padma dkar pos/ mi tshe 'di bshas ra'i dud 'gro dang 'dra/ /yud tsam re song yang 'chi la nye/ /de ring dang sang gi ngang ring 'dis/ /mal mtha' nas 'o dod 'chor ro sang / /zhes gsungs/ des na chos phyi bshol gyi ngang du skad cig kyang mi bzhag par/sdar ma'i pang du sbrul zhugs pa'am/sgeg mo'i mgo la me shor ba ltar/ /'jig rten tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad cog gis bzhag ling gis bskyur nas 'phral dang 'phral du chos la 'bad dgos/ de ltar ma byas na 'jig rten gyi bya ba zin dus med pa gcig rjes gcig non du 'ong ba chu'i gnyer ma lta bu yin pas chos sgrub pa'i longs skabs mi 'ong / rang gis blo thag chod nas 'jig rten gyi bya ba nam bsgyur kyang de'i dus su zin pa yin te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/'jig rten bya ba shi shir zin dus med//nam bzhag dus na zin pa chos nyid yin/zhes dang /bya byed byes pa'i rtsed mo 'dra/ /byas na mi zin bzhag na zin/ /zhes gsungs/ des na dam pa'i chos la sgrub 'dod kyi blo zhig skyes pa'i tshe/ mi rtag pas skul ma btab ste/ chos le lo dang phyi bshol gyi dbang du skad cig kyang mi lus par 'phral dang 'phral du chos la 'jug pa de spyor ba'i brtson 'grus yin/chog par mi 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus ni/ rang gi mtshams dang bsnyen sgrub 281

kha ton dang dge sbyor la sogs pa cung zad re 'grub pa'i tshe/ de tsam gyis chog shes mi bya bar tshe dang sgrub pa stoms pa'i dam bca' blangs nas ji srid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob bar du brtson pa rgyun ring la shugs drag pa chu bo'i rgyun lta bu zhig dgos te/ dam pa gong ma dag gi gsung las chos sgrub pa'i dus g.yag ltog gis rtswa za ba lta bu zhig dgos/ zhes gsungs/ g.yag ltog gis rtswa za ba'i tshe/ kham sngon ma gcod pa'i dus nas phyi ma mig gis bltas nas za ba ltar/ chos kyi bya ba sngon ma sgrub pa'i dus nas 'di 'grub pa dang 'di bsgrub snyam du blos blangs te/ sgo gsum sos dal dang chos med du skad cig kyang ma lus pa zhig gi ngang nas nyin re bzhin yang chos la brtson pa je cher 'bad dgos te/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i zhal nas kyang / 'chi ba la ji tsam bcar bzhin dge sbyor la snying rus cher 'gro ba 'di chos pa sad kyis ma khyer ba'i rtags yin/ zhes gsungs/ da lta sgom chen dang bla ma bzang por grags pa dag la/ gzhan dag na re/ da khyed tshos phyag dang kha ton tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong sogs dgos dogs med zer zhing ngo bstod byed la/ rang rang nas kyang nga de dang de lta bu yin pas gang yang mi dgos snyam pa 'dug ste/mnyam med dwags po'i zhal nas/ mi dgos snyam pa de dgos bdo yin pa'i rtags yin gsungs/ rgya gar jo bo dī paṃ ka ras kyang nyin re bzhin phyag sa khal le sātstsha 'debs pa la brtson/ 'khor rnams kyis khyed bla ma chen po zhig sa las mdzad pa mis kyang 'phya zhing / 'o brgyal bar 'dug pas nged rnams kyis byed par zhu zhus pas/ ci zer 'o na nga'i zan kyang khyed rnams kyis za'am gsungs/ des na rdzogs pa'i sangs 282

rgyas ma thob kyi bar du sbyang bya las dang bag chags yod cing / thob bya gong ma gong ma'i yon tan yod pa yin pas dal khom dang res 'ga'i chos su ma song bar snying thag pa nas chos la chog shes med par 'bad dgos/ lar sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob mi thob brtson 'grus 'di kho na la rags las pa yin pas/brtson 'grus rnam pa gsum po 'di la 'bad dgos pa yin te/ shes rab rab cig yod kyang brtson 'grus tha ma zhig las med na chos pa tha ma zhig las mi 'ong /shes rab tha ma zhig las med kyang / brtson 'grus rab cig yod na chos pa yang rab zhig 'ong / brtson 'grus med na yon tan gzhan yod kyang mi phan pa/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i zhal nas/ brtson 'grus med pa'i gang zag la/shes rab dang ni dbang 'byor stobs/ /gang gis skyob par mi nus te/ /gru gzing yod pa'i ded dbon la/ /skya bas rdugs pa ji bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs/ des na dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du/lto tshad la phab/gnyid srang la gcur/rig pa gzhur la drangs nas/ thang lhod med pa'i brtson 'grus gzhu brdungs pa lta bu zhig med na/ dal khoms re 'ga'i chos kyis ni gar yang mi phyin no/ /lnga pa bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ dang po 'du 'dzi dang rnam g.yeng thams cad spangs nas gnas dben pa zhig ma brten na/ bsam gtan rgyud la skye mi nus pas/ dang po rnam g.yeng spang ba gal che/ de yang 'dus pa ni 'bral ba'i chos can yin te/ pha ma dang /spun zla/ bza' mi dang / gnyen grogs/ tha na lhan cig skyes pa'i lus kyi sha rus kyang so sor 'bral ba'i chos can yin na/ rtag pa med pa'i mdza' bshes la chags nas ci byed snyam du bsams nas/ rtag tu gcig 283

pur gnas par bya dgos te/ ras pa zhi ba 'od kyis/ rang nyid gcig pu sangs rgyas kyi ngang / chos mthun grogs po dge sbyor gyi rten/ /gsum bzhi phan chad chags sdang gi rgyu/ /bdag des kyang gcig pur bsdad pa zhig lags/ /zhes gsungs/'dod pa ni nyes pa thams cad kyi 'byung khungs/yod kyang chog mi shes/longs spyod dang 'byor pa ji tsam yod bzhin ser sna 'phel ba yin te/ji skad du/gang la nor yod de la ser sna yod//zhes dang / yod kyin je dgos phyug po 'dra/ /zhes gsungs/ nor med tsa na dgra dang zal/ /zhes pa ltar/ rang la zas nor dang longs spyod la sogs pa ji tsam 'byor pa de tsam du dgra dang rkun po la sogs pas yang 'tshe zhing / de la brten nas dus dang rnam ba thams cad du/ de nyid gsog pa dang / srung ba dang / spel ba gsum gyis mi tshe zad la/ de yang sdug bsngal dang sdig pa kho na ma gtogs med pas na/'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang /gsog dang srung dang spel bas nyam thag pas/ /nor ni phung khrol mtha' yas shes par bya//zhes gsungs/lho 'dzam bu'i gling gi rgyu rdzas dang longs spyod thams cad mi gcig la yod kyang / don du ni mi gcig gi lto gos gnyis las byed rgyu gzhan med/ 'on kyang ci tsam 'byor bzhin rang gcig pu tsam gyi yang kha la za mi bra/rgyab la gyon mi bra bar sdig sdug gtam ngan thams cad khyad du bsad de phyi ma rlung la bskur/ tshe 'di srog dang bsdos/ rgyu rdzas phra mo re'i ched du khrel dang ngo tsha gzhungs dang phyi thag chos dang dam tshig thams cad khyad du gsod/za rlom/ rnyed rlom/ thob rlom kho nas dus 'da' ba 'byung pos gtor ma tshol ba lta bu'i ngang du nyin gcig gi dal khom dang bde skyid kyang nyams su ma myong bzhin du mi tshe 284

zad/ mthar longs spyod bsags bsags rang gi srog la babs nas/ de kho na'i ched du gri kha dang mtshon khar 'chi/ tshe gcig tu bsags pa'i rgyu rdzas longs spyod ni/dgra la sogs pa gzhan gyis longs spyod de chud zos kho nar 'gyur/de'i ched du bsags pa'i sdig pa'i phung po ri rab tsam zhig ni/rang nyid kho na'i skal bar thob ste ngan song bzod par dka' ba'i gting nas thar ba'i dus med par 'khyams pa de lta bu yin pas/ 'byor pa cung zad re yod na da lta rang dbang yod tshe 'dir phyi ma'i rgyags phye bzang po re tshags su tshud par byas nas/ lto gyi na dang gos lhag skyob tsam gyis chog shes par bya/ de bzhin du tshe 'di kho na don du gnyer ba'i mi rnams ni byes pa'i grogs po zhes bya ba yin te/ de dag ni phar la phan par byas kyang / tshur la gnod pa byed pas byas pa mi gzo ba/ ji ltar byas kyang 'thad pa'i dus med pas mgu bar dka' ba/ kho bas rang lhag na ni phrag dog byed/ rang bas kho lhag na ni khyad du gsod pa/ ji tsam 'grogs bzhin mi dge ba 'phel zhing dge ba 'grib pa yin pas de dag ring du spang / tshong dang so nam bzo dang rig shes la sogs pa la brten nas mang po dang 'brel zhing don mang pos rnam par g.yeng ba ni/'du 'dzi yin te/ de yang rtag tu brel zhing don chung ba/ji tsam brtson kyang snying po med pa/dgra btul kyang mtha' med pa/gnyen bskyangs kyang mtha' med pa/ zin pa'i dus med pa'i bya byed dang rnam g.yeng thams cad mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin dor te/ pha yul rgyab tu bskyur/ mi yul dang du blangs/ gnas brag rtsa ru bsdad/grogs ri dwags dang 'gros/sa/ bab lus sems la bskur/ gyong lto gos gtam gsum la gtad nas/ mi med kyi lung 285

stong kho nar mi tshe bskyal te/ ji skad du/rje btsun mi la ras pa'i zhal nas/ mi med lung ba'i brag phug na/ /skyo chad de ba la sangs dus med/ /bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la/ /yid dung nge ba la 'bral ba med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar byas na/yid skyo ba'i gnas su bsam gtan 'khor/ /zer ba yin pas nges 'byung dang skyo shas/ dad pa dang dag snang / bsam gtan dang ting 'dzin la sogs lam gyi yon tan thams cad rang shugs kyis skye ba yin pas/ de lta bu la ci nas kyang 'bad/ de bas na dben pa'i nags khrod ni/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang zhi ba brnyes pa'i gnas/'du 'dzi dang rnam g.yeng med pa/tshong dang so nam med pa/ byis pa'i grogs dang bral ba/bya dang ri dwags 'grogs na bde/ chu dang lo ma dka' thub kyi zas dang mthun pa/ rig pa ngang gis dwangs/ ting nge 'dzin shugs kyis 'phel ba'i gnas/ de na dgra med/ gnyen med/chags sdang gi sgrog las grol ba yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i gnas yin te/de lta bu'i dben pa'i gnas su dngos su phyin nas sdod pa lta yang ci smos/ tha na dben pa'i gnas der 'gro bsams nas/de'i phyogs su gom pa bdun bor yang /bskal pa ga mi'i klung gi bye ma snyed du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa phul ba las kyang phan yon che bar/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis zla ba sgron me'i mdo la sogs pa las gsungs/ de lta bu'i gnas su ji skad du/ ri khrod dben pa'i gnas mchog na/ /spyod lam thams cad dge ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ ched du brtson 'grus brtsams nas dge ba ma bsgrubs kyang / nges 'byung dang skyo shas/ byams dang snying rje la sogs pa lam gyi yon tan thams cad ngang 286

ngam shugs kyis skye bas/ spyod lam thams cad kyang rang bzhin gyis dge ba 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur/ 'du 'dzi'i gnas su 'bad nas bkag kyang mi kheg pa'i chags sdang dang nyon mongs pa thams cad kyang / dben pa'i gnas su sleb pa tsam gyis rang shugs kyis chung du 'gro/ lam gyi yon tan thams cad rang rgyud la skyed par sla ba yin te/ 'di dag ni bsam gtan gyi sngon du 'gro ba'i chos yin pas ci nas kyang gal che bas med thabs med do/ /bsam gtan dngos la/ byis pa nyer spyod kyi bsam gtan/ don rab 'byed pa'i bsam gtan/ de bzhin gshegs dge'i bsam gtan dang gsum yin/ de yang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams la zhen nas/de nyid la ched du gnyer te nyams zhen gyi rtsi dang bcas par sgom pa'i dus na/ byis pa nyer spyod kyi bsam gtan zhes bya/ nyams kyi zhen pa dang bral nas bsam gtan gyi ro myong med kyang stong 'dzin gnyen po'i phyogs la zhen nas sgom pa'i dus na/ don rab 'byed pa'i bsam gtan zhes bya/ stong 'dzin gnyen po'i blo dang bral te/ chos nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs dge'i bsam gtan zer ba yin/ de ltar bsam gtan sgom pa'i dus thams cad du lus kyi gnad du rnam snang chos bdun byed pa dang / mig gi gnad du lta stangs byed pa sogs gal che ste/ lus drang na rtsa drang / rtsa drang na rlung drang / rlung drang na sems drang zer ba yin pas/ nyal ba 'khris pa la sogs mi byed par lus drang por bsrangs te yid gang du'ang mi rtogacir yang mi 'dzin pa'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo yin/287

drug pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la/ thos pa'i shes rab/ bsam pa'i shes rab/ sgom pa'i shes rab dang gsum/ dang bo thos pa'i shes rab ni/ chos kyi tshig don thams cad bla mas gsungs/ rang gis nyan te gsungs pa bzhin go ba de yin/bsam pa'i shes rab ni/ bla mas gsungs pa'i don de dag thams cad go lo dang thos lor mi bzhag par/ rang rgyud la gshar sbyangs byas te rtog dpyod dang bsam gzhig gi sgo nas gtan la phab/ ma shes pa gzhan la dri/ de yang shes lo dang yin lo tsam gyis chog shes mi bya bar nges par dben pa'i ri khrod bzung nas gcig pur nyams su len pa'i dus su nyams len gyi gnad gzhan la dri mi dgos par nyams len rang rkya thub nges su zhun thar bcad pa de yin/ sgom pa'i shes rab ni/ shes nas nyams su blangs te bsgoms pas gnas lugs don gyi rtogs pa ma nor pa rang rgyud la skyes/ kho thag nang nas chod/ yin min gyi sgrog las grol te gnas lugs kyi rang zhal mthong ba de yin/ de yang dang bo thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad nas/ sgom pa'i nyams su len pa'i dus su/ 'di ltar phyi yu la lnga'i snang ba thams cad med bzhin 'khrul ngo la snang ba mi lam lta bu/rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa las glo bur du snang ba sgyu ma lta bu/ med pa la yod par snang ba mig g.yor lta bu/ snang bzhin bden par ma grub pa smrig rgyu lta bu/ phyi nang gang la yang med bzhin snang ba brag cha lta bu/ rten dang brten par med pas dri za'i grong khyer lta bu/ snang la rang bzhin med pas gzugs brnyan gyi snang ba lta bu/ med snang cir yang 'char ba sprul pa'i grong khyer lta bu ste/ dngos po med pa'i stong gzugs sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad du bltas pas yul gyi snang ba rdzun pa'i 288

rang bzhin du go la/ de ltar snang ba'i mkhan po yul can sems kyi gshis lugs la brtags pas yul snang ma 'gags la yul gyi 'dzin rtog zhi/ chos nyid stong gsal nam mkha' lta bur rtogs pa'i ngang du 'jog pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no//de ltar pha rol phyin pa drug po de dag kyang phar bkral na pha rol tu phyin pa re re la yang gsum gsum du phye ba'i bco brgyad de las kyang zang zing gi sbyin pa la gsum du dbye bas nyi shu/ de'i steng du thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang nyer gcig stobs kyi pho rol tu phyin pa dang nyer gnyis/ smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang nyer gsum/ ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang nyer bzhi yin la/ de las kyang rgyas par dbye na pha rol tu phyin pa re re la yang drug tu dbye bas sum cu rtsa drug tu 'gyur ba yin te/ de yang dper na sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang chos kyi sbyin pa lta bu la mtshon na/ bshad mkhan po'i bla ma/ bshad rgyu'i chos/bshad yul slob ma dang gsum 'dzoms nas chos bshad pa de sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa/de ltar bshad pa'i dus rnyed pa dang bkur ste la sogs mi 'dod cing /rang gi che ba 'byin pa dang / gzhan la zur za ba sogs nyon mongs pa'i dri ma dang ma 'dres par 'chad pa de tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ tshig gcig gi don yang lan grangs mang po'i bar du bskyar te dka' tshegs dang ngal ba thams cad khyad du bsad nas 'chad pa de bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa/ le lo dang phyi bshol gyi dbang du mi gtong bar bsha/da pa'i dus las mi yol ba'i 'chad pa de brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ ga/nga bshad rgyu'i tshig don de las sems 289

gzhan du mi yengs par nor 'khrul dang lhag chad spangs nas 'chad pa de bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ de ltar bshad pa'i dus na 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pa'i shes rab kyi rtsis zin pa de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste phar phyin drug ka tshang ba yin/ yang zang zing gi sbyin pa mar sprang po la bza' btung sbyin pa lta bur mtshon na/ sbyin rgyu sbyin mkhan sbyin yul gsum 'dzoms nas sbyin pa de sbyin pa/ de yang ngan pa skyon canaXsogs mi sbyin par rang gi za rgyu'i bza' btung nas sbyin pa tshul khrims/ yang dang yang du bslangs kyang khong mi khro ba bzod pa/ dka' tshegs dang ngal ba mi bsam zhing yun ring du mi 'gor bar sbyin pa de brtson 'grus/ de las sems gzhan du mi yengs pa bsam gtan/'khor gsum bden med du shes pa shes rab ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug ka tshang zhing / de bzhin du tshul khrims la sogs gzhan la yang des rigs 'gre'o/ /yang pha rol tu phyin pa de dag tshur bsdu na/ rje mi las/ bdag 'dzin spangs pa'i pha rol na/ /sbyin pa bya ba logs na med/ /g.yo sgyu spangs pa'i pha rol na/ /tshul khrims bya ba logs na med//don la mi skrag pha rol na/ /bzod pa bya ba logs nas med/ /nyams len 'bral med pha rol na/ /brtson 'grus bya ba logs na med/ /ngang la gnas pa'i pha rol na/ /bsam gtan bya ba logs na med/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i pha rol na/ /shes rab bya ba logs na med/ /byas tshad chos kyi pha rol na/ /thabs zhes bya ba logs na med/ /bdud bzhi bcom pa'i pha rol na/ /stobs zhes bya ba logs na med/ /don gnyis 'grub pa'i pha rol na//smon lam bya ba logs na med/ /nyon mongs rang mtshang rig pa na/ /ye shes bya ba logs na med/ /zhes 290

gsungs/ yang khu rngog 'brom gsum gyis/ jo bo la/ lam gyi chos thams cad kyi mchog gang lags zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ mkhas pa'i mchog bdag med kyi don rtogs pa yin/ btsun pa'i mchog sems rgyud dul ba yin/ yon tan gyi mchog phan sems che ba yin/ gdams ngag gi mchog rtag tu rang sems la lta ba yin/ gnyen po'i mchog gang yang rang bzhin med par shes pa yin/ spyod pa'i mchog 'jig rten dang mi mthun pa yin/ dngos grub kyi mchog nyon mongs pa je chung la song ba yin/ grub rtags kyi mchog 'dod pa ji chung la song ba yin/ sbyin pa'i mchog ma chags pa yin/ tshul khrims kyi mchog sems zhi ba yin/ bzod pa'i mchog dman sa bzung ba yin/ brtson 'grus kyi mchog bya ba thong pa yin/ bsam gtan gyi mchog blo ma bcos pa yin/ shes rab kyi mchog gang la yang der 'dzin med pa yin/ zhes sogs gsungs/ yang rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i zhal nas kyang /chog shes la sbyin pa'i phar phyin gnas//de yi ngo bo gtong sems yin//dkon mchog gis ma khrel na tshul khrims yod/ /dran rigs ma nyams pa bzod pa'i mchog /kun gyi grogs su brtson 'grus dgos/ /snang zhen lhar sgom bsam gtan te//'dzin zhen rang grol shes rab bo//de la bsam dang bsam byed med//tha mal ma yin nges shes bral//mya ngan 'das zhi dam pa'o//'di ni kun la brjod mi bya/ /sems kyis dam pa zung zhig gu/ /zhes gsungs/ de ltar pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i gzhung lam rgya chen po de thams cad mdo hril gyis dril na stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can zhig/ la 'ub kyis 'dus pa yin te/dpal sa ra ha pa'i do ha las kyang //snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid lta ba// 291

des ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin te//gal te snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgom na yang //'khor ba 'dir gnas thar pa yod dam ci//gang la gnyis po yod par gyur pa de//srid par mi gnas mya ngan 'das mi gnas/ /zhes gsungs/ srid pa dang mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis kar mi gnas pa ni/ mi gnas pa'i myang 'das rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yin no/ /de bzhin du mgon po klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /byang chub spub pa kha gcig la'o/ /zhes dang / jo bo rje lha gcig la 'brom ston pas chos thams cad kyi mthar thug gang lags/zhus pas /chos thams cad kyi mthar thug stong nyid snying rje'i snying bo can yin gsungs/dper na 'jig rten na sman dpa' po chig thub bya ba nad thams cad kyi gnyen por 'gro ba zhig yod pa yin/ dpe de bzhin du sman dpa' bo chig thub lta bu/chos nyid stong pa nyid kyi don rtogs na nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi gnyen po 'gro ba yin gsungs/ 'o na stong nyid rtogs zer ba kun gyi chags sdang kha ma bri ba gda' ba ci lags zhus pas/jo bo'i zhal nas de kun kha stong du song ba yin/stong pa nyid kyi don gsha' mar rtogs na/ lus ngag yid gsum ras bal rdog pas mnan pa'am/ phye thug la zo mar sbyar ba bzhin du 'gro/ slob dpon ārya de ba'i zhal nas/ chos rnams kun gyi gnas lugs stong par 'dug gam mi 'dug snyam du the tshor zos pa tsam kyis kyang srid pa hrul por 'gro bar gsungs/ des na stong pa nyid kyi don phyin ci ma log pa zhig rtogs na sman dpa' bo chig thub dang mtshungs te/ lam gyi chos thams cad de'i khong na yod gsungs/ stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i khong na lam gyi chos thams cad ji ltar yod zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal 292

nas/ lam gyi chos thams cad pha rol tu phyin pa drug tu 'dus te/ stong pa nyid kyi don phyin ci ma log pa zhig rtogs na/ phyi nang gi dngos po mtha' dag la zhen 'dod 'dzin chags med pas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rgyun chad med par yod/'dzin chags med pa la mi dge ba'i dri mas mi gos pas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyun chad med par yod/ de la nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa'i khong khro med pas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rgyun chad med par yod/ de rtogs pa'i don la sems mngon par spro ba dang ldan pas brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyun chad med par yod/ de la dngos por 'dzin pa'i g.yeng ba dang bral bas bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyun chad med par yod/ gang la yang 'khor gsum rtog pa'i yid dang bral bas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyun chad med par yod gsungs/'o na don rtogs pa gcig la stong pa nyid kyi lta sgom kho nas sangs rgya ba lags sam zhus pas/ 'di ltar snang tshod grags tshod 'di thams cad rang gi sems las ma byung ba med/ sems rig pa dang stong pa gnyis med du rtogs pa de lta ba yin/ de la ma yengs par dran pa rgyun chags su gnas pa de sgom pa yin/ de'i ngang nas sgyu ma lta bu'i tshogs gnyis gsog pa de spyod pa yin/ de de ltar nyams 'og tu tshud pa zhig yod na mi lam du 'ong / mi lam du byung na 'chi khar 'ong / 'chi khar byung na bar dor 'ong / bar dor byung na mchog gi dngos grub thob nges pa yin gsungs/ des na rgyal bas chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad kyang / byang zub kyi sems stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can 'di rgyud la skye ba'i thabs su sa/sungs pa yin/ byang zub kyi sems rin po 293

che 'di dang bral na/ lta sgom gyi chos ci tsam zab zab 'dra yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa la ci yang mi phan/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim la sogs gsang sngags kyi nyams len rnams kyang / byang chub kyi sems kyis zin na tshe 'dir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur 'gro ba yin kyang / byang zub kyi sems dang bral na mu stegs pa'i lam dang khyad par med/ mu stegs pa rnams la'ang lha bsgom pa sngags bzla ba/ rtsa rlung sgom pa/ rgyu 'bras la spang blang byed pa sogs du ma yod kyang / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gnyis po 'di med pas 'khor ba'i gnas las thar mi nus pa yin/des na dge bshes kha rag sgom chung gi zhal nas kyang / skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste sngags kyi bar du sdom pa thams cad blangs kyang 'jig rten pa'i chos la blo ma log na phan med/ dus rgyun du gzhan la chos 'chad kyang rang gi nga rgyal ma zhi na phan med/ yar skyed bton kyang skyabs 'gro'i chos gzhug shor na phan med/ nyin mtshan med par dge sbyor la 'bad kyang byang chub sems kyis ma zin na phan med/ ces gsungs/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed gnyis po 'di'i gzhi legs par ma zin par chos la thos bsam sgom gsum rgya gang che byed lo byas kyang / dper na dgun kha'i 'khyag rom steng du mkhar brtsegs dgu yod pa bzhengs te/ de la zhal ba dang ri mo la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur byas pa dang 'dra ste phugs su snying po ci yang med/ des na skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed gnyis po 'di chos ngan pa'am/ las dang po pa'i chos yin snyam du gal chung mi byed par/ lam thams cad kyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum 'di'i khong nas rdzogs pa zhig byed dgos pas/ bzang ngan mtho dman thams 294

cad nas 'di kho na la rtsal du bton nas sbyang bar byed pa gal che'o/ /khyad par bla ma dang ser mo ba lta bu dang zas dang gshin dkor za ba dang / shi bo yar 'dren byed pa rnams la ni/ rgyud na byang zub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa zhig med thabs med/ byang chub kyi sems dang bral na chos dang sgrib sbyang sogs ji ltar byas kyang shi gson su la yang phan mi thogs/ gzhan don ltar snang de yang phugs su rang 'dod kho na dang 'dres pas/ rang la yang dkor sgrib dang nyes pa mi zad pa bskyed cing phyi ma ngan song du 'gro ba las 'os med pa yin/ des na gang zag zhig la yang / nam mkha' la bya ltar 'phur ba/sa 'og tu bye ltar 'dzul ba/ri brag la zang thal du 'gro ba/mngon shes thogs pa med pa/rdo la phyag zhabs kyi rjes 'jog pa la sogs ngo mtshar gyi rnam grangs ji lta bu yod kyang rgyud la byang chub kyi sems med par 'dug na/ de mu stegs pa'am yang na gdon chen po zhig gis rgyun brlams pa gnyis las 'gro sa med/ de lta bu de la dang po blun dad kyis rjes su 'brangs nas mos gus dang 'bul ba sogs byas kyang / mthar rang gzhan gnyis ka phung ba las med/ byang chub kyi sems yang dag pa zhig rgyud la yod par 'dug na/ yon tan gzhan ci yang med kyang de la gang 'byel don dang ldan pa yin/ 'on kyang byang chub sems dpa' gang na yod mi shes/ shan pa dang smad 'tshong ma la sogs pa'i khrod na yang thabs la mkhas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' du ma yod par gsungs/ des na gang zag gzhan gyi rgyud na byang chub kyi sems yod pa dang med pa shes dka' bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / nga dang nga 'dra ba ma gtogs gang zag gi tshad gang zag gis mi bzung / zhes 295

gsungs/ des na rang rgyud la byang chub kyi sems gang gis skyed pa'i lha dang bla ma dge ba'i grogs po la sogs pa de la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag rang rgyud la yang gnas lugs kyi don rtogs snyam pa dang / mngon shes dang / ting nge 'dzin thon pa dang / yi dam lha'i zhal mthong ba la sogs pa lam rtags kyi yon tan ltar snang ba ci lta bu byung yang de la brten nas 'pho 'gyur med ba'i byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems gong 'phel du 'gro bar 'dug na/ de nyid yon tan yin par thag bcad/ gal te de dag la brten nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'grib par 'dug na/ lam rtags ltar snang ba de dag kyang bdud kyi bar chad dam phyin ci log gi lam yin par gdon mi za/ khyad par gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa bcos ma ma yin pa de rgyud la skyes na/ yul gong ma la dad pa dang dag snang / 'og ma la byams dang snying rje la sogs pa thun mong ma yin pa zhig skye mi 'ong ba'i thabs med de/ mnyam med dwags po rin po ches/ rje btsun mi la la/tshogs pa skyong ba'i dus nam yin zhus pas/ ji zhig na khyed rang gi sems kyi ngo bo da lta'i 'di ma yin pa the tshom thams cad dang bral ba zhig lhag ger mthong 'ong ste/ de'i dus su pha rgan nga la yang sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes thun mong ma yin pa zhig skye zhing / sems can la byams snying rje yang bcos ma ma yin pa zhig skye nges pas/ de'i dus su tshogs pa skyongs shig gsungs/ des na byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems la gzhi bcol nas chos la thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral bar nyams su len dgos/ dang po thos pas sgro 'dogs ma bcad na nyams su len mi shes pas/ ji skad du/ thos pa med pa'i sgom pa de/ / 296

lag rdum brag la 'dzegs pa 'dra/ /zhes gsungs/ thos pas sgro 'dogs gcod zer ba de yang shes bya'i chos rgya che zhing grangs mang ba thams cad shes par bya mi dgos te/ de thams cad snyigs dus tshe thung gcig la shes kyang mi nus/ des na rang gi gang nyams spu blang bar bya rgyu'i chos de thog mtha' bar gsum du sgrub pa'i tshul thams cad mngon par shes shing / de la bsam pas sgro 'dogs thams cad chod dgos pa yin/ sngon jo bo rje snye thang na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ zhang sna zung ston pa dang / kyung ston pa dang / lhang tshang ston pa gsum gyis tshad ma'i grub mtha' zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ phyi rol mu stegs pa dang / nang pa sangs rgyas nga/'i grub mtha' mang du yod/ de thams cad rnam par rtog pa'i phreng ba yin/rnam rtog bgrang gis mi lang dgos pa med/ tshe la longs med pas snying po'i don bsdu ba'i dus yin gsungs/ zhang sna chung ston pas/ snying po'i don ji ltar bsdu zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje byang zub kyi sems sbyang / de rnams kyi don du tshogs ba/nyis gsog pa la 'bad par gyis/ de las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can thams cad dang thun mong du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngos/ de thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa mtshan nyid mi lam sgyu ma lta bur shes par gyis gsungs/ de ltar nyams len snying po'i gnad du bsdu ma shes na shes shes go go rig rig mang pos phan pa ci yang med de/ sngon jo bo rje lha cig bod du phebs pa'i tshe/ lo chen rin chen bzang pos ga/dan drangs pas//jo bos lo tsā ba la/ chos 'di dang 'di rte bu mkhyen nam zhes rim par dris pas mi mkhyen pa med pa ltar 297

'dug pas/jo bo mgu ste ngo mtshar che/ khyed lta bu'i mkhas pa bod na bzhugs bzhin du kho bo bod du 'ong mi dgos par 'dug gsungs/ slar yang de thams cad stan thog gcig tu nyams su len na ci ltar byed gsungs pas/ rang rang gi gzhung nas ji ltar bshad pa ltar nyams su len pa yin zhus pas/jo bo ma dgyes te/ lo tsā ba rul/ nga bod du 'ong dgos par 'dug gsungs/'o na ji ltar byed zhus pas/ chos thams cad gnad gcig tu bsdus nas nyams su len dgos pa yin gsungs/ des na bla ma'i man ngag gi steng du nyams len gyi gnad dril ba de ma shes pa'i thabs med/ de ltar shes nas nyams su ma blangs na ci yang mi phan ste/ rje mi la'i zhal nas kyang / mi ltogs pa la zan go bas mi chog za dgos pa ltar/chos shes pas mi phan nyams su blang dgos/zhes gsungs/de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i don po rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa dang bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por song ba zhig/ yong dgos te/ rje mi la'i zhal nas/ zos ma zos dmar chung byad la shes/ /zer ba ltar/ chos shes ma shes dang nyams su blangs ma blangs bdag 'dzin dang /nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por song ma song gis shes gsungs/de bzhin du dge bshes ston pa la/ pu to pas/ chos dang chos ma yin pa'i gnam thig gang lags zhus pas/ ston pa'i zhal nas/ nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro na chos yin/mi 'gro na chos min/ 'jig rten pa kun dang mi mthun na chos yin/mthun na chos min/bka' lung dang mthun na chos yin la/mi mthun na chos min/rjes bzang na chos yin/ rjes ngan na chos min/ gsungs/ yang slob dpon lce sgom gyi zhal nas las rgyu 'bras yid ches pa ni/ dbang po tha ma'i yang dag pa'i 298

lta ba yin/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad snang ba dang stong pa dang rig pa dang stong pa zung 'jug bzhir rtogs pa ni/ dbang po 'bring gi yang dag pa'i lta ba ni/blta bya lta byed rtogs pa gsum dbyer med par rtogs pa yin/ dbang po rab kyi yang dag pa'i lta ba yin/dmigs pa rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa ni/dbang po tha ma'i yang dag pa'i sgom pa yin/ zung 'jug bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa ni/ dbang po 'bring gi yang dag pa'i sgom pa yin/ bsgom bya sgom byed nyams spyong gsum med cing mi dmigs pa ni/ dbang po rab kyi yang dag pa'i sgom pa yin/ las rgyu 'bras mig gi 'bras bu ltar srung ba ni/ dbang po tha ma'i yang dag pa'i spyod pa yin/ chos thams cad mi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul gyis spyod pa ni/dbang po 'bring gi yang dag pa'i spyod pa yin/gang ci la yang mi spyod pa ni/dbang po rab kyi yang dag pa'i spyod pa yin/ bdag 'dzin nyon mongs rnam rtog sogs je chung ji chung la song ba ni/ dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum ka'i yang dag pa'i drod rtags yin/ zhes gsungs shing / mnyam med dwags po'i lam mchog rin po cher yang 'di dang mthun par gsungs/ des na chos thos pa'i dus snying po'i gnad bsdu shes dgos te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ shes bya nam mkha'i gza' skar 'dra/ /bslab dgos gnas la zad pa med/ /da res chos sku snying po'i don//'gyur med btsan sa bzung na legs//zhes gsungs/bsam pa'i dus sgro 'dogs chod pa dgos te/ rgya gar dam pa sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ bla ma'i gdams ngag tshol ba la khra chang mas gzan tshol ba lta bu zhig dgos/ chos nyan pa'i dus ri dwags sgra la nyan pa lta bu zhig dgos/ sgom pa'i dus lkugs 299

pas ro myang ba lta bu zhig dgos/ bsam pa'i dus byang pas lug 'dreg pa lta bu zhig dgos/ 'bras bu'i dus nyi zla sprin las grol ba lta bu zhig dgos gsungs/des na chos la thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral ba dgos te/ mnyam med dwags po rin po'i zhal nas/ chos la thos bsam sgom gsum dkrug mang byed pa ni gnad ma nor ba yin gsungs/ de ltar thos bsam sgom gsum byas pa'i 'bras bu yang byams snying rje byang zub kyi sems gong nas gong du 'phel zhing / bdag 'dzin dang nyon mongs pa je chung je zung la song ba zhig ni nges par dgos pa yin no/ /de ltar byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i khrid 'di ni chos thams cad kyi nying khu/ lam thams cad kyi snying po yod na des chog nges pa dang / med na thabs chag nges pa'i chos yin pas go lo dang thos lor mi bzhag par snying thag pa nas nyams su len pa gal che'o/ /sems mchog bskyed par rlom yang skyes pa med/ /phyin drug lam la bslabs kyang rang 'dod bcas/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra blo chung sems can rnams/ /byang chub sems mchog 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba jeg pa chen po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i khrid do// 300

gsum pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ sgrib gnyis dre mas dben kyang sbyong tshul ston//lam mchog mthar phyin nges kyang slob pa'i tshul/ /srid zhi'i mtha' las 'das kyang srid na snang / / mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo//don gsum pa sgrib pa sbyong ba bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas la/chos gsan pa'i chul la sogs pa 'dra/ dngos gzhi gsan par bya ba'i chos la/zab mo'i lam gyi nyams rtogs khyad par can skye ba la bar du gcod pa'i gtso bo ni sdig sgrib bag chags yin/ de yang kun gzhi'i me long la rtogs pa'i gzugs brnyan 'char bar byed pa la sgrib pa sbyong ba gal che ste/ dper na me long la gzugs brnyan 'char bar byed pa la byi dor byed pa gal che baXltar yin/ de'i phyir sgrib pa sbyong ba'i thabs grangs med pa zhig rgyal bas bstan pa las/ de dag thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa ni/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas yin/ de yang spyir sdig pa'i las gang yang bshags pas mi 'dag pa med de/ sngon gyi dam pa dag gi zhal nas/ spyir sdig pa la yon tan med kyang / bshags pas 'dag pa sdig pa'i yon tan yin gsungs/ des na phyi so thar gyi sdom pa dang 'gal ba/nang byang zub sems kyi bslab bya dang 'ag/la ba/ gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa sogs sdig pa'i las ci tsam mchang che yang / bshags pas mi 'dag pa 301

med de/ bram ze'i khye'u mi gdung ba'am sor mo'i phreng ba can gyis mi stong dgu brgya go dgu bsad pa yang / bshags pas sor grod de tshe de la dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob/ rgyal po ma skyes dgras rang gi pha bsad pa yang phyis bshags pas sor chud de/ dmyal bar dar gyi pho long brdabs pa tsam sbong nas thar pa sogs du ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis mdo sde rnams las gsungs/ des na mgon po klu sgrub kyi zhal nas kyang /gang zhig sngon chad bag med gyur pa la//phyis nas bag dang ldan par gyur pa de/ /zla ba sprin bral lta bur rnam mdzes te/ /dga' bo sor phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhin/ /zhes gsungs/ de yang gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas/snying thag pa nas legs par bshags na 'dag pa yin gyi/ rang bzhin du kha yengs mig yengs/ sems rnam rtog gzhan gyi rjes su 'brangs bzhin du/ ngag nas mthol lo bshags so sogs bshags tshig tsam kha ton byed pa dang / phyis kyang bshags pas chog pas phyin chad sdig pa'i las byas kyang mi gnod do snyam pa sogs kyi sgo nas bshags pa byas kyang mi 'dag ste/ rje mi la'i zhal nas/sdig bshags pas e 'dag snyam pa na//dge ba dran na 'dag pa yin//zhes gsungs/ des na bshags pa gang la yang gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba ni/ci nas kyang gal che/ de la stobs bzhi ni/ rten gyi stobs/ nyes byas sun 'byin gyi sto/bas/sdom pa'i stobs/ gnyen po kun spyod kyi stobs dang bzhi yin/dang po rten gyi stobs/ ni/ skabs 'dir rdo rje sems dpa' la skyabs su bzung nas sbon 'jus bi byang sems dang ldan pa de yin/ skabs gzhan du yang sdig pa bshags pa'i yul de nyid rten yin te/dper na phung po gsum pa'i dus sangs rgyas so lnga 302

dang /de bzhin du dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam/sku gsung thugs rten la sogs pa gang gi drung nas bshags pa byed kyang de nyid rten gyi stobs yin/ de bzhin du smon 'jug byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa ni/ sdig bshags pa thams cad la med du mi rung / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa med na sdig spung stobs bzhi tshang bas bshags kyang cung zad srab tu 'gro ba tsam las rtsa ba nas 'dag par ma gsungs/byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa de rgyud la skyes na/ sngon chad sdig pa'i las ci tsam byas pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag par gsungs te/ spyod 'jug las/ sdig pa shin tu mi bzad byas na yang / /dpa' la brten nas 'jigs pa chen po ltar//gang la bsten nas yud kyis grol 'gyur na/ /de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi bsten/ /des ni dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig chen rnams/ /skad cig gcig gis nges par sreg par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ nyes byas sun 'byen pa'i stobs ni/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa mi dge ba'i las thams cad la 'gyod sems byed pa de yin/ de ltar sdig pa la sdig tu mthong zhing / de la 'gyod sems drag po'i sgo nas mi 'chab par bshags pa med na mi 'dag ste/phung po gsum pa las kyang /mthol lo bshags so/mi 'chab bo/mi sbed do/zhes gsungs/de bzhin du mkhas grub karma chags med kyis kyang/ 'gyod pa med na bshags pas mi 'dag pas/ /sngar byas sdig pa khog tu dug song ltar/ /ngo tsha 'jigs skrag 'gyod pa chen pos bshags//zhes gsungs/sdom pa'i stobs ni/ rang gis sngar byas pa'i sdig pa'i las de nyid dran te/ da nyi ma phyin chad srog dmar po 'di la bab kyang /de lta bu'i sdig pa'i las mi bgyid do snyam pa de yin/ phung po gsum pa las kyang /303

slan chad kyang gcod cing sdom par bgyi'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / de bzhin du bde smon las kyang / phyin chad sdom sems med na mi dag pas/ /phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi dge'i las/ /da nas mi bgyi sems la dam bca' bzung / /zhes gsungs/ gnyen po kun tu spyod ba'i stobs ni/sngar byas kyi sdig pa'i gnyen por dge ba'i las gang 'grub sgrub pa dang / khyad par rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal ba/ gzhan gyi bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo ba/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed dang / gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i ngo bo skyong ba sogs yin/ sngon mnyam med dwags po rin po che'i slob ma sgom pa zhig gis/ sngar gsung rab kyi blus zos pa dran nas 'gyod de zhus pas/ gsung rab de nyid bzhengs shig gsungs/ gsungs rab de bzhengs par brtsams pas rnam g.yeng mang du byung / des sun nas spu mdun du phyin te/ga/sung rab bzhengs pa la yang rnam g.yengs mang po rang byung / sdig pa bshags pa la yang ngo bo skyong bar rang las zab pa med dam zhus pas/ dwags po rin po che dgyes te/ don du de ga rang yin/ sngar byas pa'i sdig pa'i phung po ri rab tsam yod kyang / ngo bo mthong ba'i skad cig la 'dag pa yin gsungs/ des sdig pa sbyong ba la byang chub kyi sems sgom pa dang gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i rgyun skyong ba gnyis las zab pa med pas/ 'dir yang de gnyis dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas rdo rje sems dpa' bsgoms te bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong byed pa dang / yig brgya bzla ba sogs yin/ de ltar ga/nyen po stobs bzhi'i dbe ba dran pa'i ngang nas/rdor sems sgom bzlas byed pa dngos ni/ rang nyid tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bor 304

mda' gang tsam gyi steng gi nam mkhar padma dkar po 'dab ma stong brdal zhig bsgom/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba zhig bsgom/ nya gang zer ba de che chung gi tshad ma yin gyi/ zla ba'i cha shas thams cad kha gang ba'i tshes bco lnga'i zla ba lta bu phyogs thams cad la ya yo khyag 'khyog med par gyi ler yod pa'i don yin/ de'i steng hūṃ yig dkar po 'od zer bkrag mdangs ldan pa gcig sgom/ gzhan ma'i lugs la hūṃ yig de las 'od zer spros bsdu sogs yod kyang rang lugs la med/ de nas skad cig gis hūṃ yig de nyid gnas 'gyur nas/ ngo bo dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo mtshungs med thugs rje'i gter mdzod dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la/ rnam pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma 'bum gyis 'khyud ba lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas rig stong gi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ g.yon snang stong gi dril bu dku la brten pa/zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/sku la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan chas bcu gsum gyes spras pa/ de yang dar gyi chas gos lnga dang / rin po che'i rgyan brgyad las/dang po dar gyi chas gos lnga ni/cod pan dang gcig stod g.yogs dang gnyis/dar dpyangs dang gsum/sku regs dang bzhi/smad dkris dang lnga'o//rin po che'i rgyan brgyad ni/dbu rgyan dang gcig snyan rgyan g.yas g.yon gnyis gcig tu brtsis pa dang gnyis/ mgul rgyan dang gsum/dpung rgyan gnyis gcig tu brtsis pa dang bzhi/ do shal dang se mo do gnyis gcig tu brtsis pas lnga/ phyag gdub gnyis gcig tu brtsis pas drug sor 305
