gdub rnams gcig tu brtsis pas bdun/ zhabs gdub gnyis gcig tu brtsis pas brgyad do/ /yum snyems ma dkar mo dang gnyis med du 'khril ba/ sku snang la rang bzhin ma grub ba snang stong chu zla lta bu'am/ me long du gzugs brnyan shar ba lta bu bkra lam me yod pa/ rang gi spyi bor rang gi kha lta phyogs su zhal gyu nas bzhugs yod pa de lta bu zhig bsgoms pa de rten gyi stobs yin/ de nas de ltar gsal btab pa de yang thang sku dang gyang sku lta bu'i lebs pa bcar bcar po yang ma yin/ sa sku dang gser sku lta bu'i dngos po gdos bcas kyi rang bzhin sems med bem po'i rnam pa lta bu'ang ma yin/ snang cha nas spyan gyi dkar nag tshun chad ma 'dres par gsal ba la/ stong cha nas dngos po gdos bcas sha khrag nang khrol la sogs pa'i rnam par grub pa spu tsam yang med pa nam mkhar mja' mtshon shar ba 'am/ shel bum dri ma med pa lta bu/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dang mgon po rdo rje sems dba' gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin thugs ye shes kyi mkhyen cha dang bcas pas/bdag dang sems can thams cad thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su dgongs te bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ rang gi tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bzung ste dus da lta la thug gi bar du/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba bcu/ mtshams med pa lnga/ lci ba bzhi/ log pa brgyad/ phyi so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba/ nang byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang 'gal ba/ gsang ba rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba/'jig rten pa'i mna' zos pa/ rdzun bshad pa/ khrel dang ngo tsha nyams pa la sogs sdig pa'i las bsags tshad dngos su dran pa thams cad blo la blangs te/ bla ma rdo rje sems 306

dpa'i spyan sngar rang nyid ngo tsha 'jigs skrag 'gyod pa dang bcas pas sha zing spu zing byed cing mthol lo bshags so snyam pa dang / de bzhin du rang gi yid la mi dran pa'ang tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i dus tshun zad nas bsags pa du ma zhig yod nges pas/de dag thams cad mi 'chab bo/ /mi sped do//mthol lo bshags so/ /bzod par gsol lo/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa de dag thams cad dus da lta nyid du/ myur ba nyid du/ 'dug sa 'di ru lhag ma tsam yang med par byang zhing dag pa zhig thugs rje ma zung snyam pa ni sun 'byen pa'i stobs/ sngon chad ni bdag mi shes rmongs pa'i dbang gis sdig pa dang mi dge ba'i las de dag bsags pa lags kyi/ da ni drin chen gyi bla ma'i thugs rje la brten nas khe nyen shes pa'i rang bzhin can yin pas/ da phyin chad ni srog la bab kyang sdig pa'i las de lta bu mi bgyid do/ /snyam pa ni sdom pa'i stobs te/ de lta bu'i dag pa dran pa'i ngang nas/ āḥbadag nyid thal ma spyi bo ru/ /sogs nas/ ma lus byang bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod/ de nas rdor sems yab yum gnyis su med pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yungs kar glebs pa tsam gyi steng du hūṃ yig dkar po spus bris ba lta bu zhig gsal la/oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya sogs/yig ge brgya pa tshar gcig brjod pas/ hūṃ gi mtha' bskor du yi ge brgya po rwa langs pa lta bu gcig la gcig ma reg tsam du bskor bar bsam/ de nas rang gi ngag nas yi ge brgya pa gsol 'debs kyi tshul du bzlas pas/ yig 'bru rnams las thugs rje ye shes kyi bdud ci 'khyags rom mes zhu ba las chu thig pa ltar/ thig thig hram hram du babs pa/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud yab yum snyoms par zhugs 307

pa'i sbyor mtshams nas thon rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang gi nad thams cad khrag rul rnag rul/ gdon thams cad srog chags sdom sdig pa sbal pa nya sprul lhong mo shig la sogs pa'i rnam pa/ sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu sol khu thal dud sprin pa rlangs pa'i rnam par zu sna rgyug pas sa rdul ded pa ltar bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis thogs pa med par ded de rkang mthil 'og sgo ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas nag nyil gyis phyir thon/ rang gi 'og tu sa gas pa'i mar zhabs na/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje la 'khor lan chags bu lon sha 'khon gyi bdag po bdag mo thams cad kyis bskor te kha lag sbar gsum zed nas yod pa'i nang du song bar bsams la yig brgya bzla/ de yang dmigs pa thams cad gcig char du gsal nus na de ltar bya/ de ltar mi nus na res 'ga' rdo rje sems dpa'i sku zhal phyag sogs la dmigs pa gtad de bzla/res 'ga' rgyan cha lugs 'a dmigs pa gtad de bzla/ res 'ga' bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis nad gdon sdig sgrib bkru ba la dmigs pa gtad de bzla/ res 'ga' 'gyod pa dang sdom sems dran par byas te bzla/ de nas mthar sa 'og na 'khod pa'i 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje la sogs lan chags bu lon sha 'khon gyi bdag po rnams lhong ngoms shing tshim/lan chags 'khor/ bu lon sod/ sha 'khon byang / sdig sgrib dag gshin rje de'i kha lag sbar gsum yang zum/ sa gas pa yang sos/ rang gi lus 'di yang phyi gsal nang gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin du yod pa las dbus su rtsa dbu ma dang / de las gyes pa'i 'khor lo bzhi po gdugs kyi rtsibs ma lta bu/ lte ba sprul ba'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi kha yar gyu ba/308

snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad kha mar gyu ba/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug kha yar gyu ba/ spyi bor bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis kha mar gyu ba de ltar gsal gdab/ slar yang bdud rtsi'i rgyun sngar ltar babs pas/ rang gi lus spyi bor bde chen gyi 'khor lo nas bzung ste rtsa 'khor lo bzhi po thams cad dang / de las gyes pa'i lus kyi nang thams cad rkang lag gi sor mo'i rtse tshun chad/shel bum 'o mas gang ba ltar bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis skya ltem me gang / bum dbang / gsang dbang / sher dbang / tshig dbang rin po che ste dbang bzhi thob/ las kyi sgrib pa/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa/shes bya'i sgrib pa/ bag chags kyi sgrib pa ste sgrib pa bzhi dag dga' ba/ mchog dga'/ khyad par gyi dga' ba/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ste dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ sprul sku/ longs sku/ chos sku/ ngo bo nyid sku ste sku bzhi'i go 'phang rgyud la bzhag par bsam/de nas/mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/sogs nas/byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gnong tshig brjod ma thag tu/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dgyes bzhin zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib nyams chag thams cad dag pa yin no/ /zhes gnang ba byin te 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis rang nyid sngar bskyed pa dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems dpar gnas 'gyur/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yungs 'bru glebs pa tsam gyi steng du/ dbus su hūṃ mthing ga/ de'i mdun du oṃ dkar po/g.yas su badzra ser po/ rgyab tu sa dmar po/ g.yon tu twa ljang gu rnams gsal nas/ oṃ badzra satwa hūṃ/ zhes bzlas pa dang mnyam du yig 'bru lnga po las/'od zer 309

kha dog dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga lnga yar 'phros pa'i rtse la sgeg sogs 'dod yon gyi lha mo rnams kyi phyag na bkra shis rtags brgyad/rgyal srid sna bdun/'phan gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ bla re/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong /dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil pa la sogs mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa spros nas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams bsam gyis mi khyab pa na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad la thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag thugs rje dang byen rlabs thams cad 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rnam par byung nas rang la thim pas/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub lam dang 'brel pa rig 'dzin bzhi dang / mthar thug gi 'bras bu mi slob zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du gyur par bsam pa de/ rang don chos sku'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin/ yang yig 'bru lnga po las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs brgya stong grangs med pa mar 'phros/ khams gsum rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog de rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i sdig sgrib sdug bsngal bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad mun par nyi ma shar ba ltar sang sang dag phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams dang / nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur nas/de thams cad kyi zhal nas/ oṃ badzra satwa hūṃ/zhes 'ur di ri ri sgrogs par bsams nas bzla ba ni/ gzhan don gzugs sku'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin/ de ltar yang chos spyod bag chags rang grol las/ 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas nas rtog sgrib sbyangs/ zhes gsungs pa yang 'di lta bu'i 310

dmigs gnad la zer ba yin/ dmigs pa'i gnad 'di lta bu la brten nas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa thabs mkhas pa'i gnad kyis bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa yang skad cig ma re la rdzogs shing / nam mkhas gar khyab kyi sems can gyi don yang mnyam du sgrub nus pa yin/ de ltar bzlas pa ci rigs byas pa'i rjes su thun bsdu ran pa na/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten mngon dga'i zhing du snang ba thams cad nang bcud kyi rdor sems rigs lnga'i lha tshogs la bsdu/ de rnams kyang rim gyis 'od du yal nas rang la bsdu/ rang yang mtha' nas rim gyis 'od du yal nas thugs ka'i oṃ la thim/ o badzra la badzra sa la/ sa twa la/ twa hūṃ gi zhabs kyu/ 'a chung ha khog mgo bo zla tshes thig le tsā da'i bar rim bzhin thim nas/ tsā da yang nam mkhar 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar mi dmigs spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang la dar cig lhod de mnyam par bzhag de nas yang rnam rtog zhig 'char bar rtsom pa na/ slar yang snod bcud thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i zhing khams su bkra lam gyis gsal la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag//rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur nas/ /sogs bsngo ba dang smon lam bya/de ltar rdor sems sgom bzlas byed pa 'di la sogs pa bzlas brjod gang byed kyi dus su sems dmigs pa las gzhan du ma yengs pa dang / bzlas brjod mi tshig gis bar ma chod pa ni ci nas kyang gal che ste/ rgyud las kyang / gal te ting 'dzin 'di med na/ /rgya mtsho'i 'jing gi pha wong bzhin/ /bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin//zhes dang /de bzhin du dag dang ma dag stong 'gyur yin/ /ting 'dzin yod med 'bum 'gyur yin/ /zhes gsungs/ sngags dang bsnyen pa bzla 311

ba'i dus su tha mal ma dag pa'i long gtam gzhan dang bsres nas bzla ba ni/sngags ma dag pa yin te/ dper na gser dang dngul la ra gan nam zangs la sogs cung zad 'dres kyang / gser min nam dngul log tu grags te/ des gser dngul gyi go mi chod pa dang 'dra/des na o rgyan chen po'i zhal nas kyang /lo gcig 'bag bsnyen byas pa pas/ /zla gcig smra bcad byas pa dga'/ /zhes gsungs/ des na da lta'i dus grong chog pa rnams kyang tshogs gral sogs su 'don pa dang bzlas brjod kyi dus smra bcad byed pa ni ci nas kyang gal che/ tha mal pa'i ngag 'khyal dang 'dres pa'i 'don zlos sogs la snying po ci yang med pa dang / khyad par gshin po sogs kyi don yin na/ bar do na gnas pa'i sems can de/ 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i gdung ba'i tshe phan du re nas yon gnas dang bla mchod la sogs pa'i drung du rgyug de'i tshe de dag gi nying nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang /sdom pa dang dam tshig mi dag pa dang /chags sdang gi gtam dang rtog pa la sogs pa 'char gyin yod na/ bar do'i 'gro ba de mngon shes dang ldan pa yin pas/ de dag shes nas bla mchod la log lta'am zhe sdang skyes nas rkyen des ngan song du 'gro bar bshad pas/ de lta bu'i bla mchod ni/ yod pa las med pa dga'/ khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i cho ga rnams ni/bskyed rim gsal 'debs brjod pa tshig gi sgo/ zhes bskyed rim gyi gnad de dag gsal 'debs pa'i tshig tsam yin pa la/ gsal 'debs rgyu'i bskyed rdzogs kyi don la blo kha tsam mi phyogs par kha tshig stong pa zhig gis gsal gsal bsgom bsgom dmigs dmigs la sogs pa cho ga'i tshig rigs mang po zhig gyar ma gyer 312

khug 'ur 'ur chem chem du gyer te/ don gyi snying po ngag gi bzlas brjod bsnyen pa dngos la thug tsa na/ blo bag gis lhod tha na lus tshugs drang po zhig yod pa yan chad shig gis bshig mi dge ba brgya phrag gi 'byung khungs tha ma kha la sogs pa gzhib/ phu mda' la shod kyi gtam 'brel pa med pa'i ngag 'khyal mang po'i gter sgo phye/ phreng ba stong bgrang rgyu nag bda' bda' byed pas dus 'da'/ phyi 'phred tsa na gnam la gcig bltas nas/ badzra pu ste dhū pe zer zhing rol mo 'ur chems se gtong ba ni/ cho ga'i gzugs brnyan las kyang yang brnyan tha chad pa yin pas/ de lta bu las ni bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas ltung bshags sam bzang spyod tshar re tsam bton na de dga' nges so/ /de ltar ma dag pa'i bzlas brjod dang cho ga'i gzugs brnyan la brten nas gshin po ngan song du 'phen pa'i bla mchod des ni/ gsona'i po sku rim byas kyang phan las gnod pa che ba de dang 'dra/ de lta bu des dkor zos pa yang lca sa/sa kyi tho lum me 'bar ba zos pa dang 'dra nges pa de yin no/ /des na dad zas dang ga/shin dkor za ba rnams ni bla ma'am gra pa su yin kyang 'dra ste/ sha che chung thud srab 'thug 'bul ba bzang ngan kho na la thugs dam gyi mthil du mi bya bar/ nad pa'am shi bo su yin kyang 'dra ste gal 'gags la bab ste sdug thug pa'i sems can skyabs dang bral ba de la phan 'dod kyi byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis zin par byas nas/ bskyed rdzogs rang gis gang shes snying thag pa nas ma yengs par 'bad/ de ltar mi shes pa rnams kyang tshig rjes don dran tsam mam/ tha na yang nyam thag pa'i sems can la byams pa dang snying rje dkon mchog gsum gyi bden mthu bslu ba 313

med pa la dad pa nges shes sogs lus ngag yid gsum chun gcig dril gyis 'bad de/ cho ga dang bzlas brjod sogs sgra dag sgros gtsang ba re 'grub nges byas na/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i nus mthu byang chub sems kyi phan yon tshad med pa rnams la brten nas/nad pa dang shi bo gang yin de la phan thogs nges shing / mi'i stan thog nas rang gi sgrib pa sbyong zer ba ltar/ rang gzhan gyi tshogs gnyis mnyam du rdzogs/ 'brel tshad thar pa'i lam la 'god pa yin pas de lta bu re la ci nas kyang 'bad dgos so/ /lar da lta'i dus na bla ma'am ser mo cung zad bzang du re ba rgyu 'bras shes pa rnams ni/ dkor gyi nyes dmigs tsam la 'jigs nas nad pa dang shi bo sdug thug pa'i sems can de la/ byin rlabs dang bsngo smon tsam yang mi byed par byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi rtsa ba gcod/ phal cher ni ha cang rang 'dod che ches pas sbyin bdag gi tshogs gral du 'ong / de tshang la dgos rgyu'i 'don pa de mi 'don par/ rang gi kha ton nag lcibs lcibs shig blangs te de chag mi nyan pa'i khul gyis 'don tshul byed/ de dag su yin kyang 'dra ste rang don gyi 'don pa dang bzlas brjod sogs cung zad re byed pa de la gzab gzab lta bu re byed cing / de rang gi sgrib spyong ngam dkor sbyong yin khul byed/ sbyin bdag gi 'don pa mang tshogs kyi gral du byed pa de la ni kha yengs mig yengs khral rgyug ma byed/ gang bskyabs par bya rgyu'i sems can shi gson su yin kyang / de'i don ni blo la mi 'char ba de rnams ni byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi rtsa ba chad pa yin pas/ rjes nas dkor sbyong byas kyang rang 'dod yid byed kyi blo ngan des 314

dkor sgrib spyong ba yang dka'/ dang po nyid nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la gzhi bcol/ bskyed rdzogs sogs ci shes ci nus la snying thag pa nas 'bad/ sems can la phan 'dod kyi kun slong dang ma bral ba byas na/ rang gi khyim nas bskyed rdzogs bsgoms te bzlas brjod byas pa dang / gzhan gyi khyem nas bskyed rdzogs bsgoms te bzlas brjod byas pa la ni khyad par spu tsam yang med cing / gang ltar yang rang 'dod kyi blo dang bral te gzhan don la dmigs dgos pa ni 'dra 'dra yin pas de lta bu ni nges par dgos so/ /de ltar sems dmigs pa las gzhan du mi yengs shing tha mal gyi smra ba dang ma 'dres par/ dus gcig la yi ge brgya pa lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na sngar byas kyi sdig sgrib dang nyams chag thams cad nges par dag pa bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal gyis bzhes pa yin te/ dri med bshags rgyud las kyang / bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi yang snying nyams chas/ dang rtog/ sgrib thams cad sbyong bar byed pa/yi ge brgya pa zhes bya ba bshags pa thams cad kyi rgyal po 'di dus gcig la lan brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas na nyams chag thams cad bskangs te/ ngan song gsum du spung ba las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /rnal 'byor pa gang zhig gis yid dam du bcas nas 'don na/ mi de tshe 'di la'ang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis sras kyi dam par dgongs nas srung skyob mdzad la/ shi 'phos nas kyang /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sras kyi thu bor 'gyur ba gdon mi za'o/ zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas rtsa ba yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chag gang byung yang / nyin re bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' 315

bsgoms nas yi ge brgya pa nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzlas na/ des ltung ba byin gyis rlabs pa zhes bya ste/ spung ba byung ba'i rnam smin gong nas gong du 'phel 'gro rgyu med pa dang / yi ge brgya pa 'bum phrag gcig bzlas na ltung ba thams cad rtsa ba nas dag pa snying po rgyan las gsungs te/pad dkar zla ba'i gdan gnas pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' legs dmigs te/ /yi ge brgya pa cho ga bzhin/ /nyi shu rtsa re bzlas gyur na/ /ltung sogs byen gyis brlab 'gyur phyir/ /'phel ba ru ni mi 'gyur zhes/ /grub pa mchog rnams kyis bshad pas/ /rtag par du ni nyams su blang //'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas gyur na//rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid 'grur//zhes gsungs/ de'i phyir na da lta'i dus 'dir bod yul 'di na bla ma ser mo mi skya pho mo yan chad dbang re thob ma myong ba ni su yang med/ des na gsang sngags kyi sgor ma zhugs pa su yang med pa yin la/ gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs phyin chad ni/dam tshig ma bsrung na dmyal ba dang /bsrungs na rdzogs pa'i sa/ngas rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa gnyis las 'gro sa gzhan med pa/ dper na sbrul snyug dong du bcug pa lta bur gsungs/ sprul zhig snyug dong du bcug na/ yang na de yar kha dang yang na mar zhabs gnyis las 'gro sa med pa lta bu yin/ yon tan mdzod las kyang / sngags la zhugs pa'i skyes bu ngan song dang / /sangs rgyas gnyis las 'gro sa gsum pa med/ /zhes gsungs/ de nas gsang sngags kyi dam tshig ni/ phra zhing grangs mang la srung dka' ba yin pas/ jo bo rje lha cig lta bus kyang / sngags la zhugs pa'i dus nyes ba car rgyag/ nyar rgyag byung gsungs na/ da ltar rang re gnyen po zung ba/ dran pa nyams pa/ shes bzhin med pa/spung ba'i rnam grangs 3 16

leb/sa par mi shes pa rnams la ni/ ltung ba'i rnam grangs char pa bzhin 'bab par gdon mi za bas/ de dag gi gnyen por dus dang rnam pa thams cad du rdor sems sgom bzlas 'di la yi dam du bzung nas tha na yang yig brgya nyer sa/cig re ma chag par byed pa ni gal che'o/ /gal te rang ngos nas bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad la mkhas pa/ dran pa dang shes bzhin gsal ba sogs la brten dam tshig nyams pa'i skyon ma byung yang / gzhan rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa dag dang gtam bsre ba dang / spyod lam gyis 'brel ba/ tha na lung ba gcig gi chu la btung bas kyang zlas nyams dang zhor nyams kyi nyes pa skyed pa yin pas bshags sbyong la 'bad dkos te/ rgyud las kyang / nyams la 'grogs shing nyams pa skong ba dang / /nyams dang snod min rnams la chos bshad dang / /nyams la mi 'dzem nyams pa de dag gi /nyams grib skyo na gyis gos par grur to 'tshal/ /tshe 'di'i rkyen dang phyi ma'i sgrib gyur rnams/ /rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags/ /zhes gsungs/ tshogs gral gcig na dam tshig nyams pa'i mi gcig yod kyang /de'i nyams grib kyis phog ste dam ldan brgya stong yod kyang sgrub pa'i 'bras bu cung zad kyang mi 'byin pa 'o ma rul pa thigs pa gcig gis ma rul pa zangs gang ya nga rul bar byed pa dang / sbal ba rma can gcig gis sbal pa thams cad rma can du byed pa lta bu yin te/ ji skad du/ ji ltar 'o ma thigs pa gcig /rul bas thams cad rul ba ltar/ /rna'/ 'byor nyams gyur gcig gis ni/ rnal 'byor can kun ma rungs byed/ /ces gsungs/ der ma zad bla ma skyes bu dam pa grub pa thob pa zhig yin kyang nyams grib kyis mi gos pa ni su yang med de/ 'gro mgon 317

gling rje ras pa lta bu yang tsā ri'i gnas nang du zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gros bar chad brtsams nas nyi ma'i gung mun rub ste skar ma khra gyi le 'char ba'i mun pa byung yang / thogs pa med par dmar nag rakta'i mtsho 'gram du phyin nas rdo rje'i glu blangs te bro brdungs rdo la zhabs rjes bzhag pa da lta yang mjal du yod pa de lta bu'i grub thob yin kyang / phyis slo/ba ma dam tshig nyams pa zhig mdun du byung nas nyams grib kyi thugs myos te gsung smra mi shes par gyur pa'i lo rgyus yod/ de bzhin du grub thob u rgyan pa'i mgur las kyang / gangs can gyi sprang po rin chen dbal/ /dgra nyams grib min pas thub ma myong / /grogs bla ma min pas skyob ma myong / /zhes gsungs/ des na gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig 'di ni nyams na nyes pa che zhing srung bar yang shin tu dka' bas/ rang rgyud la mi brtag par nga dam ldan yin no snyam nas nga rgyal byas pas ni ci yang mi 'ong ste/ sngags sa/zhung dag las/ sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gsum gyi khyer so dang skad cig ma gcig bral kyang / gsang sngags kyi dam tshig las 'das par bshad pa yang yod pas/ bsrung dka' zhing rgyas par dbye na sa ma ya 'bum sde'i grangs su gsungs pas tsham grangs mang la nyams pa'i nyes pa yang / rgyud las rdo rje srin po snying khrag 'thung ba dang / tshe thung nad mang nor yal dgras 'jigs dang / /mnar med dmyal ba shin tu skyi g.ya' bar/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad yun ring gnas par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ rang gi blo la mngon pa dang mi mngon pa'i nyams/ chag nyes ltung thams cad kyi gnyen ngo/ra dus/ dang rnam pa thams cad du rdor sems sgom bzlas dang yig brgya'i bshags pa byed pa 'a 'bad dgos te/ 3/ 8

sngon gyi dam pa dag gi zhal nas kyang / dang bo nas sdig gis ma gos pa dang /gal srid gos na bshags pa byed pa gzu che ba yin gsungs/ bshags na 'dag pa yang gsang sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa 'di sla ba yin te/ nyan thos kyi lugs la rtsa ldung skor cig byung na rdza be'u chag pa dang 'dra ste slar gso ba'i thabs med par gsungs/ byang sdom rin po che'i nyer spyad chag pa 'dra ste/ dper na rin po che'i nyer spyad chag na mgar ba mkhas pa la brten nas bcos su yod pa ltar/gzhan rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten nas gso rung bar gsungs/ gsang sngags kyi sdom pa ni rin po che'i nyer spyad cung zad zhom pa dang 'dra ste/ rang nyid kyis kyang lha sngags ting 'dzin la brten nas bshags pa byas kyang lhag ma med par dag par gsungs pa yin/ de yang 'phral dang 'phral du bshags na 'dag sla ste/ yun lon nas ni nyes pa gong du 'phel ba yin pas bshags lhag par dka' zhing / lo gsum 'das phan chad bshags pa'i yul las 'das pa bshags pa byas kyang mi 'dag par gsungs so/ /gzhan yang ngag nus dang byen rlabs kyi sgo nas gzhan gyi srung skyob byed pa dang / sad ser dang nad yams gcod pa/ nad pa dang sri'u gso ba sogs rang don dang gzhan don sbrel mar byed pa rnams kyang ngag nus dang byen rlabs yod par byed pa la/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag dgos shing / ngag gi sgrib pa dag par byed pa la snying po yi ge brgya ba las lhag pa su yang med pas/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du yig brgya'i bzlas pa la 'bad pa gal che ste/ rje bla ma'i zhal nas kya/nga / zhal kyal gyi tshul du/ gzhan la srung skyob byed pa dang / dkor za ba rnams kyis dang po rang gi ngas/ sgrib spyo nga ba 319

la yig brgya 'bum ther brgya re ma thon pa'i thabs med ces gsungs te/ rje'i zhal slob tu gyur pa la/ yig brgya 'bum phrag nyis brgya re dang brgya re thon pa du ma yod cing / tha ma rnams kyang yig brgya 'bum phrag gnyis gsum re ma song ba ni su yang med pa lta bu yin no/ /des na bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ rigs brgya rigs gcig tu 'dus pa'i rang bzhin/ gsang chen rigs gcig rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ste/ yi dam gyi lha zhi khro rab 'byams bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag kyang / rdo rje sems dpa' la ma 'dus pa med/ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med du bsgoms pas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor kyang kun 'dus nor bu'i lugs su bsgom pa zhes shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug pa yin/ sbags kyang snying po yi ge brgya ba las lhag pa med tshul sngar bshad pa ltar yin pas/ 'di las zab pa'i chos ni/gang na yang med par shes par bya'o/ /phan pa'i gdams ngag thos kyang tshig tu lus/ /cung zad nyams su blangs kyang g.yeng bas bslus/ /bdag dang bdag 'drar 'khrul gzugs sems can rnams/ /bskyed rdzogs snying po lon par byin gyis rlobs//sgrib pa sbyong ba bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi khrid do//320

bzhi pa/ maṇḍal/kun rjob rdzun par shes kyang tshogs gnyes gsog /don dam sbom med rtogs kyang mnyam sar 'jog /zung 'jug mngon du sprur kyang brtson 'grus rtsom/ /mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don bzhi pa tshogs bsags pa maṇḍal gyi khrid ni/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis ma rdzogs na/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs med/ de bzhin du tshogs gnyis yongs su ma rdzogs par/ /stong pa nyid kyi don ma nor ba de yang rgyud la skye mi nus te/mdo las/ ji srid tshogs gnyis dam pa de ni ma rdzogs par/ /de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni rtogs mi byed/ /ces gsungs/ de bzhin du gzhan yang / don dam lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni/ /tshogs bsags sgrib pa dag pa'i lag rjes dang / rtogs ldan bla ma'i byen rlabs kho na las/ /thabs gzhan bsten pa rmongs par shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ stong nyid mngon du rtogs nas kyang / da dung ji srid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob bar lam gong nas gong du bgrod dgos pas na/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis bsags pa la 'bad dgos te/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug te lo pa'i zhal nas/ /bu snang ba rten cing 'brel 'byung 'di/ /don skye ba med par ma rtos/sa nga/ra// /tshogs gnyis shing rta'i 'phang lo dang //'bral bar ma byed nā ro pa//321

zhes dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi za pa'i do ha las kyang / kun rdzob sangs rgyas mi re'i gdeng chen ldan gyur kyang / /bsod nams tshogs chen mi gcog ci nus 'bad par bya/ /zhes dang / mnyam med dwags po rin po che'i zhal nas kyang bsab/sa sbyang rang sar dag kyang tshogs chung ngu nas bsags zhes gsungs/ des na tshogs bsags pa'i thabs la bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig rgyal ba thabs/ mkhas la thugs rje che bas gsungs pa yin kyang / de'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ni maṇḍal 'bul ba 'di yin zhing / rgyud las/sangs rgyas zhing khams thams cad la/ /stong gsum zhing khams ma lus pa/ /'dod pa'i yon tan brgyan pa yi/ /mchod na sangs rgyas ye shes rdzogs/ /zhes pa ltar/ de la maṇḍal 'bul ba'i dus su/ rang 'u/sa/sa kyi phyag len la sgrub pa'i maṇḍal dang mchod pa'i maṇḍal sa/nyis yod/ de la maṇḍa 'a/ gyi rgyu ni/ rang gi 'byor pa dang bstun nas rab gser dngul la sogs rin po che'i maṇḍal/ 'bring 'khar ba la sogs rgyu dag pa/ tha na rdo leb dang shing leb la sogs pa'i stegs 'jam pos kyang rung / de la 'god rgyu'i tshom bu ni/rab g.yu/ byu ru/ mu men/ mu tig la sogs pa rin po che/ 'bring yi ru ra/ sgyur ru ra la sogs pa'i sman gyi 'bras bu/ tha ma nas/ 'bras/ gro sran ma la sogs 'bru'i rigs byed/ yang tha yang rdo dang gseg ma/ bye ma la sogs pas kyang dmigs pa'i rten tsam rung / gang ltar yang maṇḍal gyi gzhi de bye dor legs par byas la/dang po sgrub pa'i maṇḍal tshom bu lnga dgod/ de'i dbus kyi tshom bu de sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad la budha rigs kyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ mdun gyi tshom bu de sangs rgyas rdo rje mi bskyod pa la/ rdo rje rigs kyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ lho'i 322

tshom bu de sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan la rin chen rigs kyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ nub kyi tshom bu de sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la padma rigs kyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ byang gi tshom bu de sangs rgyas don yod grub pa 'a/ 'a1sa kyi rigs kyi lha tshogs kyis bskor bar bsam/ yang na dbus kyi tshom bu de rtsa ba'i bla ma dang o rgyan chen po dbyer med pa la rdzogs chen brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad mthor brtsegs su bzhugs pa/ mdun gyi tshom bu de sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyis bskor ba/ g.yas kyi tshom bu de nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la byang sems 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyis bskor ba/ g.yon gyi tshom bu de nyan thos mchog gnyis la nyan rang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyis bskor ba/ rgyab kyi tshom bu de 'od kyi drwa mig gi klong na chos dkon mchog glegs bam brtsegs pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa ste/ skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing ltar gsal gdab/ gang ltar yang sgrub pa'i maṇḍal de la mchod stegs la sogs par dgongs/ 'byor na mchod pa sna lnga sogs kyis bskor/ sku gsung thugs rten gyi mdun nas 'bul ba'am/ ma 'byor na sgrub pa'i maṇḍal med kyang rung / tshogs zhing yid kyis gsal gdab/ de nas mchod pa'i maṇḍal de lag pa g.yon gyis bzung / g.yas kyi mkhrig mas yun ring phyi bzhin du yid dmigs pa las ma yengs pa'i sgo nas yan lag bdun pa sogs bya/ de yang maṇḍal la ma dag pa zhig phyi rgyu yod pa kho na'i don gyis bye dor byed pa min/ rang rgyud sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma 'dag pa'i ched du/ dka' tshegs kyi sgo nas maṇḍal la byi dor byed pa yin pas na/ sngon gyi bka' gdams pa chen po dag shi phyag gi mkhrig ma'i 323

mdun ngos kyis maṇḍal phyis pas brdol nas rmar song ba'i tshe/ zur ngos kyis phyis shing / de yang brdol ba'i tshe rgyab ngos kyis phyis pa sogs kyi lo rgyus yod pa yin/ des na byi dor byed pa yang snam tshe ras sogs gzhan gyis mi phyi bar/ lag pa'i mkhrig ma kho nas phyi ba sogs sngon gyi bka' gdams pa chen po dag gi phyag srol yin pas de ltar bya/ de nas tshom bu 'god pa'i tshe/ maṇḍal so bdun ma 'di sa skya'i 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa ste/ 'jug pa bde bas gsar rnying ris med la khyab che bas/ skabs 'dir yang dang po de ltar dbul ba'i phyag srol yod pas de ltar bya/ gzhan du gsar rnying gang la yang rang rang so so'i lugs kyi maṇḍal 'bul thabs du ma yod cing / khyad par rnying ma'i gter kha re re la yang maṇḍal re dang / rang lugs 'dir yang / sku gsum gyi maṇḍal rgyas par 'bul ba'i cho ga kun mkhyen chen po'i zhal gsung ma snying thig rnams na du ma yod pa ltar yin pas gang ltar dbul yang chog so bdun ma ltar 'bul ba'i tshe/dang po/oṃ badzra byu mi sogs kyi tshe/maṇḍal lag g.yon gyis bzung bzhin pa la/g.yas pas 'byung dang dri bzang gi chus chag chag gdab/ de nas g.yas pa'i mjeb srin gyis me tog gi tshom bu zhig bzung ste/ oṃ badzra re khe sogs kyi sngags tshig dang sbrags nas/ maṇḍal gyi gzhi la g.yas su bskor zhing mthar dbus su bzhag bzos pa'i lcags ri 'god rgyu yod na skabs 'dir dgod/ de nas ri yi rgyal po ri rab zhes brjod pa'i tshe/dbus su maṇḍal tshom bu che ba gcig dbo/da/de nas shar lus 'phags pa la sogs pa'i gling ba'i/ dgod pa'i tshe/ shar rang phyogs sam yang na 'bul yul gyi phyogs gnyis gang byas kyang 'dra/ gang ltar 324

yang shar nas rim pas g.yas bskor gyis 'god/ lus dang lus 'phags sogs gling g.yog 'god pa'i tshe/ gling rang rang gi nub dang shar du gling g.yog gnyis re rim pa ltar dgod/ de nas rin po che'i ri bo shar/ dpag bsam gyi shing lho/'dod 'jo'i ba nub/ma rbos pa'i lo tog byang du dgod/de nas rgyal srid bdun gter chen po'i bum pa dang brgyad rim pas phyogs bzhi dang mtshams bzhir dgod/ de nas sgeg mo sogs pa'i phyi sgeg bzhi phyogs bzhi dang / me tog ma la sogs pa'i nang sgeg bzhi mtshams bzhir dgod/ de nas nyi ma shar/ zla ba nub/rin po che'i gdugs lho/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal pa'i rgyal mtshan byang du bkod la/de nas lha dang mi yi longs spyod ma tshang ba med pa zhes pa'i tshe/de dag gi steng du go mtshams med par spungs nas tog la sogs pa yod na bzhag 'di nyid rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang zub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod do//'di skabs su kha cig gis ma tshang ba med pa/tshang zhing yid du 'ong ba 'di nyid zer ba yod kyang de ni gzhung na med pas lhag pa yin zhes rje bla mas gsungs/ 'di dag gi dmigs rim rnams rje bla mas zhal khrid mdzad dus 'di tsam las gsung srol med pas 'dir yang ma bris la/ 'on lhong khrid yig rtsa bar dgongs 'dus rnam bshad la zhal 'phangs mdzad pa ltar rgyas par shes 'dod pa dag gis der blta bar bya'o//de nas sku gsum gyi maṇḍal rang gzhung ltar 'bul ba la/ dang po thun mong sprul spu'i maṇḍal/ sngar tshom bu bkod pa'i skabs bshad pa de lta bu'i gling bzhi ri rab tshangs ris kyi lha gnas 325

dang bcas pa de gcig la brtsis nas/ de 'dra ba stong song pa'i tshe/ stong dang po spyi phud kyi 'jig rten zhes bya/ stong dang po spyi phud kyi 'jig rten na gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten stong yod pa de gcig la brtsis nas/ de 'dra ba'i spyi phud kyi 'jig rten stong song ba'i tshe/ stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten zhes bya/ stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten de gcig la brtsis nas/ de 'dra ba stong song ba'i tshe/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya/ de na gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya yod pa ni sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku gcig gi gdul zhing yin te/ dper na sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i zhing khams mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams zhes pa lta bu yin/ de lta bu'i zhing khams grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag na lha dang mi yi yo byad dam pa rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun la so/gas bdag pos yongs su bzung ba dang ma bzung ba ji snyed yod pa de dab/ thams cad blos blangs nas/ de'i steng du rang gi lus longs spyod/ tshe bsod nams/kha rje dbang thang / dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bde skyed bde ba'i dngos po dang bcas pa/ gces dgu phongs dgu thams cad ma lus lus pa med pa spungs te chags pa dang zhen pa til 'bru tsam yang med par bla ma sprul sku'i lha tshogs la 'bul ba ni/ /thun mong sprul sku'i maṇḍal/ de'i steng du bkod pa chen po nga 'i zhing khams na zhing dang gzhal med khang gi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / sgeg so gas 'dod yon gyi lha mo grangs med pas brgyan pa blos dpag/ tu med pa dag sprul nas/ bla ma longs sku'i lha tshogs la 'bul ba ni/ thun min longs sku'i maṇḍal/ chos dbyengs skye ba med pa maṇḍal gyi 326

gzhi'i tshul du bzhag nas// snang ba'i/ la sogs rtog tshogs sang shar thams/ cad tshom bu'i tshul du bkod de/ bla ma chos sku'i lha tshogs la 'bul ba ni/ khyad par chos sku'i maṇḍal yin pas/de lta bu'i dmigs gnad khong du chud pa'i ngang nas/mos gus kyi gdung ba dang bcas// oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sto nga gsu/ma 'jis rten bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing / /sogs brjod/ grangs gsog pa'i tshe lag g.yo/na gyis/ maṇḍal dang po phul ba ltar bzung nas/ sa/yas kyis maṇḍal tshar re ba'i/na tshom pu re dbul zhing gsag de ltar byas pas lag pa g.yon pa shin tu na ste maṇḍal po/tan nas bzung mi nus pa lta bur ma gyur gyi bar du snying rus bskyed de/ maṇḍal lag pas bteg nas bzung / de yang chos la dka' spyad dang snying rus byed zer ba de za ma za rgyu med pa tsam kho na 'a/ mi zer te/ dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du bsgrub par dka' ba thams cad la snyi nga rus byas nas nyams su len pa de yin pas na/ 'di tsam gyis kyang bzod pa dang brtson 'grus la brten nas/ tshogs rdzogs/ stobs che ba yin pas nyams su blang / cis kyang bzung mi nus par mdun stegs la sogs pa'i steng du bzhag ste/ tshom bu dbul bzhin grangs gsog ja skabs la sogs par mtshams thams cad du snga ra dbul ba'i bkod pa de bsdus nas/ tshom bu so bdun ma sngar ltar dbul zhing grangs gsog pa sogs bya/ de lta bu'i sgo nas maṇḍal tshom bu 'bul phrag gcig 'gro nges bya dgos la/ skabs 'gar sku gsum gyi maṇḍal rgyas par 'bul mi nus pa dag gis/ sa gzhi da chus byugs shing sogs/ maṇḍal so bdun ma kho na phul kyang chos gang ltar yang dang po sbyor ba sems bskyed kyi rtsis zin pa dang /bar du dngos ga/zhi dmigs pa med pa dang / 327

tha mar mjug bsngo ba'i rgyas yongs su thebs pa ste/ dam pa gsum gyi rtsis zin pa gal che ba ni thams cad la 'dra'o/ /de ltar maṇḍal 'bul ba 'di'i skabs su nas dang gro la sogs pa 'bru'i maṇḍal 'bul ba'i tshe/ rang la 'byor ba yod na maṇḍal gyi mchod 'bru rnying pa yang zlos gtan nas mi bya zhing/gsar pa kho nas dbul/de ltar phul ba de yang bya byi'u dang long sprang la sogs par sbyin par gtong pa'am/ rten la sogs pa'i drung du spungs te 'jog pa sogs gang rung bya zhing /rang gis bdag tu bzung nas longs spyod pa sogs mi bya/ ma 'byor na ci 'byor pa'i tshod du mchod 'bru brje ba dang / dbul po sogs yin na 'bul thengs gcig gi mchod 'bru kho na yang nas yang du phul kyang rung / gang ltar yang sa rdul dang yug/ po bya bran 'a/ sogs pa lhad thams cad bsal te dngos gtsang bar bya zhing / gur gum la sogs pa dri bzang po'i chus rlan phab ste 'bul/ ci nas kyang 'byor ba med pa'i dbul po la sogs pa'i rigs dang / rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed kyi zhing khams dngos su blos sprul te 'bul nus pa'i dbang rab rnams la dgongs nas/ sa dang gseg ma la sogs pas kyang dbul rung bar gsungs pa yin gyi/ rang la yod bzhin du mchod sbyin gyi phyogs su gtong mi bra bar/ sngags dang dmigs pa la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan bden bden yin yin mo mang po bkod nas/ yin rlom byed pa ni rang mgo rang gis bskor ba yin/der ma zad rgyud dang man ngag thams cad nas/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba'i ra1chod pa'i tshogs/ /zhes dang / gtsang mar sbyar ba'i mchod yon 'di/ zhes sogs gsungs kyi/ btsog cing ba'i ga par sbyar ba sogs ma gsungs pas/ rang 328

gi kha 'phro dang 'bags ba'i ga sogs mchod rdzas su byed pa dang / nas kyi 'go ma rang gi za rgyu dang / snyigs ma mchod 'bru dang bca' rtsam sogs byed pa dang / de bzhin du sngon gyi bka' gdams pa dag gi zhal nas/ bzang po rang gis byas te thud kyi sngo sa dang / lo ma'i ser sa nas dkon mchog la phulaXbs mi 'ong gsungs pa ltar/ mar la sogs pa'i kha tshas dang / rul ba nas bca' mar dang mar me 'bul zhing / legs sa nas rang gis za ba sogs ni bsod nams zad pa'i rgyu yin pas spang dgos/ zhal zas dang gtor ma la sogs bca' ba'i tshe yang / zan gyi dka' sla rang gang za ba'i tshod tsam byed dgos kyi/ bzo sla ba la bsam nas gtor zan sla mo byed pa ni mi rung ste/ jo bo lha cig gi zhal nas/bod phyug po mi 'ong gtor zan sla mo byed kyin 'dug pa/ zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du jo bo'i zhal nas/ bod na bsod nams bsags pa la chu gcig pos kyang chog par 'dug rgya gar tshad khungs che bas/ bod kyi chu 'di 'dra ba'i legs pa med gsungs pa ltar/ rang gis brtson 'grus nus na tshogs bsags pa la chu gtsang mas yon chab phul ba yang phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab/ yon chab de yang ting bdun sogs dbul ba'i snod kyang bye dor legs par byas/ gral la bsgrigs pa'i tshe yang bar yangs drags pa dang dog drags pa sogs med pa'i 'tshams pa dang /ya yo 'khyag 'khyog med pa dang / chu nang du 'bru dang spu rdul srog chags sogs ma 'dres pa dang / ma gang ba dang ha cang gang drags sogs ma yin par mchod stegs kyi steng du chu bo ba la sogs kyang med par mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba bya/de bzhin du bzang spyod las kyang/ bkod pa khyad par 'phag/sa pa'i ma/chos/ rnams 329

kyis/ zhes/ gsungs pa ltar/ mchod pa'i rnam pa ga/nga yin kyang tha na bsham chul dang bkod tshul yan chad mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba byas nas/ rgyal ba sras bcas la gus pa'i rgyus rang gi bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs pa yin pas ci nas kyang 'bad par bya dgos so/ /yang rang la 'byor pa med pa dang mi nus pa sogs kyi bas/ma pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas 'bags ba'i ga dang dman pa sogs dbul mi rung ba yang ma yin te// rgyal ba sras bcas la gtsang sme'i 'dzin rtog med pas na/ sngon dbul mo grong nyug mas bcom ldan 'das la mar me phul ba'i lo rgyus dang / de bzhin mdze mo zhig gis slong mo byas pas 'bras khu zhig rnyed pa/ nyan thos 'od srung chen po la phul ba'i tshe/ 'bras khu'i nang du sbrang bu lhung ba bsa'/ bar brtsams pas/ mdze mo'i mdzub mo yang 'bras khu'i nang du chad kyang / 'od srung chen pos de'i bsam pa rdzog/sa pa'i phyir gso' / des nyin gcig si bsod snyoms kyi bo/ yang chod par mdzad pas mdze cho/ yang dga' ste sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul du skyes pa lta bu yin no/ /des na maṇḍal 'bul ba'i dus su yang bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas/ rang gi gang 'byor pa de dngos gtsang zhing yid du 'ong bar byas nas dbul ba ni gnad dam pa yin la/de lta bu'i maṇḍal 'bul ba la sogs tshogs gsog pa'i thabs la 'bad pa 'di ni lam gyi gnas skabs thams cad du 'dor du mi rung ba'i nyams len yin te/rgyud las kyang / tshogs ma bsags la dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir bas mar mi 'byung / /'e/sa gsungs// tshogs/༷ma bsags par dngos grub 'byung du re ba ni/ chu kha'i bye ma bcir nas snum sgrub pa dang 'dra ste/ bye ma ya brgya la btsir kyang de'i 330

khong na snum gyi cha spu'i rtse mo tsam 'ong rgyu med/ tshogs bsags pa las dngos grub 'dod pa ni til 'bru btsir nas snum sgrub pa dang 'dra/ til ci tsam btsir yang de tsam gyi til mar 'byung la/ tha na til 'bru gcig sen mo'i steng du btsir kyang / des sen mo'i steng thams cad snum gyi le 'ong ba yin/ de bzhin du tshogs ma bsags par dngos grub 'dod pa ni chu dkrogs nas mar sgrub pa dang 'dra la//tshogs bsags nas dngos grub 'dod pa ni 'o ma dkrogs nas mar 'dod pa dang 'dra/ zhes gsungs/ des na mthar thug mchog gi dngos grub thob pa ni/tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu ma nor ba de yin pas/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs ma rdzogs par dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sangs rgyas thob thabs med pa sngar yang bstan la/mgon po klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun//bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs nas/ /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba/ /dam pa sku gnyis thob par shog /ces gsungs/dmig/sa bcas bso/da nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pas gzugs sku dam pa dang / dmigs med ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs pas chos sku dam pa thob pa yin no/ /de bzhin du gnas skabs 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub thams cad kyang tshogs rdzogs pa las 'byung gi/ rang gis tshogs ma bsags par 'bad rtsol ci tsam che yang phan pa med de/ dper na 'phral gyi longs spyod zas nor tsam la'ang sngon gyi bsags rgyab kyis 'byor kha cig ni 'bad rtsol cung zad ma byas kyang rang bzhin gyis longs spyod kyis mi gtong ba dang / yang kha cig ni tshe gcig tu tshong dang so nar/ 'a sobs thabs sna tshos/sa pa'i sgo nas gsog brun gyi 'bad rtsol brtson kyang phan pa til 'bru tsam yang med par mthar mu

ges 'chi ba la sogs pa mthong chos su gyur pas kyang shes la/ de bzhin du nor lha dang chos skyong sogs bsgrubs nas dngos grub 'dod pa rang la sngon bsags kyi sbyin 'bras med na de dag gis sbyin mi nus te/ sngon ri khrod pa zhig 'tsho bas dbul nas dam can bsgrubs pas dngos su grub nas mi dang mi lab pa bzhin byung yang dngos grub ci yang ma byung ba la dam can na re/ khyod la sngon gyi sbyin 'bras cung zad kyang med pas/kho bos dngos grub sbyin mi nus par 'dug zer/nyin gcig sprang po mang po zhig gi gral du thug pa phor gang rnyed de slar 'ong bas dam can na re/de ring ngas khyod la dngos grub byin pa e shes zer/ thug pa phor gang rnyed de de ni nga min kyang sprang po thams cad 'dug khyod kyi dngos grub 'am de ni ma shes byas pas/ thug pa blud pa'i tshe khyed rang gi phor pa'i nang du tshil rdog chen po zhig lhung ba de nga'i dngos grub yin pa la zer skad/ de bas na rang la sngon bsags med na nor sgrub la sogs pas kyang dbul ba bsal mi nus te/'jig rten pa'i nor lha la sogs pas longs spyod kyi dngos grub ster nus na/rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad de dag rnams las mthu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul brgya stong 'gyur gyis che zhing / ma bcol par yang sems can thams cad la phan par mdzad pa sha stag yin pas/ de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir longs spyod kyi char phab ste thams cad kyi dbul ba cig char du bsal bar nges pas de ltar ma mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na longs spyod dang 'byor ba la sogs pa rnams kyang bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu kho na las 'byung ba yin pas na/ 'bad rtsol ri bo tsam byed pa las/ bsod nams me stag tsam gsog par 332

dga' ba yin no/ /lar da lta'i dus na rang re mtha' 'khob kyi yul la ltos pa'i longs spyod dang dbang thang phra mo tsam re skyes pa la/ thams cad kyis bla ma mkhyen de ji lta bu zhig yin nam zer nas ha las 'dogs byed kyang / de tsam re la bsod nams chen po rang bsags dgos par mi 'dug ste/ zhing dang bsam pa dag na mi dbang nga las nus sran nog bdun gyi sbyin 'bras kyis/ sum cu rtsa gsum man chad dbang byas pa'i lo rgyus dang / rgyal po gsal rgyal lta bu'i mnga' thang yang zan dron lan tshwa med pa zhig gi sbyin 'bras su gsungs pa dang / sngon jo bo rje lha cig bod la phebs pa'i dus bod yul kun da lta las ches 'byor zhing rgyas pa'i dus yin kyang / jo bo'i zhal nas/ bod pre ta pu ri'i rgyal khams dngos su 'dug bod yul na zhing dag pa zhig la nas gre gang sbyin par btang pa'i sbyin 'bras la longs spyod mkhan mi 'dug ces gsungs/ des na 'phral gyi zang zing dang dbang thang cung zad re ngo mtshar rmad du 'dzin pa ni/ gcig tu rang nyid blo chung ba dang / gnyis su 'jig rten 'dir snang gi zhen pa che ba dang /gsum du las 'bras kyi 'phel tshul sngar yo sho ka'i 'bras bu bstan pa sogs kyi gnad ci bzhin ma go ba'am/ go yang yid ma ches pa'i rtags bstan pa yin pas/ snying nas nges 'byung gi blo bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skyes pa zhig yin na/ 'jig rten 'dir snang gi phun tshogs phyug po klu lta bu/ mthon po gnam lta bu/ btsan po thog lta bu/ phyor po 'ja' tshon lta bu ji 'dra ba mthong kyang / de la rtag pa dang brtan pa snying po til gyi shun pa tsam yang med par shes nas/mkhris nad can la btso zan byin pa ltar zhe log ge ba zhig dgos pa yin/ der ma zad tshe 'dir 333

longs spyod la sogs pa la ched du re nas tshogs bsags la 'bad pa sogs kyang 'jig rten pa phal pa la rung gi nges 'byung gi chos yang dag pa'i ni phyogs dang nye ba ma yin te/thar pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i chos yang dag pa zhig 'dod na/sngar yang nas yang du smos pa ltar 'jig rten tshe 'di'i zhen pa thams cad mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du bor nas pha yul rgyab tu bskyur/ mi yul dang du blangs/ gnas dben pa kho na bsten te na dga' dang shi skyid kyi ngang nas sgrub pa zhig dgos te/ mnyam med dwags po rin po che la slob ma zhig gis/ da lta snyigs ma'i dus 'dir chos yang dag pa zhig sgrub pa la zas gos dang yo byad dka' bar 'dug pas/nor sgrub dum pa re bya 'am/ bcud len bzang po re slob bam/yang na nges par 'chir 'jug nus pa zhig dgos pa yin nam/ gang lags zhus pas/ nor sgrub byas kyang rang la sngon gyi sbyin 'bras med na 'ong ba yang dka' jing /snying nas chos bzhin byed pa la tshe 'dir ched du nor sgrub pa yang 'gal/bcud len byas kyang sngon bskal pa yar dar la sa rdo chu shing la sogs pa'i bcud ma shor ba'i dus lta bu deng sang mi 'ong bas/ da lta'i dus na phan med/nges par 'chir bcug pa yang mi 'ong ste/ dal 'byor tshang ba'i lus rten da res kyi 'di 'dra ba phyin chad rnyed par dka'/ 'on kyang nges par shi ma shi med par nyams su len nus pa'i blo zhig snying thag pa nas skyes na/ lto gos kyis phongs pa mi 'ong ste/ chos pa mu ges shi ba'i dpe med/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang phye bre re la mu tig bre re 'jal ba'i mu ge/ byung yang sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug/ zas gos kyis mi phongs par gsungs/ zhes gsungs/ des na rgyal ba'i sras po byang chub 334

sems/ dpa' rnams ni tshogs bsas/sa pa dang sgrib spyo nga byed kyang / nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du byed pa nyag cig yin pas/rang gi tshe 'di'i ched du sgrub pa yang lta ci smos/ rang don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par 'dod kyang jeg pa chen po'i lam gtan nas ma yi na pas na/ tshogs bsags dang sgrib sbyong gang dang gang byed kyang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du dmigs pa las/ rang 'dod kyi blo dang gtan nas ma 'dres pa zhig cis kyang gal che'o/ /de ltar byas na rang don dang tshe 'di'i bde skyid sogs mi 'dod kyang zhor la 'byung ste/ me 'bud pa'i tshe dud pa zhor la 'byung ba dang / nas btab pas sog ma zhor 'byung ba lta bu yin pas na/de dag la ched du gnyer ba'i blo ni/ dug bzhin du spang bar bya dgos so// lnga pa/ ku sā la'i tshogs bsags/lnga pa bdud bzhi gcig char gcod pa ku sā la'i tshogs gsog ni/ de la 'dir ku sā li'i tshogs gsog zhes lus sbyin nyung ngu zhig 'byung ba 'di/ spyir sems nyid ngal gso nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel par 'byung bas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi cha lag tu byas kyang chog mod kyi/ tshogs bsags pa maṇḍal gyi yan lag tu byas kyang mi 'gal bas na/ skabs 'dir sbrel te gsungs pa bka' srol la yod pa bzhin 'dir yang 'chad do/ /de la ku sā/ li 'e/sa pa ni/ sprang po'i don yin pas tshe blos btang gi rnal 'byor ri khrod pa lta bu tshogs gsog pa'i 335

longs spyod gzhan mi rnyed pa rnams kyis dmigs pa la brten nas rang gi lus kyi mchod sbyin byed pa yin/ de yang dngos po gzhan thams cad kyang rang gi lus 'di gso ba'i ched 'bad rtsol dang rtsol sgrub gsog 'jog dang gces spras sogs byed pa yin la/ longs spyod gzhan thams cad las kyang rang gi lus 'di nyid gces 'dzin che bar nges pas na/ lus la gces 'dzin bcad de mchod sbyin bya ba ni/ dngos po gzhan gyi mchod sbyin bya ba las lhag par yang phan yon che ba yin te/ ji skad du/rta dang glang po brgya 'gyur yin/ /bu dang chung ma stong 'gyur yin/ /lus kyi mchod sbyin 'bum 'gyur yin/ /zhes dang / ma cig gi zhal nas/ chags med lus sbyin byed pa de/ /tshogs gnyis yin par ma shes nas/ /phung po gces 'dzin byas pa de//ma sprul pa'i sku la mthol lo bshags//zhes gsungs/de yang dang po rang nyid dmigs pa la goms po yod na rnam shes nam mkhar spar te/ skad cig gis khros mar bskyed kyang 'dra/ de ltar min na rang gi snying dbus su sems rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo ma gcig khros ma nag mo gar thabs ling nge yod pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal nag pos ngur sgra sgrogs pa khro mo'i cha byad can de lta bu zhig bskyed la/ phaṭaḥces brjod pa'i tshe rtsa dbu ma'i lam brgyud spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas rgyangs kyis thon pa'i mod la rang gi lus de nyid ro ru gyur nas ling gis 'gyel/ de yang da lta'i lus 'di lta bu ma yin par che ba tsho ba snum pa stong ga/sum gyi rgya khyod dang mnyam pa gcig tu bsgom/ de nas rang nyid ma cig khros ma nag mor gsal ba'i phyag g.yas kyi gri gu des rang gi 336

lus bem po de'i smin mtshams su tshad tsam byas pas thod pa sgar gyis bkogathod pa de yang da lta'i 'di lta bu ma yin pa stong gsum gyi rgya khyon dang mnyam pa gcig tu bsgom/ de nas khros ma'i phyag g.yon pas thod pa de blangs nas mi mgo'i sgyed pu ri rab dang mnyam pa gsum gyi steng du dpral ba rang la bstan te bkod/ yang khros ma'i phyag g.yas kyi gri gug des bam ro de nyid ling gis blangs te thod pa'i nang du bzhag de nas thod pa'i steng gi nam mkhar bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin rta yig dkar po zhig dang / thod pa'i 'og tu me'i rang bzhin yi ge sa thung dam ra po zhig bsgom/ de nas/oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod pa'i tshe sa thung las me 'bar thod pa dros nang gi bam ro de bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du so ro ro zhu nas khol te thod ba'i kha gang nas 'bags btsog dang dri ma ma dag pa'i cha thams cad lbu ba dang spris ma'i rnam par phyir lud de/ rlangs pa sgru yig la phog pas khyi yig kyang dros te bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs pa yang gnyis med du 'dres shing mthar ho yig kyang 'od du ltem gyis zhu nas thon pa'i bdud rtsi dang gnyis med du thim par bsams la/phaṭaḥ lus gces 'dzin sogs brjod/ rang gis oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod pa'i tshe/ oṃ gyis kha dog dri ro la sogs pa'i skyon thams cad sbyangs/ āḥyis mang por spel/ hūṃ gis gang la gang 'dod kyi dngos por bsgyur te/ zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dod rgu yid bzhin gyi sprin 'phro ba'i rol pa dang rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ de nas rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri rkang dar zab 'bol brtsegs dang bcas pa'i steng du/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sku dngos su bzhugs pa de'i steng gi cha la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/bar gyi 337

cha la yi dam gyi lha tshogs/ thod pa'i kha'i thad kyi nam mkha' la dpal mgon bdun chu rtsa lnga la sogs ye shes dang las las grub pa'i chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang yul lha gzhi bdag la sogs pa 'khod/ de'i 'og gi sa gzhi'i steng du bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ byes pa'i gdon chen bco lnga la sogs bgegs rigs lan chags kyi mgron gtso bor gyur pa'i/ khams gsum rigs drug gi sems can thams cad nyi zer la rdul 'khrigs pa ltar bskyed/ de nas steng gi rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyi ljags rdo rje'i spu gu can gyis bdud rtsi'i bcud drangs te gsol/ rang gi tshogs rdzogs/ sgrib pa dag dam tshig nyams chag byang / mchog dang thun mong gi dngos/ grub thob par bsam/ bar na yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug gi lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rang rang gi phyag ma/tshan/ rdo rje//'khor lo/rin chen/padma/ rgya gram la sogs pa'i rnam pa can gyi spu gus bdud rtsi'i bcud drangs te gsol/ rang gi tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag dam tshig nyams chag byang /mchos/ thun mong gi dngos grub thob par bsam/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos/ skyong srung ma dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang bcas pa la sogs pa rnams kyi ljags nyi zer gyi spu gu can gyis bdud rtsi'i bcud drangs te gsol/ rang gi tshogs rdzogs/ sgrib pa dag dam chos byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad gsal/mthun rkyen smon pa'i legs tshogs thams cad spel bar bsam/ de yar mgron la dkar 'byed yin/ de nas rang nyid dmigs pa la bo/mas po yod na rang nyid ma cig khros ma nag mor gsal ba'i thugs ka nas las byed kyi mkha' 'gro ma 338

dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga brgya stong grangs med pa nyi zer la rdul 'khrigs pa lta bu zhig spros nas/ de dag gis khams gsum 'gro ba rigs drug gi sem/sa can thams cad la snod ye shes kyi ka pā la bcud zag med kyi bdud rtsis gang ba re re byin pas ngoms shing tshims par bsam/ yang rang nyid dmigs pa la goms po med na/ rang nyid khros mar gsal ba'i phyag g.yon pa'i thod pa de nyid kyis thod pa'i bdud rtsi bcus shing gtor bas khams gsum rigs drug gi gnas su bdud rtsi'i char babs pa la thams cad kyis 'thung bas ngoms shing tshims par bsam/ de ni mar mgron la dkar 'gyed yin/ yang bdud rtsi khol ba'i rlangs pa las yar mchod yul la mchod yon/zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'phan gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ bla re/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong / dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil pa la sogs pa mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros nas mchod/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag par bsam/ de yar mgron la khra 'gyed yin/ yang mar mgron rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la rang rang gang la gang 'dod ci la ci 'dod kyi yo byad thams cad char bzhin du babs pas thams cad dga' mgu tshims shing yi rang / khyad par rang gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bzung ste tha ma da la thug gi bar du/bsad pa tshe thung ba'i lan chags/ 'phrog pa nor dbul ba'i lan chags/ brdung ba nad mang ba'i lan chags/ bro/nga mas bskyabs ba'i lan chags/ 'og mas bkur ba'i lan chags/ bar ma mdza' ba'i lan chags/ mtho ba mkhar gyi lan 339

chags/dma' ba sa zhing gi lan chags/gnyen grogs srid sde'i lan chags/bu tsha phyugs kyi lan chags/bza' ba zas kyi lan chags/bgo ba gos kyi lan chags/bu lon 'brel gyi lan chags/ zho bzhos pa'i lan chags/ khal bkal ba'i lan chags/ rmo rmos pa'i lan chags/ bed du spyad pa'i lan chags la sogs tshe lan srog lan/ sha lan/ rus lan chags pa'i lan chags bu lon sha 'khon gyi bdag po bdag mo thams cad snod bzung ste bu lon bsnyag pa ltar du 'dus pa la/ de dag thams cad rang rang gang la gang 'dod/ ci la ci 'dod/ zas 'dod pa la zas/gos 'dod pa la gos/ longs spyod 'dod pa la longs spyod/skyed tshal 'dod pa la skyed tshal/ bzhon pa 'dod pa la bzhon pa/ gnas khang 'dod pa la gnas khang / gnyen grogs 'dod pa la gnyen grogs la sogs 'dod rga'i longs spyod zad pa med pa'i gter du gyur nas char ltar babs pa la/ rang rang gis longs spyad nas lan chags 'khor/ bu lon sod/ sha 'khon byang / sdig sgrib dag/ thams cad kyang ngoms shing tshims te dga' bar bsam/ yang de dag gi lhag ma khas zhan pa/ dbang chung ba/ zha bo/ long ba/ 'on pa/ lkugs pa la sogs rigs drug gi sems can sdug bsngal gyis gdung ba nyams thag pa thams cad la rang rang gang la gang 'dod kyi dngos po/ skyabs med pa la skyabs/ mgon med pa la mgon/dpung gnyen med pa la dpung gnyen/ gnyen grogs med pa la gnyen grogs/srid sde med pa la srid sde/ nad pa la gso ba'i sman/'chi ba slong ba'i bdud rtsi/zha bo la rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa/ long ba la ye shes kyi spyan/ 'on pa la zag med kyi rna ba/ lkugs pa la shes rab kyi lce la sogs par gyur te longs spyod pas thams 340

cad ngoms shing tshims/ rigs drug so so'i las snang sdug bsngal bag chags thams cad dang bral te/ pho thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang / mo thams cad rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i go 'phang thob ste/ khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par bsam/de ni mar mgron la khra 'gyen yin/de ltar dmigs pa ma zin bar du oṃ āḥhūṃ kho na brjod/ de nas/ phaṭaḥ yar mchod yul mgron gyi sogs/ gshis rdzogs pa chen po ma bcos maḥ zhes brjod cing / mchod bya mchod byed mchod yul dang bcas pa thams cad mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag spyir gcod gzhung rnams las/ dkar 'gyed dmar 'gyed khra 'gyed nag 'gyed de 'gyed chen bzhi bshad kyang / 'dir dkar 'gyed dang khra 'gyed gnyis las dmar 'gyed dang nag 'gyed med pa yin/ lar da lta'i dus na gcod byed par rlom pa rnams nas/ gcod zer rgyu de lha 'dre ma rungs pa dag bsad bcad gtub brdungs bskrad nas rlab par byed pa'i drag shul gyi las shig yin par bzung / des na gcod pa zer ba de yang dus dang rnam pa thams cad du yang khros 'khrugs rngam ste zhe sdang dang nga rgyal kho nas dpa' bskyed de yod pa/ gshin rje'i las mkhan lta bu zhig yod dgos snyam zhing nad pa sogs la gtso byed pa'i tshe yang / khros 'khrugs rngams pa'i drag shul gyi dpa' bskyed de sdang mig phor pa tsam re bsgrad/ khu tshur dang kha pho mnyam rdeg byed cing / rdung rdeg sbar mo btab nas nad pa'i rgyab la gyon pa'i gos hrul yan chad gted de/ des lha 'dre 'dul bar rlom pa 'dug kyang / de 'dra ba'i chos lugs de nor ba yin te/ ma cig gi zhal nas kyang / thog ma med pa'i dus nas 341

las ngan gyi rgyu byas/ rkyen ngan gyi rlung gis ded/ 'khrul snang dang sdug bsngal kho na khor mo yug tu spyod/ shi tsam na ngan song gi gting rdo las 'gro sa med pa'i lha 'dre gdug pa can de dag ngas snying rje'i lcags kyus bzung ste/ rang gi sha dron mo dang khrag dron mo zas su byin nas/byams snying rje byang chub sems kyis snang ba bsgyur te/ rang gi 'khor du bsdu ba yin pa la/ ma 'ongs pa'i gcod mkhan chen po de dag gis nga'i snying rje'i lcags kyus bzung ba'i nor/ lha 'dre ma rungs ba de dag bsad pa dang / sgrod pa dang /rdung bar rlom pa ni gcod log bdud kyi bstan pa dar ba'i rtags yin par gsungs shing / de bzhin du nag po dgu phrug gi gcod pa la sogs pa gcod log ji snyed cig 'byung bar gsungs pa thams cad kyang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang bral nas drag shul gyis lha 'dre 'dul bar rlom pa kho nar 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu des 'byung po phra mo nus pa chung ba re re gnyis gnyis 'dul nus pa ltar 'dug rung / lha 'dre ma rung pa gdug pa can dag dang 'phrad na slar la rang gi srog la rgol ba yang yod de du ma zhig mthong chos su gyur pas mtshon la/ khyad par chos rnam dag sgrub pa'i gang zag zhig la 'dre 'dul byin rlabs la sogs skyes pa lam rtags kyi yon tan yin nam/ bdud kyi bar chad yin shes dka' ste/ lha 'dre ma rungs pa dag gis rgyud brlams pa phal mo che mngon shes dang nus pa sogs yod pa ltar snang yang /phugs su yang dag pa'i chos dang je 'gal la 'gro zhing mthar dge sems til gyi 'bru tsam yang med par 'gyur/ dkor rnam smin gyi bu lon ri bo tsam zhig gi khur gyis non kyang / rnyed pas tshe 'di tsam la yang phan mi 'dogs par mthar 342

'tsho ba'i zas gos tsam yang mi rnyed pa'am/ mi bra bar gyur nas 'chi ba de dag ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar nyi tshe ba'i dmyal gnas la sogs par skye bar nges pa yin no//des na gcod pas 'dul rgyu'i lha 'dre ni/phyi na su yang med par nang na yod de/ phyi 'khrul snang lha 'dre'i gzugs su snang ba de thams cad kyang nang nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i snyems byed rtsa ba ma chod pa las byung ba yin te/ ma cig gi zhal nas kyang / thogs bcas bdud dang thogs med bdud/ /dga' brod bdud dang snyems byed bdud/de yang snyems byed bdud la thug /ces gsungs/des na 'dre zhes bya ba bdag 'dzin snyems byed kyi bdud yin la/de yang gzhan du/ 'dre mang po bya ba 'du shes yin/ /'dre ngar ma bya ba ngar 'dzin yin/ /'dre rgod po bya ba rnam rtog yin/ /'dre de dag chod na gcod pa zer/ /zhes bya ste/ rje mi las brag srin mo la gsungs pa las kyang / 'dre khyod las thu ba ngar 'dzin yin// /'dre khyod las mang ba 'du shes yin/ /'dre khyod las langs shor rnam rtog yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs/de bzhin du gcod kyi dbye ba gsungs pa yang /gnyan sa ri khrod 'grims pa phyi yi gcod/ /phung po gzan du bsgyur ba nang gi gcod/ /nyag gcig rtsad nas gcod pa don gyi gcod/ /gcod de gsum dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa lags te/ zhes gsungs/ des na gcod byed pa thams cad kyang ma rig ba dang 'khrul snang thams cad kyi rtsa ba bdag 'dzin rtsad nas gcod pa la/ nyag gcig rtsad nas gcod pa don gyi gcod ces bya ba yin pas/ de ma bcad par phyi 'khrul snang gi 'dre bsad pas mi sod/ brdung bas mi thub/ mnan pas mi non/bskrad pas mi 'gro ste/ dper na me ma spangs par du ba sbang du mi nus pa ltar 343

nang snyems byed kyi rtsa ba ma chod par de'i rtsal las byung ba'i phyi 'khrul snang gi lha 'dre med par byed mi nus te/brag srin mos kyang / rje btsun la/'dre sems kyi rtsa bar ma shes na/ /'dre nga bas mi tshad gzhan yang yod/ /spyod song zhig byas pas nga mi 'gro/ /zhes sogs zhus pa ltar dang / rje btsun gyi zhal nas kyang / 'dre 'dre ru bzung na gnod pa yin/ /'dre sems su shes na grol ba yin/ /'dre stong par rtogs na chod pa yin/ /zhes dang / gdon gnod sbyin pho mo'i snang ba 'di/ /ma rtogs dus na bdud yin te/ /tho 'tshams bar du gcod par byed/ /rtogs na bdud kyang lha yin te/ /dngos grub thams cad khyod las 'byung / /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ nang 'drer 'dzin gyi rtog pa rtsad nas gcod pa la gcod gsungs pa yin gyi/ 'dre gsod ba min/ 'dre rdung ba min/ 'dre bskrad pa min/'dre mnan pa min/ 'dre rlag pa min/ des na gcad bya phyi na med de nang na yod pa shes par bya dgos so/ /lar chos gzhan phal che ba'i lugs ba pa phrin las kyi rno so/ drag shul gyi nus mthu/ mda' rtse mdung rtse thams cad phyir la bskor nas phyi dgra bgegs kyi steng du phrin las ston pa yin kyang /rang re'i chos lugs 'di la/rje btsun mi la'i zhal nas kyang / nga'i chos lugs 'di bdag 'dzin rtsad nas bcad de chos brgyad rlung la bskur nas bdud bzhi kha skyengs su 'jug pa'i chos lugs yin gsungs pa ltar/ nyams su blangs tshad kyi kha nang la log nas nang ngar 'dzin gyi steng du mthu rtsal nus pa thams cad yod dgu rtsal sprugs su byed pa yin/ des na srungs shig skyobs shig brgya zer ba las kyang / zo zhig khyer cib gcig thi/sa dga'/ lha srung brgya ra ma dar sbran pa las kyang / lha 'drer brgya za 344

'jug pa dga' ste/ji skad du/ nad pa 'dre la gtad pa yin/ /skyel ma dgra la bcol ba yin/ /srungs shig skyobs shig brgya las kyang / /zo zhig khyer cig gcig gis dga'/ /sa ma jo ma'i chos lugs yin/ /zhes gsu ngas/ des na nang 'drer 'dzin gyi rtsa ba bcad na snang ba dag par shar nas bdud rigs chos skyong du gnas 'gyur/chos skyong sprul skur zhal bsgyur ba zhes bya ba de 'byung ba yin pa la/de ltar ma shes par da lta gcod byed par rlom pa rnams nas lha 'dre phyi na yod par bsams te/ rtag tu 'drer 'dzin gyi snang ba dang ma bral bar bsdad pas snang ba thams cad 'dre dang rgyal 'gong du shar te/ rang nyid kyang blo sos mi dal zhing /gzhan la yang phu ya gi na 'dre/mda' ma ki na 'dre/'dre de red/ bdud de red/ btsan de red ngas rig yod/ ngas bzung yod/ ngas bsad yod/ khyod la 'jab kyin 'dug ngas bskrad yod/ phyi mig cig bltas byung / zer ba la sogs rdzun gyi mgo skor kho na gtong zhing pho byas byas mo'i dpa' skad 'don/ de tsa na lha 'dre dang yi dwags rnams kyis kyang de'i rgyus lon te/de gar song du 'gro zhing /bud med bla yangs ma la sogs pa rnams kyi rgyud la brlams te/ nga lha yin/ 'dre yin/ nga shi bo yin/ nga khyod kyi pha rgan yin/ ma rgan yin bya ba la sogs pa bden bden dang / yin yin mo du ma bshad/ kha cig tu nga lha yin/ nga chos skyong yin/ nga dam can yin la sogs pa zer zhing rdzun lung dang mngon shes du ma sgrogs par byed de/ 'dres bla ma mgo g.yogs/ bla mas yon bdag mgo g.yogs pa ni/'jig rten pa'i kha skad la/ pha mgo bus g.yogs bu mgo dgras g.yogs zer ba ltar/ snyigs ma'i rang rtags mngon du gyur nas/ rgyal khams bdud kyi dbang 345

byed pa yin te/ o rgyan chen po'i lung bstan 'a/sa/ snyigs ma'i dus na skyes pa'i snying la pho 'dre 'jug /bud med snying la mo 'dre 'jug /byis pa'i snying la je'u rang 'jug /btsun pa'i snying la dam sri 'jug /bod mi re'i snyeng la 'dre re 'jug//zhes pa ltar dang / the'u rang lha ru mthong ba'i dus bod sdug pa'i dus la babs pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i lung bstan thog tu bab pa yin no/ /des na phyi 'khrul snang lha 'dre bgegs kyi rnam pa ltar snang ba la bden bden dang yin yin gyi rgyab skyor mi bya bar/ thams cad kyang mi lam dang sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam rol du rtsal sbyang / gnas skabs su gnod bya dang gnod byed ltar snang ba'i lha 'dre dang nad pa gnyis ka yang / las ngan dang 'khrul snang gi rgyu las byung zhing gnod byed du 'brel pa yin pas na nye ring dang chags sdang mi bya bar/ gnyis ka la byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgo ma/ rang gi gces 'dzin dang bdag 'dzin rtsa ba nas bcad de lus srog phongs pa med par lha 'dre'i gzan du ster/ rgyud zhe sdang dang gdug rtsub zhi ste/ shes rgyud dam pa'i chos la 'khor ba'i chos bshad dang smon lam la sogs snying thag pa nas byed/ mthar thug gnod bya dang gnod byed/ lhar snang dang 'drer snang / bdag gzhan gnyis su 'dzin pa'i re dogs dang chags sdang / bzang ngan dang dga' sdug gi rtog pa thams cad rtsa gdar bcad de/ ji skad du/ lha med 'dre med lta ba'i gding / /yengs med 'dzin med sgo ma pa'i gnad/ /blang med dor med spyod pa'i gnad/ / re med dogs med 'bras bu'i gnad/ /zer ba ltar/ gcad bya gcod byed thams cad chos nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi klong du gdal na/ nang snyems byed gdon gyi rtsa ba chod de 346

mthar thug don gyi chod chad mngon du 'gyur ba yin no/ /bdag med go yul yod kyang bdag rtog rags/ /gnyis 'dzin spong blo byas kyang re dogs ldang / /bdag dang bdag 'dra bdag lta'i sems can rnams/ bdag med gnas lugs rtogs par byen gyis rlobs//tshog/sa bsags pa maṇḍa gyi khrid do//drug pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/dang po bla ma mchog bsten bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ /bar du dka' ba sprud de nyams su blangs/ /tha ma dgongs pa dbyer med brgyud srol zin/ /mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la phrag 'tshal lo/ /drug pa rtogs pa'i ye shes rang rgyud la skyed pa'i thabs thams cad kyi mthar thug pa/ byin rlabs kyi 'jug sgo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yin/ de yang spyir chos yang dag pa zhig nyams su len na/ dang por mchan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang dag pa zhig btsal te/ des ci gsung sgrub pa dang sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes kyis snying thag pa nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni gal che ste/ mdo las kyang / don dam pa ni dad pas rtogs par bya ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du jo bo rje lha cig gi zhal nas kyang /grogs dag byang chub ma thob bar du bla ma dkos pas bshes ba nyen dam pa bsten/gnas lugs ma rtogs bar thos pa dgos pas bla ma'i gdams ngag nyon/ /bde 347

ba thams cad bla ma'i byen rlabs lags pas drin du gzo bar mdzod//ces dang /dge bshes kha rag sgom chung gi zhal nas/ bla ma 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad kyi byed pa por ngo shes dgos zhes dang / sde snod gsum shes kyang bla ma la mos gus med na phan med/ces gsungs/ khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje jeg pa'i lam thams cad ni/bla ma kho na gal che ba yin pas/bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom pa yang rgyud sde thams cad nas gsungs shing / de nyid bskyed rdzogs sgom pa thams cad las kyang lhag par gsungs te/ rgyud las/ gang gis bskal pa bye ba ru/ /lha sku 'bum phrag bsgoms pa las/ /bla ma skad cig dran pa mchog /ces gsungs/ yang dgos rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po snying thig rdo rje snying po'i jeg pa 'di las ni/ theg pa 'og ma ltar rtog dpyod dang gtan tshigs la sogs pa'i sgo nas zab mo'i don gtan la 'bebs pa yang ma ga/sungs/ rgyud sde 'og ma ltar thun mong gi dngos grub la brten nas mthar thug mchog la sbyor bar yang ma gsungs rgyud sde gong ma gsum lta ra dbang gsum pa'i dpe ye shes la brten nas don gyi ye shes ngo sprod pa yang rtsal tu bton nas ma gsungs te/brgyud pa gser gyi nyag thag la dam sel gyi g.ya' yis ma gos pa'i rtogs pa mchog ldan gyi bla ma kho na la/ sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag yid khyed shes kyi mos gus drag pos gsol ba 'debs pa la brten nas thugs yid dbyer med du 'dres te/ byin rlabs 'pho ba'i stobs kyis rtogs pa rgyud la skye bar bzhed pa yin te sngar drangs pa ltar/ don dam lha na cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni/ /tshogs bsags sgrib pa dag pa'i lag rjes dang / /rtogs ldan bla ma'i byen rlabs 348

kho na las/ /thabs gzhan bsten ba rbongs par shes par bya/ /zhes dang / sa ra has kyang / bla mas smras pa gang gi snying zhugs pa/ lag pa'i mthil na gnas pa'i gter mthong 'dra/ /zhes gsungs/de bzhin du kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos sgyu ma ngal gso las kyang / bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim sgom pa la sogs pa rnams ni rang rang gi lam gyi ngo bo des mi grol te/ de yang spyod pa dang bogs 'don sogs la brten pa yin/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni rang gi lam gyi ngo bo 'di kho nas gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa rgyud la skyes te grol ba yin pas na/ lam thams cad las bla ma'i rnal 'byor zab pa yin/ zhes gsungs/ de skad du/dam tshig bkod pa'i rgyud las kyang / mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa'i lha/ /bskal pa 'bum du bsgom pa bas/ /bla ma skad cig dran pa mchog /bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa sa ya bas/ /bla ma'i gsol 'debs lan gcig mchog /ces dang / sa ti bkod pa las/ drin dang ldan pa'i bla ma de/ /spyi bo'i gtsug gam snyeng gi dkyil/ /yan lag mthil du gang bsgoms pa/ /sangs rgyas stong gi dngos grub kyang / /gang zag de yis 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes dang /rje rgod tshang pa'i zhal nas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa na/ /skyon zad yon tan rdzogs par 'gyur//zhes dang / bskyed rim bsgoms pa mang lags kyang / /bla ma sgom pa'i gong na med/ /rdzogs rim bsgoms pa mang lags kyang //blo khel ling bsgyur gong na med/ /ces gsungs/de bzhin du 'bri gung skyob pa rin po ches kyang / bla ma sku bzhi'i gangs ri la/ /mos gus kyi nyi ma ma shar na/ /byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun mi 'bebs pas/ /sems mos gus 'di la nan tan mdzod//ces dang /rje btsun rang rig ras pa'i zhal nas kyang /rje la gsol 349

ba mi 'debs pa'i/ /mi rtog ye shes 'dod pa de/ /byang bstan phug par nyi sgrag 'dra/ /snang sems 'dres dus de la med/ /ces gsungs/ des na gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba ni/ mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor kho na la brten nas rgyud la skye ba ma gtogs thabs gzhan gang gis kyang rtogs mi nus pas na/ rje tsā ro pa yang / theg pa gsum la mkhas pa'i parnyi tar gyur/ mu stegs kyi rgol ba thams cad tshar bcad de/ bikra ma shī la'i byang sgo srung ba'i brnyi ta mdzad pa'i dus su yang /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas khyod tshig la mkhas pa yin gyi/don la mkhas pa ma yin pas na/ da dung yang bla ma bsten dgos so zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ dka' ba du ma'i sgo nas te lo pa bsten pa'i tshe/ te lo pa'i zhal nas/ 'di tsam bstan yang mi go ba zhes gsungs te mchil lham gyis dpral bar bsnun pas gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa skyes te bla ma dang dgongs pa mnyam par gyur pa dang / slob dbon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis ngar snabs cig dor ba klu'i byang chub kyis tsen gyis blangs nas longs spyad pas mchog gi dngos grub thob par bshad pa dang / de bzhin du rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i zhal nas kyang / kho bos kyang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gsung rab mthong nas/ sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skyes te phur tshugs su gsol ba btab pas/ye shes kyi sku sa rjes su bzung ste rang byung gi rtogs pa rgyud la skyes/ dus de nas bzung ste zhu ba po brgya phrag thal ba la khrid btab pa yin te/ brtson 'grus can 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan las ni mi 'phar/ shes rab can rtog dpyod kyi phyogs su mi 'chor/ don dam pa'i rtogs zul mos gus kyi srang la theg pa sha 350

stag byung ngo / /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du lo chen bai ro tsa na rgyal mo tsha ba'i rong du sprugs pa'i tshe/ sprang rgan mi pham mgon po zhes bya ba rgan po lo brgyad cu 'gro ba shin tu rgas shing 'khogs pa zhig la/sgom thag lus la bcings/sgom rten sked la btsugs te byen rlabs bla ma'i lam khyer 'di bsta/na pas/ ka dag khregs chod kyi dgongs pa ma nor rgyud la skyes te lus rdul phran du dengs nas sangs rgyas pa sogs yin pas/ 'di las lhag pa'i zab lam ni theg pa rim pa dgu'i chos zhal bsdur kyang mi rnyed de ming du sngon 'gror btags kyang / don du dngos gzhi'i lam thams cad kyi gnad 'gag mthar thug pa de yin pas/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du 'di kho na la nyams len gyi mthil bcol na/ nyams len gzhan ci yang med kyang rung ba yin pas snying thag pa nas 'bad pa ci nas kyang gal che'o//de lta bu'i zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor de nyid nyams su blang ba la don gsum ste/tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa/ yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba/ phur tshugs su gsol ba gdab pa las/ dang po tshogs zhing gsal 'debs pa ni/ zhing khams sbyong ba sems stobs chen po'i spyod yul yin pas snang bas gar khyab thams cad padma 'od kyi pho brang bkod pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i dbus su/ rang nyid dbang gi snod du rung ba dang / bde stong gi ye shes skyed pa dang / rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel gyi khyad par las/ ngo bo mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal yin pa la/ rnam pa rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan sa/sum bla ma'i thugs kar rings pa'i tshul gyis gzigs pa/ de yang rings pa 'i tshul zer ba de bla ma mjal ba la gcig tu dga' 351

ba'i brel langs pa lta bu'i rnam 'gyur la zer ba yin/phyag g.yas na ma rig gti mug gnyid las slong bar byed pa'i thod pa'i ḍa ma ru nam mkha'i dbyengs su 'khrol ba/ g.yon dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'i gri gug dkur brten pa/ sku gcer mo rus pa'i rgyan can me tog gi zun 'phyang can snang la rang bzhin med pa nam mkhar 'ja' tshon shar ba lta bu zhig bsgom/ de'i spyi bor mda' gang tsam gyi steng gi nam mkhar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i padma 'dab ma 'bum brdal zhig bsgom/ de'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ngo bo dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo mtshungs med thugs rje'i gter mdzod dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la/ rnam pa o rgyan rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar la dmar pa'i mdangs chags pa/zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol ba'i stabs su bzhugs pa/ sku la za ber chos gos phod ka gsol ba/ dbu la pad zhu mnabs pa/de yang o rgyan rin po che'i dbu zhwa 'di la mi 'dra ba gsum yod de/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa de nyid lho nub 'o ma can gyi rgya mtsho las pha yi rgyu las ma bskyed/ ma yi rkyen las ma grub/ padma ge sar gyi sdong por rig pa thol skyes su 'khrungs snang srid gzhir bzhengs su rtogs dus/mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rigs bdag gi tshul du gsol ba la padma kha 'bus zhes bya/ dur khrod chen po brgyad du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad de/ spyod pa legs nyes kyi mtha' stong pa'i dus su mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis che rtags kyi tshul du gsol ba la sha ba'i mnyen zhu zhes bya/ za hor rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyis gson bsregs mdzad pa'i tshe/ rdo rje'i sku la 352

'byung ba me yi gnod pas ma tshugs te ngo mtshar padma'i dbus na sku gcer bu grang bsil bsil ltar bzhugs pa'i tshe/rgyal po ngo mtshar dang dad pa skyes nas/za 'og ber mdzod gsar pa'i sgo phyes la//nga yi zhwa gos thams cad khyer la shog /ces zer te sku chas thams cad dang rgyal srid 'bangs 'khor dang bcas pa 'bul dus kyi dbu zhwa de la padma mthong grol zer ba las/ 'dir padma mthong grol lam 'dab ldan rigs lnga 'di nyid yin te/ de yang bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug mtshon pa'i phyi nang rim pa gnyis/ sku gsum mtshon pas yar rtse gsum/ sku lnga'i don mdzad pa mtshon pas kha dog lnga thabs dang shes rab mtshon pas nyi ma dang zla ba/ dam tshig la mu mtha' med pas mu khyud mthung ga ting nge 'dzin la g.yo 'gul med pas rdo rje'i tog lta ba'i yang rtse rtogs shing sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin pas rgod kyi rtse sgros brgyan pa de lta bu zhig yin/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje thugs kar sdigs mdzub kyis 'dzin pa/ g.yon ma nyam bzhag gi steng na ka pā la 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bkang ba'i tshe'i bum pa dpag bsam ljon shing gi kha rgyan dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ mchan khung g.yon na yum lha lcam mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug sbas pa'i tshul gyi kha ba ga 'dzin pa/ kha ṭī de yang ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum mtshon pa'i yar rtse gsum/ chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum mtshon pa'i thod pa skam rlon rnying gsum/ theg pa rim pa dgu mtshon pa'i rwa la lcags lung dgu/ ye shes lnga mtshon phyir dar tshon sna lnga/ dur khrod chen po brgyad du brtul zhugs kyi sbyong ba mdzad de ma mo dang mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdus pa'i brdar shi skra dang gson skra la sogs pas brgyan pa de lta bu zhig 353

gsal btab/ de'i mtha' skor du 'od lnga'i drwa ba mig mang ris su shar ba'i nang khong 'ja' 'od zlum 'khyil gyi dbus na/ rgya gar gyi rig 'dzin brgyad bod kyi rje 'bangs nyer lnga la sogs rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho tha mal gyi snang ba rang 'gags su 'gro ba zhig gsal gdab/ spyir bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa 'di la sgom lugs mi 'dra ba gsum yod pa las/ skyabs 'gro'i dus tshogs zhing de bla ma mtho brtsegs su bsgom par bya ba yin te/ o rgyan chen po'i dbu gtsug na rdzogs chen brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad tho brtsegs su gsal 'debs pa yin/ rdor sems sgom bzlas kyi dus kyi de kun 'dus nor bu'i lugs su bsgom par bya ba yin te/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' gcig la 'dus par sgom pa yin/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs 'di bla ma khrom tshogs su sgom par bya ba yin te/ rdzogs chen brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang / rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho thams cad o rgyan chen po'i sku'i mtha' bskor na khrom tshogs pa ltar bzhugs pa yin/de nas/ e ma ho/ rang snang lhun grub dag pa rab 'byams zhing / /sogs nas/ gsal stong mnyam gnas chen po'i ngang du gsal/ /zhes tshig don 'brel chags par gsal btab la/ de nas mos gus kyi gdung pa drag po bskyed de/ hūṃ/ u rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams/ /sogs nas/ gu ru padma sirnyi hūṃ/ zhes brjod ma thag tu zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo padma 'od kyi pho brang rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad dngos su byon te/ rang gis bskyed pa'i dam tshig pa la chu la chu bzhag pa ltar gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ gnyis pa yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/'di ltar rdo rje theg pa'i lam thabs mang pa dang / 354

dka' ba med pa dang /dbang po rnon po'i spyod yul yin pas/sems stobs chen pos tshogs bsags pa la rgyun chags su bslabs pas/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i bskal pa chen po'i tshogs 'dir skad cig ma la 'dum nas tshe gcig la sogs par grol ba yin no/ /de'i phyir gsang ba bla na med pa'i tshogs zhing gi rab dang phul tu gyur pa yang rdo rje slob dpon nyag gcig tu nges bas bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang rjes su 'brel bar byung la/ de la tshogs gsog pa'i sgo mtha' yas pa yan lag bdun du 'du ba las/dang po nga rgyal gyi gnyen po phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag ni/ rang gi lus brgya stong grangs med pa zhing gi rdul gyi grangs snyed cig sprul te nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyang rang dang lhan du phyag 'tshal bar bsam zhing / dīḥbadag lus zhing gi rdul rnyed du/ rnam par 'phrul pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod/ de yang spyir khrid sbyang 'bum lnga ma tshang tsam byed pa rnams nas skyabs 'gro sogs dang sbre' te phyag 'tshal kyang rung bas de ltar byed pa'i phyag len kyang yod mod/ 'on kyang phyag gi khrid dngos 'di yin pas bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel par phyag 'tshal na ni phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /de yang phyag 'tshal ba'i tshe lus kyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba/ ngag gis phyag 'tshal dang gsol 'debs kyi tshig 'don pa/ yid kyis ci mdzad khyed shes dang blo gtad ling bskyur gyi mos gus dang bcas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad lhan cig phyag 'tshal ba'i dmigs pa sogs lus ngag yid gsum chun gcig dril du byed pa ni gnad che la/ de ltar ma yin par kha yengs mig yengs sems phyi rol gyi yul rjes su 'brangs/ g.yas phyos/sa nas 'gro 'dug dang smra 355

brjod byed pa byung na mig dang shes pa de phyogs su g.yeng zhig thal mo 'gram pa g.yon gyi steng du sbyar/ g.yon phyogs su de bzhin byung na mig dang shes pa de phyogs su g.yeng zhing 'gram pa g.yas kyi steng du thal mo sbyar ba lta bu/ sems rnam g.yeng gi dbang du btang / lus de kho nas khyo ro ro phyag 'tshal 'dogs byed pa la ni/ rang gi gzugs por sdug gtad pa tsam las snying po ci yang med pa shes bar bya'o/ /der ma zad phyag 'tshal tshe yang thal mo khong stong du padma kha 'bus lta bur sbyar dgos kyi/ thal mo nang khong stong med par lag mthil gnyis sprad de bca' ba dang /sor rtse thug tsam byed pa sogs ni mi rung ste/ thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa'i mdo las/ padma kha 'bus phye 'dra ba/ lag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar te/ /lus dpag med pa'i sprin tshogs bcas/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes dang / yon tan mdzod las kyang / bab col goms pa min ba'i lus btud nas/ /snying nas gus bcas mngon rtogs ngom pa la/ /me tog dogs pas rab bzung snyim pa'i snod//ga bu chung gi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa yin//zhes gsungs/de nas rim bzhin thal mo sbyi bor sbyar bas lus kyi sgrib pa 'dagamagrin par sbyar bas ngag gi sgrib pa 'dag /snying gar sbyar bas yid kyi sgrib pa 'dag /de nas lus kyi ma lnga sa la phab pa zhes bya ba//dpral ba dang gcig lag mthil gnyis/ pus mo gnyis dang lnga po sa la phab ste phyag byas pas/ nyon mongs pa dug lnga'i sgrib pa 'dag pa dang /sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga'i byin rlabs thob pa la sogs pa'i dgos pa yod pas de ltar bya/ de nas yar langs pa'i tshe yang rked pa drang por bsrangs te thal mo bcas nas yang sngar ltar phyag 356
