che yang / /blo rbongs yid kyi khang bur 'jug dka' zhing //don zab lta grub mthon bo'i kha skad kyang / /snyigs spyod blo chung skye bos nyams len dka'/ /de slad gzhung 'di shes sla don du 'dus/ /blo chung blo yi khung bur gser gyi bcud/ /blo dman yid kyi mun par mar me bzhin/ /don bzang rang gsal khro med slob dpon yin/ /bshad yam tshig la zhen pa'i mkhas pa dang / /gzhung lugs gdams par ma shar ston chen kyang / /dam pa'i man ngag bcud 'di 'thungs dang gzod/ /nyam len gnad kyi lus zungs los kyang rgyas//stong sgom mun rdo 'phen pa'i sgom chen dang / /dge sbyor byas yus 'dren pa'i sgrub pa po//rang rgyud tshod ma longs pa'i grub brdzu rnams/ /lam 'di mthong na snying gi thur ma byed/ /bshad yam tshig gi spros gzhung mang thos shing / /snyan tshig 'ja' tshon ri mo bri mkhas kyang / /drin ldan bla ma'i zhal rgyun ma lags pa//rang bzo'i tshig ris bsres ba 'di la med/ /mtshungs med bla ma sangs rgyas dngos byon te/ /gangs ljongs 'jig rten skal ba bzang po ru/ /gyur pa'i dus tshod de las 'gyangs min pas/ /da dung rdo rje'i mched bzhugs 'di la dbang / /de slad yang dag bka' yi bsdu ba ru/ /brtson pa'i rgyu yang dam pa'i drin las te/ /mos gus bsam pa bzang po'i lag ris la/ /ye rangs lhar bcas mched kyis stsal bar rigs/ /slad nas 'byon pa'i skal bzang gang zag kyang //tshul 'di mthong na bla ma sangs rgyas de/ /dngos su mjal ba'i mos gus skyed cig dang / /gsung gi gnad la nor 'khrul med dam snyam//de 'dra de las gang zhig thob pa yi//dge ba de yang mar gyur 'gro ba kun/ /bshes gnyen dam pas zin nas dam pa'i gsung / /sgrub pa'i 'bras legs mthong ba'i rgyu ru 409

bsngo/ /khyad par mtshungs med bla ma rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de yi zhal gyi bdud rtsis bskyangs mtha' dag /tshom bu gcig tu mngon par sangs rgyas nas//'gro ba'i 'dren par chas pa'ang mthong gyur cig /dam pa'i legs bshad bdud rtsi'i bcud gsol te/ /gdams pa'i sbos glus skal bzang yid 'gugs pa'i/ /drin chen bla ma'i rgyal tshab mchog rnams kyang / /zhabs pad rdo rje'i khri la brtan gyur cig /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bla ma mchog dang de yi rjes 'jug gi /bran du gyur nas ci gsung bka' sgrub cing / /mnyes pas rjes su 'dzin pa yod gyur cig /'khor ba'i mtha' dang lus can mtha' de srid/ /lus dang longs spyod dge ba kun spungs te/ /nyams thag ma rgan rnams kyi g.yog bgyid cing / /de kun rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'dzin shog /gnas skabs su yang brgyud pa rin po che'i/ /byin rlabs nyi ma snying la legs 'char zhing / /dben pa'i gnas su tshe 'dir mthar byas te/ /mtshungs med bla ma'i drung der 'gro bar shog /de ltar klong chen snying gi thig le'i thun mong phyi nang gi khrid yig mtshungs med bla ma dam pa'i zhal rgyun ltar bris pa 'di yang / snga sor rje bla ma'i zhal slob sdom brtson dam pa sgron ma tshe ring nas khong rang gi thugs la gang nges zin ris su bris nas byin te/'di la gzhi byas nas khyed kyis rje'i zhal rgyun bcos med kyi khrid yig cig cis kyang bris shig ces nan tan gyis bskul ba dang /khyad par rje btsun bla ma mchog gi smin grol gyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku rin po che kun bzang theg mchog rdo rje'i zhal snga nas bri gzhi'i shog bu dang 410

bcas pa gnang nas lan grangs gnyis gsum gyi bar du gsung gis bskul ba dang / slar yang skyabs mgon bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gi brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i thugs sras yongs kyi thu bo yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sku zhabs rin po che gzhan phan mtha' yas 'od zer nas/ rje bla ma'i zhal rgyun gsung sgros ltar yi ger bris na/ bla ma dran pa'i mos gus kyi gsos su 'dug pas cis kyang bris shig ces gsung gis dbugs dbyung gnang ba dang / gzhan yang ji srid byang chub snying po'i mthas gtugs pa de srid du me mar gyi 'od dang sdong bu ltar 'grogs par nges pa/ dpral ba'i mig ltar brtse ba'i rdo rje'i mched po du mas legs so'i dbugs dbyung dang blo gros kyi zur gsos thob pa la brten nas/mtshungs med grub brgya'i gtsug rgyan rig 'dzin byang chub rdo rje zhal snga nas/ o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po zhes ming gi cod pan byen pa yin na yang /don du dug lnga me 'bar sa bu hral por 'bod pa'i gdol spyod mkhan de nyid kyis/ ru dam o rgyan bsam gtan chos gling gi yang dben 'jigs byed dus dgra'i dbang po'i pho brang dben pa'i yon tan ma tshang ba med pa'i rgyan gyis brjid chags par spras shing / drod bcud nyi zer 'od snang byi bos len la/bsil bcud bdud rtsi'i thigs pa rkang pas 'thungs pa'i ljon shing dang / 'khri shing dang /lcug ma dang /phang phung dang /ldum bu dang /sdong po'i bye brag rigs mi gcig pa du ma'i yal ga dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu 'phyangs 'phrul drwa ba dang /drwa ba phyed par bres pa'i khong seng nas sngo bsangs nam mkha'i bu mo'i 'dzum zer gyi bdud rtsis snying la sim pa cir yang sbyin pa'i gnas su/ 411
kyang mtha' 4dod ma'i mabo

rtsom sgrig 'gan khur pa/ mkhan po rdo rje/lag bstar rtsom sgrig pa/ karma gu ru/ sngags 'chang gu ru/dge che/gas nyi ma//mtsho sngon nang bstan dpe tshogs/glegs bam gnyis pa/khrid yig kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung /dpal sprul rin po ches brtsams/mkhan po rdo rjes bsgrigs/zhang kang then mā dpe skrun khang gis bskru na te bkram/lan kru'u dmag khul dpar khang gis par/deb tshad/850ya1168 1732 dpar shog 13gsab shog4 yig/ grangs khri23nyis sto/nga gcig lo'i zla bdun par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs//nyis sto nga gcis lo'i zla ba bdun par dpar thengs dang po dpar/dbe rtags/ 1④2ma962—450—953—07za ‘12048rin gong / sgo ra 17 5
